### Create `apps/admin/test/edge.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { EDGE_WORDS, type CaseView, type EdgePurgeView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { bothTimes } from "../src/ui";
import { IMAGE_ONE, IMAGE_TWO, postCase, postSnapshot } from "./case-fixtures";

/**
 * The edge's purge lines on a case (3d design, sections 8.1, 8.4 and 10.3; Task 3), server-rendered: beside each image
 * of the newest snapshot that stopped being public, [case.purge.accepted] with its time, [case.purge.failed],
 * [case.purge.off] and [case.purge.pending], each the minutes of the edge's bound from EDGE_WORDS, never typed; nothing
 * beside an image that never stopped being public, and nothing for a snapshot that is withheld.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const text = (out: string) =>
  out
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replaceAll("&quot;", '"')
    .replaceAll("&#x27;", "'")
    .replaceAll("&lt;", "<")
    .replaceAll("&gt;", ">")
    .replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const noop = () => undefined;
const base: Omit<CaseScreenViewProps, "caseId" | "view"> = {
  shownImage: null,
  busy: null,
  notice: null,
  error: null,
  note: "",
  reveal: null,
  onOpenCase: noop,
  onShowImage: noop,
  onShowClearly: noop,
  onHideImage: noop,
  onImageError: noop,
  onSnapshot: noop,
  onNoteChange: noop,
  onNoteSave: noop,
  onRevealOpen: noop,
  onRevealChange: noop,
  onRevealConfirm: noop,
  onRevealClose: noop,
};
const IMAGE_THREE = "2c3d4e5f-6a7b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f";
const IMAGE_FOUR = "3d4e5f6a-7b8c-4d9e-8f0a-2b3c4d5e6f7a";
const AT = "2026-10-19T09:15:00.000Z";
const page = (view: CaseView) => html(<CaseScreenView {...base} caseId={parseCaseId(view.id)!} view={view} />);

/** The post's case whose newest snapshot lists four images, with these purge lines. */
function withPurges(purges: EdgePurgeView[]): CaseView {
  const four = postSnapshot({
    media: [
      { id: IMAGE_ONE, alt: "one", width: 2048, height: 1536 },
      { id: IMAGE_TWO, alt: "two", width: 800, height: 600 },
      { id: IMAGE_THREE, alt: "three", width: 640, height: 480 },
      { id: IMAGE_FOUR, alt: "four", width: 320, height: 240 },
    ],
  });
  return postCase({ snapshots: [four], purges });
}

describe("[case.purge.*] beside each image that stopped being public (3d design, section 8.4)", () => {
  test("the four words, from the outcome, the answer's time and EDGE_WORDS", () => {
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("accepted", bothTimes(AT))).toBe(`Edge copy: purge accepted at ${bothTimes(AT)}.`);
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("failed", bothTimes(AT))).toBe(
      `Edge copy: purge failed. A copy may have been served for up to ${EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes} minutes after the measure; the operator is alerted.`,
    );
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("off", bothTimes(AT))).toBe(`Edge copy: no purge (off): a copy may be served for up to ${EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes} minutes.`);
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("pending", bothTimes(AT))).toBe("Edge copy: purge not sent yet.");
    // The minutes are the constant's, which the header is built from: five while EDGE_CACHE.edgeSeconds is 300.
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("off", "x")).toContain("up to 5 minutes");
  });

  test("each image of the newest snapshot gets its own line, in the image's place, and an image with no row gets none", () => {
    const out = page(
      withPurges([
        { mediaId: IMAGE_ONE, outcome: "accepted", at: AT },
        { mediaId: IMAGE_TWO, outcome: "failed", at: AT },
        { mediaId: IMAGE_THREE, outcome: "off", at: AT },
      ]),
    );
    const shown = text(out);
    const lines = [AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("accepted", bothTimes(AT)), AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("failed", bothTimes(AT)), AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("off", bothTimes(AT))];
    for (const line of lines) expect(shown.split(line).length - 1, line).toBe(1);
    expect(shown).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("pending", bothTimes(AT)));
    // In the images' order: each line follows its image's size and comes before the next image.
    const at = (part: string) => shown.indexOf(part);
    expect(at("2048 by 1536 pixels")).toBeLessThan(at(lines[0]!));
    expect(at(lines[0]!)).toBeLessThan(at("800 by 600 pixels"));
    expect(at("800 by 600 pixels")).toBeLessThan(at(lines[1]!));
    expect(at(lines[1]!)).toBeLessThan(at("640 by 480 pixels"));
    expect(at(lines[2]!)).toBeLessThan(at("320 by 240 pixels"));
    expect(shown.split("Edge copy:").length - 1).toBe(3);
    // A failure is drawn as a notice; the other lines as hints.
    expect(out).toContain(`<p class="purge notice">${AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("failed", bothTimes(AT))}</p>`);
    expect(out).toContain(`<p class="purge hint">${AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge("off", bothTimes(AT))}</p>`);
  });

  test("pending while the row has no outcome; nothing at all while no image stopped being public, or while the snapshot is withheld", () => {
    expect(text(page(withPurges([{ mediaId: IMAGE_FOUR, outcome: "pending", at: AT }])))).toContain("Edge copy: purge not sent yet.");
    expect(text(page(withPurges([])))).not.toContain("Edge copy:");
    const withheld = { ...withPurges([{ mediaId: IMAGE_ONE, outcome: "accepted", at: AT }]), snapshots: [{ id: postSnapshot().id, takenAt: AT, digest: "a".repeat(64), withheld: true as const }] };
    expect(text(page(withheld as CaseView))).not.toContain("Edge copy:");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/media-edge-job.test.ts`

```ts
import { Writable } from "node:stream";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { EDGE_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryJobLock } from "../../src/lib/jobs";
import { edgeAdapterFrom, type EdgeAdapter } from "../../src/media/edge-adapter";
import { EDGE_JOB, EDGE_ROUND_MS, createEdgeJob, edgeRound } from "../../src/media/edge";
import { createMediaRepo } from "../../src/media/repo";
import { fakeEdge } from "../media/fake-edge";
import { aPost, act, decideIn, imagePost, newTestStaff, report, rowCounts, staffProfile, uuids, type Runner, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/**
 * The outbox's job, edge-purge (3d design, sections 7.4 and 7.14; 12.1 row 20; Task 3), against the `test` adapter and
 * fakeEdge(): one request a round with at most EDGE_RULES.prefixes prefixes, each `<host>/api/media/<id>/`; a failed
 * purge backs off from 30 seconds, doubled a failure, to an hour; after 24 hours a row is failed and edge_purge_failed is
 * written once in 24 hours; a row written while the request was out stays open; a round that throws leaves its rows; a
 * measure stands while the edge is down; the token is in no log line and no audit row. Every test runs in a transaction
 * that is rolled back; the `test` adapter is built in the process on a site this test has closed.
 */
const silent = pino({ level: "silent" });
const TOKEN = "edge_token_that_must_never_be_seen_9876";
const ZONE = "fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210";
const testAdapter = (host = "edge.test") => {
  const adapter = edgeAdapterFrom({ EDGE_PURGE: "test", APP_SITE: "closed", EDGE_HOST: host });
  if (adapter.mode !== "test") throw new Error("not the test adapter");
  return adapter;
};

type Row = {
  id: string;
  media_id: string;
  attempts: number;
  outcome: string | null;
  done: boolean;
  wait: number | null;
};
/** The outbox rows of these images, oldest first, with the seconds from the transaction's start to when each is due again. */
const rowsOf = (q: Runner, mediaIds: readonly string[]) =>
  q.execute<Row>(sql`
    select id::text as id, media_id, attempts, outcome, done_at is not null as done, extract(epoch from next_at - now())::int as wait
      from public.edge_purges e where e.media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)}) order by e.id`);

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the edge's job (3d Task 3)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, createAuthRepo(authDb), "moderator");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, ["edge_purges", "alert_outbox"]);
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /**
   * `n` images, each of its own post, that stopped being public by their author's deletion, in id order of their rows; and
   * every other row still open in the database closed as off inside the transaction, so a round sees these alone.
   */
  async function hidden(tx: DbTx, n: number): Promise<string[]> {
    const ids: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author' where id = ${p.postId}::uuid`);
      ids.push(p.mediaIds[0]!);
    }
    await tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set outcome = 'off', done_at = now() where done_at is null and media_id <> all(${uuids(ids)})`);
    return ids;
  }
  const deps = (tx: DbTx, adapter: EdgeAdapter, log = silent) => ({ repo: createMediaRepo(tx as unknown as Db), adapter, log });
  /** Makes every open row of these images due again now, as the next round's time would. */
  const dueNow = (tx: DbTx, ids: readonly string[]) => tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set next_at = now() where done_at is null and media_id = any(${uuids(ids)})`);

  test("one request a round with at most 30 prefixes, the oldest images first, each prefix the host, the image route and the id; the next round sends the rest", async () => {
    // A round EDGE_RULES.roundSeconds after the last ended, one request each: at most four a minute.
    expect(EDGE_ROUND_MS).toBe(EDGE_RULES.roundSeconds * 1000);
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const ids = await hidden(tx, EDGE_RULES.prefixes + 5);
      const adapter = testAdapter();
      const first = await edgeRound(deps(tx, adapter));
      expect(first).toMatchObject({ off: 0, sent: 1, prefixes: EDGE_RULES.prefixes, outcome: "accepted", closed: EDGE_RULES.prefixes, gaveUp: 0, alerted: false });
      expect(adapter.sent).toEqual([ids.slice(0, EDGE_RULES.prefixes).map((id) => `edge.test/api/media/${id}/`)]);
      expect((await rowsOf(tx, ids)).map((row) => row.outcome)).toEqual([...Array(EDGE_RULES.prefixes).fill("accepted"), ...Array(5).fill(null)]);
      const second = await edgeRound(deps(tx, adapter));
      expect(second).toMatchObject({ sent: 1, prefixes: 5, outcome: "accepted", closed: 5 });
      expect(adapter.sent[1]).toEqual(ids.slice(EDGE_RULES.prefixes).map((id) => `edge.test/api/media/${id}/`));
      // Nothing is left: a round reads nothing and sends nothing.
      expect(await edgeRound(deps(tx, adapter))).toMatchObject({ sent: 0, prefixes: 0, outcome: null, closed: 0 });
      expect(adapter.sent).toHaveLength(2);
    });
  });

  test("two rows of one image are one prefix; a failed purge backs off from 30 seconds, doubled a failure, to one hour, and leaves its rows open", async () => {
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      // The post's state, then the image's own delete: two rows for one image.
      await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author' where id = ${p.postId}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from post_media where id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set outcome = 'off', done_at = now() where done_at is null and media_id <> ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
      const failing = testAdapter("fail.edge.test");
      const waits: number[] = [];
      for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 9; attempt++) {
        const round = await edgeRound(deps(tx, failing));
        expect(round, `attempt ${attempt}`).toMatchObject({ sent: 1, prefixes: 1, outcome: "failed", closed: 0, gaveUp: 0, alerted: false });
        const rows = await rowsOf(tx, p.mediaIds);
        expect(rows.map((row) => [row.attempts, row.outcome, row.done])).toEqual([
          [attempt, null, false],
          [attempt, null, false],
        ]);
        waits.push(rows[0]!.wait!);
        await dueNow(tx, p.mediaIds);
      }
      expect(waits).toEqual([30, 60, 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920, 3600, 3600]);
      expect(failing.sent.every((prefixes) => prefixes.length === 1)).toBe(true);
      // Backing off, a row is not due, and a round leaves it alone.
      await edgeRound(deps(tx, failing));
      expect(await edgeRound(deps(tx, failing))).toMatchObject({ sent: 0, outcome: null });
    });
  });

  test("a row written 24 hours ago that fails again is failed, and the job writes edge_purge_failed with the count and the oldest time, once in 24 hours", async () => {
    // As the migrator, who alone moves a row's created_at back, in a transaction rolled back.
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const ids = await hidden(tx, 3);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'edge_purge_failed'`);
      // The first two were written a day and a minute ago; the third now.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set created_at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${EDGE_RULES.giveUpHours}, mins => 1) where media_id = any(${uuids(ids.slice(0, 2))})`);
      const failing = testAdapter("fail.edge.test");
      const round = await edgeRound(deps(tx, failing));
      expect(round).toMatchObject({ sent: 1, prefixes: 3, outcome: "failed", closed: 0, gaveUp: 2, alerted: true });
      expect((await rowsOf(tx, ids)).map((row) => [row.outcome, row.done, row.attempts])).toEqual([
        ["failed", true, 1],
        ["failed", true, 1],
        [null, false, 1],
      ]);
      const [oldest] = await tx.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select to_char(min(created_at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as at from public.edge_purges where media_id = any(${uuids(ids)})`);
      const alerts = await tx.execute<{ priority: number; scope: string; facts: Record<string, unknown>; step: number | null }>(sql`select priority, scope, facts, step from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'edge_purge_failed'`);
      expect(alerts.map((a) => ({ ...a }))).toEqual([{ priority: 3, scope: "all", facts: { count: 2, oldestAt: oldest!.at }, step: null }]);
      // The third gives up too, a round later, with no second alert within 24 hours.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set created_at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${EDGE_RULES.giveUpHours}) where media_id = ${ids[2]!}::uuid`);
      await dueNow(tx, ids);
      expect(await edgeRound(deps(tx, failing))).toMatchObject({ gaveUp: 1, alerted: false });
      expect(await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'edge_purge_failed'`)).toHaveLength(1);
    });
  });

  test("a row written while the request was out stays open for the next round: it may stand for a hiding the purge did not cover", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const [image] = await hidden(tx, 1);
      const inner = testAdapter();
      // An adapter that, while its request is out, sees the image hidden once more: the trigger's row, as the migrator writes it here.
      const racing: EdgeAdapter = {
        mode: "test",
        prefix: (id) => inner.prefix(id),
        purge: async (prefixes) => {
          await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.edge_purges (media_id, cause) values (${image!}::uuid, 'state')`);
          return inner.purge(prefixes);
        },
      };
      expect(await edgeRound(deps(tx, racing))).toMatchObject({ outcome: "accepted", closed: 1 });
      expect((await rowsOf(tx, [image!])).map((row) => row.outcome)).toEqual(["accepted", null]);
      expect(await edgeRound(deps(tx, inner))).toMatchObject({ outcome: "accepted", closed: 1, prefixes: 1 });
      expect((await rowsOf(tx, [image!])).map((row) => row.outcome)).toEqual(["accepted", "accepted"]);
    });
  });

  test("a round that throws leaves its rows as they were", async () => {
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const ids = await hidden(tx, 2);
      const broken: EdgeAdapter = { mode: "test", prefix: (id) => `edge.test/api/media/${id}/`, purge: async () => Promise.reject(new Error("the adapter broke")) };
      await expect(edgeRound(deps(tx, broken))).rejects.toThrow(/the adapter broke/);
      expect((await rowsOf(tx, ids)).map((row) => [row.attempts, row.outcome, row.wait])).toEqual([
        [0, null, 0],
        [0, null, 0],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("a measure stands while the edge is down; the bearer token reaches the provider and no log line or audit row", async () => {
    const edge = await fakeEdge();
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const log = pino({ level: "trace" }, new Writable({ write: (chunk: Buffer, _encoding, done) => void (lines.push(chunk.toString("utf8")), done()) }));
    try {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        await staffProfile(tx, mod);
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        await tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set outcome = 'off', done_at = now() where done_at is null and media_id <> all(${uuids(p.mediaIds)})`);
        const [audit] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from audit_log`);
        const adapter = edgeAdapterFrom({ EDGE_PURGE: "cloudflare", APP_SITE: "open", EDGE_ZONE_ID: ZONE, EDGE_API_TOKEN: TOKEN, EDGE_HOST: "korbat.example" }, { apiBase: edge.apiBase });
        edge.answer("forbidden");
        expect(await edgeRound(deps(tx, adapter, log))).toMatchObject({ sent: 1, prefixes: 2, outcome: "failed" });
        // The measure stood from its commit: the post is withheld whatever the edge answered.
        const [post] = await tx.execute<{ level: string }>(sql`select moderation_level::text as level from posts where id = ${p.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(post!.level).toBe("withheld");
        edge.answer("ok");
        await dueNow(tx, p.mediaIds);
        expect(await edgeRound(deps(tx, adapter, log))).toMatchObject({ sent: 1, prefixes: 2, outcome: "accepted", closed: 4 });
        // The trigger writes a post's images in id order: the prefixes are compared as a set.
        const prefixes = [...p.mediaIds].sort().map((id) => `korbat.example/api/media/${id}/`);
        expect(edge.requests.map((r) => [r.path, r.bearer, [...(r.prefixes ?? [])].sort()])).toEqual([
          [`/client/v4/zones/${ZONE}/purge_cache`, true, prefixes],
          [`/client/v4/zones/${ZONE}/purge_cache`, true, prefixes],
        ]);
        // The job wrote no audit row, and no row of the log holds the token.
        const [after] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from audit_log`);
        expect(after!.n).toBe(audit!.n);
        expect(await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from audit_log where metadata::text like ${`%${TOKEN}%`}`)).toHaveLength(0);
      });
      expect(lines.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(lines.join("")).not.toContain(TOKEN);
    } finally {
      await edge.close();
    }
  });

  test("the job runs under the shared lock: while another instance holds job:edge-purge a round is skipped", async () => {
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const lock = new MemoryJobLock();
      const job = createEdgeJob(deps(tx, testAdapter()), lock);
      expect(await lock.acquire(`job:${EDGE_JOB}`, "another instance", 60_000)).toBe(true);
      expect(await job.round()).toBe("skipped");
      await lock.release(`job:${EDGE_JOB}`, "another instance");
      expect(await job.round()).toBe("ran");
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, ["edge_purges", "alert_outbox"])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { MEASURES, type ActionKind } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { edgeAdapterFrom } from "../../src/media/edge-adapter";
import { edgeRound } from "../../src/media/edge";

import { createSocialRepo } from "../../src/social/repo";

import { effectParams, effectWith, orderForTest } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { moveForTest, reportForTest } from "./release-fixtures";
import { ageCase } from "./retention-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { pgError, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Each test runs dozens of decisions inside one open transaction: on a loaded machine that takes longer than the five
// seconds a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/**
 * The edge's outbox (3d design, sections 2 row 11, 6.3 and 7.4; 12.1 row 19; Task 3): every way an image stops being
 * public writes its outbox row in the transaction that hides it, through the two triggers post_media_purge and
 * posts_purge, whoever the writer is: a measure of 3c, 3e or 3f (moderation_apply), an author's deletion, the account's
 * purge, an R4 redaction, the disposal and a release, each with its cause. Nothing writes a row when nothing public
 * changed: a lift, an account's measure, an upload on no post. A row is written with the edge's adapter off, and the job
 * then closes it as off. Every test runs in a transaction that is rolled back, so nothing stays.
 */

/**
 * Every kind of MEASURES with what it writes when it is taken on a public post: `state` for each image it hides, or
 * nothing. Typed over every action kind, so a kind added to the ledger fails this file until it is listed here.
 */
const WRITES: Record<ActionKind, "state" | "none"> = {
  withhold: "state",
  remove: "state",
  seal_media: "state",
  withhold_media: "state",
  remove_media: "state",
  // A profile's resets, and every measure of 3e on an account: an account case names no post, and its ledger row none.
  reset_display_name: "none",
  reset_bio: "none",
  strike: "none",
  suspend: "none",
  terminate: "none",
  retire_handle: "none",
  warn_reporting: "none",
  restrict_reporting: "none",
  // 3f: a post disabled for an order leaves the public through its level.
  disable_by_order: "state",
  // A lift makes something public again: nothing has to leave a cache.
  restore: "none",
  unseal_media: "none",
  restore_media: "none",
  restore_display_name: "none",
  restore_bio: "none",
  overrule: "none",
  lift_suspension: "none",
  unretire_handle: "none",
  lift_reporting: "none",
  reinstate_by_order: "none",
};

type OutboxRow = {
  media_id: string;
  cause: string;
  outcome: string | null;
  attempts: number;
  done: boolean;
  due_now: boolean;
};

/** The outbox rows of these images, oldest first. */
const outbox = (q: Runner, mediaIds: readonly string[]) =>
  q.execute<OutboxRow>(sql`
    select media_id, cause, outcome, attempts, done_at is not null as done, next_at = now() as due_now
      from public.edge_purges where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)}) order by id`);

/** For each image, in the order given, the causes its rows carry, each once and sorted. */
async function causes(q: Runner, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<string[][]> {
  const rows = await outbox(q, mediaIds);
  return mediaIds.map((id) => [...new Set(rows.filter((row) => row.media_id === id).map((row) => row.cause))].sort());
}
const none = (n: number): string[][] => Array.from({ length: n }, () => []);
const each = (n: number, cause: string): string[][] => Array.from({ length: n }, () => [cause]);

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the edge's outbox, written by two triggers (3d Task 3)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;

  beforeAll(async () => {

      const report = await edgeRound({ repo: createMediaRepo(tx as unknown as Db), adapter: off, log: pino({ level: "silent" }) });
      expect(report.off).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);

      expect(rows.length).toBe(4);
      expect(rows.every((row) => row.outcome === "off" && row.done)).toBe(true);
      // Every open row, not only these: the queue closes by itself while the adapter is off.
      expect(await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from public.edge_purges where done_at is null`)).toHaveLength(0);
    });

  test("a new row's times are forced, its two lists and its ends are CHECKs, and the API's role reads, moves the four columns and deletes, but inserts nothing", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const [row] = await tx.execute<{ forced: boolean }>(sql`
        insert into public.edge_purges (media_id, cause, created_at, next_at) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'state', '2001-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2001-01-01T00:00:00Z')
        returning created_at > '2001-01-02T00:00:00Z' and next_at = now() as forced`);
      expect(row!.forced).toBe(true);
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.edge_purges (media_id, cause) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'hidden')`))))?.code).toBe("23514");
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.edge_purges (media_id, cause, outcome) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'state', 'off')`))))?.code).toBe("23514");
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.edge_purges (media_id, cause, outcome, done_at) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'state', 'sent', now())`))))?.code).toBe("23514");
    });
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.edge_purges (media_id, cause) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'state')`))))?.code).toBe("42501");
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author' where id = ${p.postId}::uuid`);
      const [mine] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.edge_purges where media_id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set created_at = now() where id = ${mine!.id}`))))?.code).toBe("42501");
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set media_id = gen_random_uuid() where id = ${mine!.id}`))))?.code).toBe("42501");
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set attempts = 1, next_at = now() + interval '30 seconds' where id = ${mine!.id}`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set outcome = 'accepted', done_at = now() where id = ${mine!.id}`);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.edge_purges where id = ${mine!.id}`);
      expect(await outbox(tx, p.mediaIds)).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, ["edge_purges"])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/media/edge-adapter.test.ts`

```ts
import { createServer } from "node:net";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { EDGE_CACHE, EDGE_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { PRIVATE_CACHE, PUBLIC_CACHE } from "../../src/media/flows/serve";
import { edgeAdapterFrom, type EdgeSettings } from "../../src/media/edge-adapter";
import { fakeEdge } from "./fake-edge";

/**
 * The edge's purge adapter (3d design, section 5 "The adapters" and 7.4; 12.1 rows 20 and 27; Task 3): `off`, `test` and
 * `cloudflare`, chosen by EDGE_PURGE. The `test` adapter keeps the prefixes in memory and fails a prefix that contains
 * "fail"; it is built only on a site that is closed. The `cloudflare` adapter sends one request a call to the provider's
 * purge route with the bearer token, bounded at EDGE_RULES.timeoutMs, here against fakeEdge(); every failure answers
 * `failed`, and the token is in nothing it answers or throws.
 */
const ZONE = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";
const TOKEN = "edge_token_that_must_never_be_seen_0123";
const IMAGE = "1a2b3c4d-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1";
const OTHER = "1a2b3c4d-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e2";
const closed = (over: Partial<EdgeSettings> = {}): EdgeSettings => ({ EDGE_PURGE: "test", APP_SITE: "closed", EDGE_ZONE_ID: undefined, EDGE_API_TOKEN: undefined, EDGE_HOST: undefined, ...over });
const cloudflare = (over: Partial<EdgeSettings> = {}): EdgeSettings => ({ EDGE_PURGE: "cloudflare", APP_SITE: "open", EDGE_ZONE_ID: ZONE, EDGE_API_TOKEN: TOKEN, EDGE_HOST: "korbat.example", ...over });

describe("the public image's header (7.4)", () => {
  test("PUBLIC_CACHE is built from EDGE_CACHE: a browser's minute, an edge's five minutes, revalidated, never stale", () => {
    expect(PUBLIC_CACHE).toBe(`public, max-age=${EDGE_CACHE.browserSeconds}, s-maxage=${EDGE_CACHE.edgeSeconds}, must-revalidate, stale-if-error=0`);
    expect(PUBLIC_CACHE).toBe("public, max-age=60, s-maxage=300, must-revalidate, stale-if-error=0");
    expect(PRIVATE_CACHE).toBe("private, no-store");
  });
});

describe("the edge's purge adapter", () => {
  test("off: the default, which sends nothing", async () => {
    const off = edgeAdapterFrom({ EDGE_PURGE: "off", APP_SITE: "open" });
    expect(off.mode).toBe("off");
    await expect(off.purge([off.prefix(IMAGE)])).rejects.toThrow(/off/);
  });

  test("a prefix covers both sizes of an image and every query-string variant: the host, the image route and the id, with its slash", () => {
    expect(edgeAdapterFrom(cloudflare()).prefix(IMAGE)).toBe(`korbat.example/api/media/${IMAGE}/`);
    expect(edgeAdapterFrom(closed({ EDGE_HOST: "edge.test" })).prefix(IMAGE)).toBe(`edge.test/api/media/${IMAGE}/`);
  });

  test("test: keeps each call's prefixes in memory and accepts them; a prefix that contains fail fails", async () => {
    const adapter = edgeAdapterFrom(closed());
    if (adapter.mode !== "test") throw new Error("not the test adapter");
    expect(await adapter.purge([adapter.prefix(IMAGE), adapter.prefix(OTHER)])).toBe("accepted");
    expect(adapter.sent).toEqual([[adapter.prefix(IMAGE), adapter.prefix(OTHER)]]);
    const failing = edgeAdapterFrom(closed({ EDGE_HOST: "fail.edge.test" }));
    expect(await failing.purge([failing.prefix(IMAGE)])).toBe("failed");
    expect(await adapter.purge([adapter.prefix(IMAGE), "fail"])).toBe("failed");
  });

  test("test is refused while the app's site is open, in the process as at start", () => {
    expect(() => edgeAdapterFrom(closed({ APP_SITE: "open" }))).toThrow(/APP_SITE/);
  });

  test("cloudflare is refused without its zone, its token or its host", () => {
    for (const missing of ["EDGE_ZONE_ID", "EDGE_API_TOKEN", "EDGE_HOST"] as const) {
      expect(() => edgeAdapterFrom(cloudflare({ [missing]: undefined })), missing).toThrow(new RegExp(missing));
    }
  });

  test("no call names more prefixes than a request may carry, or none", async () => {
    const adapter = edgeAdapterFrom(closed());
    const many = Array.from({ length: EDGE_RULES.prefixes + 1 }, (_, i) => `edge.test/api/media/${i}/`);
    await expect(adapter.purge(many)).rejects.toThrow(/at most/);
    await expect(adapter.purge([])).rejects.toThrow(/at least one/);
  });

  describe("cloudflare, against fakeEdge()", () => {
    let edge: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof fakeEdge>>;
    beforeAll(async () => {
      edge = await fakeEdge();
    });
    afterAll(async () => {
      await edge.close();
    });

    test("one POST to the zone's purge route with the prefixes as JSON and a bearer token; accepted when the provider says success", async () => {
      edge.requests.length = 0;
      edge.answer("ok");
      const adapter = edgeAdapterFrom(cloudflare(), { apiBase: edge.apiBase });
      expect(await adapter.purge([adapter.prefix(IMAGE), adapter.prefix(OTHER)])).toBe("accepted");
      expect(edge.requests).toEqual([
        { method: "POST", path: `/client/v4/zones/${ZONE}/purge_cache`, contentType: "application/json", prefixes: [`korbat.example/api/media/${IMAGE}/`, `korbat.example/api/media/${OTHER}/`], bearer: true },
      ]);
    });

    test("a server error, a body that says it failed, a refused token, a closed port and a provider that does not answer within the bound: each failed, with nothing thrown", async () => {
      const adapter = edgeAdapterFrom(cloudflare(), { apiBase: edge.apiBase });
      for (const how of ["error", "refused", "forbidden"] as const) {
        edge.answer(how);
        expect(await adapter.purge([adapter.prefix(IMAGE)]), how).toBe("failed");
      }
      // A port nobody listens on: taken and released again, so the connection is refused.
      const port = await new Promise<number>((resolve) => {
        const probe = createServer().listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => {
          const taken = (probe.address() as { port: number }).port;
          probe.close(() => resolve(taken));
        });
      });
      expect(await edgeAdapterFrom(cloudflare(), { apiBase: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}/client/v4` }).purge([adapter.prefix(IMAGE)])).toBe("failed");
      edge.answer("hang");
      const started = Date.now();
      expect(await adapter.purge([adapter.prefix(IMAGE)])).toBe("failed");
      const waited = Date.now() - started;
      expect(waited).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(EDGE_RULES.timeoutMs - 100);
      expect(waited).toBeLessThan(EDGE_RULES.timeoutMs + 5000);
      edge.answer("ok");
    }, 20_000);

    test("the token is in nothing the adapter shows: neither its own fields nor its text", () => {
      const adapter = edgeAdapterFrom(cloudflare(), { apiBase: edge.apiBase });
      expect(JSON.stringify(adapter)).not.toContain(TOKEN);
      expect(String(adapter)).not.toContain(TOKEN);
      expect(Object.values(adapter).map(String).join(" ")).not.toContain(TOKEN);
    });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/media/fake-edge.ts`

```ts
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type ServerResponse } from "node:http";
import type { AddressInfo } from "node:net";

/** One request the stand-in took: its method, its path, the prefixes of its body and whether a bearer token came, never the token. */
export interface EdgeRequest {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  contentType: string | null;
  /** The body's prefixes, or null when the body was not the purge's JSON. */
  prefixes: string[] | null;
  bearer: boolean;
}

/**
 * How the stand-in answers: as the provider does when it takes a purge (`ok`), with a server error (`error`), with a 200
 * whose body says it failed (`refused`), with 403 as for a token it does not accept (`forbidden`), or not at all, holding
 * the request open until it is closed (`hang`).
 */
export type EdgeAnswer = "ok" | "error" | "refused" | "forbidden" | "hang";

/**
 * fakeEdge() (3d design, section 12; Task 3): a local HTTP server that stands in for the edge provider's purge route. It
 * records each request, with whether an Authorization header carried a bearer token and never its value, and answers as
 * it is told. Its `apiBase` is what the cloudflare adapter is given in place of the provider's address.
 */
export async function fakeEdge(): Promise<{
  apiBase: string;
  requests: EdgeRequest[];
  answer(how: EdgeAnswer): void;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}> {
  const requests: EdgeRequest[] = [];
  const open = new Set<ServerResponse>();
  let how: EdgeAnswer = "ok";
  const server = createServer((req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse) => {
    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
    req.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => chunks.push(chunk));
    req.on("end", () => {
      let prefixes: string[] | null = null;
      try {
        const body = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8")) as { prefixes?: unknown };
        if (Array.isArray(body.prefixes) && body.prefixes.every((p) => typeof p === "string")) prefixes = body.prefixes as string[];
      } catch {
        prefixes = null;
      }
      const authorization = req.headers.authorization ?? "";
      requests.push({ method: req.method ?? "", path: req.url ?? "", contentType: req.headers["content-type"] ?? null, prefixes, bearer: /^Bearer [^ ]+$/.test(authorization) });
      if (how === "hang") {
        open.add(res);
        return;
      }
      const status = how === "error" ? 500 : how === "forbidden" ? 403 : 200;
      res.writeHead(status, { "content-type": "application/json" });
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: how === "ok", errors: how === "ok" ? [] : [{ code: 1000, message: "refused by the stand-in" }], messages: [], result: how === "ok" ? { id: "stand-in" } : null }));
    });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
  const { port } = server.address() as AddressInfo;
  return {
    apiBase: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}/client/v4`,
    requests,
    answer(next) {
      how = next;
    },
    async close() {
      for (const res of open) res.destroy();
      server.closeAllConnections();
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  ALERT_KINDS,
  ALERT_KIND_LIST,
  CaseView,
  EDGE_CACHE,
  EDGE_PURGE_CAUSES,
  EDGE_PURGE_OUTCOMES,
  EDGE_RULES,
  EDGE_WORDS,
  EdgePurgeView,
  OrderItemView,
  SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS,
  alertPlaceholders,
  renderAlert,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * 3d Task 3, the edge (design, sections 7.4, 10.1, 10.3 and W.7): the two numbers of a public image's header, the
 * outbox job's numbers, the two closed lists of edge_purges, the purge line's answer on a case and on an order's item,
 * and the alert edge_purge_failed, whose every number is printed from a constant.
 */
describe("the edge's contracts (3d Task 3)", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-19T12:00:00.000Z");
  const IMAGE = "1a2b3c4d-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1";

  test("EDGE_CACHE holds the header's two numbers: a browser's minute and an edge's five minutes", () => {
    expect(EDGE_CACHE).toEqual({ browserSeconds: 60, edgeSeconds: 300 });
  });

  test("EDGE_RULES holds the job's numbers: 30 prefixes a request, a round 15 seconds after the last, 5 seconds a request, a backoff from 30 seconds to an hour, 24 hours, 30 days", () => {
    expect(EDGE_RULES).toEqual({ prefixes: 30, roundSeconds: 15, timeoutMs: 5000, backoffSeconds: 30, backoffMaxSeconds: 3600, giveUpHours: 24, keepDays: 30 });
    // One request a round: at most four a minute, under the provider's documented five.
    expect(Math.floor(60 / EDGE_RULES.roundSeconds)).toBe(4);
  });

  test("the words' two numbers come from the two constants", () => {
    expect(EDGE_WORDS).toEqual({ edgeMinutes: EDGE_CACHE.edgeSeconds / 60, giveUpHours: EDGE_RULES.giveUpHours });
    expect(EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes).toBe(5);
  });

  test("the closed lists of edge_purges: why an image stopped being public, and how its purge ended", () => {
    expect([...EDGE_PURGE_CAUSES]).toEqual(["state", "deleted", "released"]);
    expect([...EDGE_PURGE_OUTCOMES]).toEqual(["accepted", "failed", "off"]);
  });

  test("EdgePurgeView: an image, an outcome of the list or pending, and a time; nothing else", () => {
    for (const outcome of [...EDGE_PURGE_OUTCOMES, "pending"]) {
      expect(EdgePurgeView.safeParse({ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome, at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }).success, outcome).toBe(true);
    }
    expect(EdgePurgeView.safeParse({ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome: "sent", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EdgePurgeView.safeParse({ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome: "off", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z", token: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EdgePurgeView.safeParse({ mediaId: "not-an-id", outcome: "off", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("CaseView and OrderItemView each carry their purges", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(CaseView.shape)).toContain("purges");
    expect(Object.keys(OrderItemView.shape)).toContain("purges");
    expect(CaseView.shape.purges.safeParse([{ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome: "pending", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }]).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OrderItemView.shape.purges.safeParse([{ mediaId: IMAGE, outcome: "accepted", at: "2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z" }]).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("edge_purge_failed: a push and a sentence to every staff account, the job's facts, as W.7 words it with every number from a constant", () => {
    expect(ALERT_KIND_LIST.at(-1)).toBe("edge_purge_failed");
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.edge_purge_failed).toEqual({ priority: 3, scope: "all", legs: ["push", "mail"], mail: "sentence", facts: ["count", "oldestAt"] });
    expect(SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS).toContain("edge_purge_failed");
    expect(alertPlaceholders("edge_purge_failed").sort()).toEqual(["count", "edgeMinutes", "giveUpHours", "oldestAt"]);
    expect(renderAlert("edge_purge_failed", { count: 3, oldestAt: "2026-10-18T08:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "A cached copy could not be dropped",
      sentence: `3 purges at the network provider failed for ${EDGE_RULES.giveUpHours} hours, the first of 2026-10-18 08:05 UTC.`,
      todo: `The measures themselves stand. A copy may have been served for up to ${EDGE_CACHE.edgeSeconds / 60} minutes after each. The operator checks the provider's token and zone.`,
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
/** The text of every element holding a person-written string or an action, kept in `seen`. */
async function texts(): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await userTexts(page);
  for (const text of found) seen.add(text);
  return found;
}

/** Waits for a locator to show, failing with what it looked for. */
async function shown(locator: Locator, timeout = 15_000): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await locator.first().waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`not shown within ${timeout} ms: ${locator.toString()}`);
  }
}

/** A virtual CTAP2 authenticator that verifies its user: a security key on USB, or a platform one whose passkeys sync. */
async function addAuthenticator(kind: "device-bound security key" | "synced platform passkey"): Promise<string> {
  const synced = kind === "synced platform passkey";
  const { authenticatorId } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator", {
    options: {
      protocol: "ctap2",
      transport: synced ? "internal" : "usb",
      hasResidentKey: true,
      hasUserVerification: true,
      isUserVerified: true,
      automaticPresenceSimulation: true,
      // The flags a password manager's passkey reports, and a security key never does.
      defaultBackupEligibility: synced,
      defaultBackupState: synced,
    },
  });
  return authenticatorId;
}

/** How many times an authenticator's keys have signed: the virtual authenticator counts every signature. */
async function signaturesOf(authenticatorId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { credentials } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.getCredentials", { authenticatorId });
  return credentials.reduce((sum, credential) => sum + credential.signCount, 0);
}

/** How many times every staff key of the walk has signed. */
async function signatures(): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const id of staffAuthenticators) sum += await signaturesOf(id);
  return sum;
}

/**

 * of the test runner's is put into the page, and nothing in the page evaluates it under the page's policy.

async function until(expression: string, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries++) {
    if (await page.evaluate(expression)) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));

  throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);

 * moment after the key press that moved the focus.

  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && !check(); tries++) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  if (!check()) throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/** The one image of the page: whether it is there, loaded as a real image of 2 by 2 pixels, from this address, drawn with this class. */

/** The end of every step: no report, error or dialog on any channel, nothing in the page the console never writes, and no request the fixtures refused for the page's fault. */

describe("the staff console in Chromium, under the console site's policy", () => {

  test("an image the API refuses says so in its place, in the console's words, and the case is read again", async () => {

    const [asked, read] = [fixtures.state.imageRequests.length, reads()];
    // The post was frozen between the page's read of the case and the browser's request, as far as the page can tell.
    fixtures.state.refuseNextImage = true;

    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => IMAGE_PATH.test(r.path)).at(-1)!.status).toBe(404);
    // What may be opened may have changed, so the page read the case again, once.
    for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && reads() === read; tries++) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
    expect(reads()).toBe(read + 1);
    // Nothing offers to show the refused image more clearly; its person puts it away, and it is asked for only on a new click.
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show clearly" }).count()).toBe(0);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Hide image" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText("Image 1, not shown"));
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked + 1);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a reveal: nothing to confirm until a reason is chosen and written; the reason saved first, the key confirming its digest; the name in a frame of its own, kept when the case cannot be read again and gone once the dialog is closed; options that bind another item are refused before the key is asked", async () => {

    expect(await why.inputValue()).toBe("");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await why.selectOption("abuse_of_reporting");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await written.fill("   ");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await written.fill("The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // The read of the case that follows the reveal will be refused: the page, and the name it has just shown, must stay.
    fixtures.state.recuseNextCaseRead = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(dialog.getByText("Revealed to you; recorded and shown to every staff member"));

    expect(reason).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, text: "The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour." });
    expect(fixtures.state.reveals).toEqual([{ itemId: ITEM_REPORTER, reasonDigest: reason.digest }]);
    // The name alone in its frame, under the console's own line that says what it is, with its hidden characters to show.
    await shown(dialog.getByText("The reporter's handle:", { exact: true }));
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    await shown(dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Show hidden characters" }));
    // The refused read left the case on the page and says why on the page's error line; the name is still there.

    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}`).at(-1)!.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    // Shown once: with the dialog closed the page holds the name nowhere.

    expect(await page.locator("#root").innerText()).not.toContain("a_reporter");

  test("a decision whose step-up options bind other params is refused before the key is asked; the draft stays, and confirmed again it is recorded without its texts being saved twice", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const sent = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path.endsWith("/decisions")).length;
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome this person may decide on the case; the page opens on a restriction.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.restricted, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    // A restriction needs a measure, its facts and its reason before anything can be confirmed.
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure));
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus: the facts when the reason was begun, the reason now.
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "reason", text: "It sells followers, which the rule names." });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    // Under both fields of a restriction: the rule on personal data, and that the author receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.personalData, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    const preview = composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.done.remove("2026-09-30 12:00 UTC"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`The facts: ${TYPED_FACTS}`);
    expect(await preview.last().textContent()).toMatch(/^You can appeal this decision once, free of charge, within six months of being told, until /);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);

    // The API asks the key to confirm another decision than the one the page built: the key is never asked.
    const [options, posted] = [fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed, sent()];
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("step_up_mismatch") }));
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options + 1);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(1);
    // The confirmation saved nothing more: both texts were on the server before it. What was chosen and written is still there.
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, with options that bind the decision itself: the saved texts are used as they are.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    const [facts, reason] = fixtures.state.texts.slice(-2);
    expect(facts).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions[1]).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_POST,
      // 3e: the case answer says a strike is due, so the key confirmed it with the removal.
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 4, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: facts!.digest, reasonDigest: reason!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The answer is the case as it now stands: closed, with nothing more to decide on it.
    await shown(page.getByText("; closed ", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" }).getByText(COMPOSER.closed));
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" }).count()).toBe(0);
    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

  test("a case that another staff member decided meanwhile: a save that failed is worded under its field and made again by the confirmation, the refusal is worded in place, the case is read again with the draft kept, and confirmed again the decision is recorded without a text saved twice", async () => {

    expect(await texts()).toContain(OTHER_STAFF);

    // The refusal's words stay, the reason's own refusal is gone now that it is saved, and the draft is as its person left it.
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("case_changed") }));
    expect(await composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: NOTE_WORDS.rate_limited }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(REASON);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold_media.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(requests("GET", "")).toHaveLength(read + 1);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, on the version the page now shows: the texts are used as they were saved.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 2);
    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429, 201]);
    expect(requests("POST", "/decisions")).toEqual([409, 201]);
    const mine = fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_CHANGED);
    expect(mine.map((text) => [text.kind, text.text])).toEqual([
      ["facts", TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS],
      ["reason", REASON],
    ]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_CHANGED,
      params: { kind: "interim", stateVersion: 2, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }], factsDigest: mine[0]!.digest, reasonDigest: mine[1]!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 3", { exact: false }));
    expect(await page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" }).getByRole("alert").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a draft's texts come back after a reload: each was saved when its field lost focus, a refused save is worded under its field with the text kept, a saved text is restored with its digest, one answered with other words under its digest is dropped, and the decision names the text saved before the reload", async () => {
    const [before, options] = [await signatures(), fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed];
    const QUOTING = 'The reporter wrote "this account spams one link everywhere".';
    const REASON = "The post repeats one link, which the rule names.";
    const saves = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}/texts`).map((r) => r.status);
    const mine = () => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_DRAFTS);
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "facts", text: TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS });
    // A text that quotes what someone wrote about the case is refused where it was written, and nothing of it is lost.
    fixtures.state.refuseNextSave = "text_quotes_user";
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(QUOTING);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("text_quotes_user") }));
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(QUOTING);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422]);
    expect(mine()).toHaveLength(1);
    // Written again in the person's own words, the refusal's words go, and the text is saved when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await composer.getByRole("alert").waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: "reason", text: REASON });
    // No key was asked for any of it.
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options);
    await clean();

    // A reload before any confirmation: the case's answer brings the saved texts back. This one answers the reason with
    // other words under the digest of what was saved: the page holds each text to its digest, and drops that one.
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = { caseId: CASE_DRAFTS, kind: "reason" };
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const again = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await shown(again);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe("");
    expect(await page.content()).not.toContain(FORGED_DRAFT);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201]);
    await clean();

    // A measure and a reason later the key confirms the decision. The click that confirms takes the focus from the
    // reason's field: that save ends first, the confirmation saves nothing, and the facts are the ones saved before the reload.
    await again.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold.label, { exact: true }).check();
    await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await again.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201, 201]);
    expect(mine().map((text) => text.kind)).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "reason"]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_DRAFTS,
      params: { kind: "interim", stateVersion: 1, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: mine()[0]!.digest, reasonDigest: mine()[2]!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = null;
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a review with the key: the appellant's statement as text on the case, Keep, Reverse in part and Reverse, the reason saved as a review reason, the preview the review's statement, the key confirming exactly that review, and the appeal answered", async () => {
    await page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").nth(1).getByRole("link", { name: "Open the case" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    await shown(page.getByText("not answered yet", { exact: false }));
    // What the appellant wrote is text in a frame of its own.
    expect(await texts()).toContain(HOSTILE.img);
    const before = await signatures();
    const decisionsBefore = fixtures.state.decisions.length;
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel }).click();
    const review = page.getByRole("region", { name: COMPOSER.reviewLabel });
    await shown(review);
    const confirm = review.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // "Keep" is chosen and lifts nothing; nothing is confirmed without a reason.
    expect(await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.kept, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await review.getByLabel("Reason of the review").fill(TYPED_REVIEW_REASON);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // A decision with one measure cannot be reversed in part: whatever is ticked, the answer does not stand.
    await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.partly_reversed, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await review.getByLabel(MEASURES.restore.label).check();
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    // "Reverse" lifts everything that is still in force, and says so by its ticked box.
    await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.reversed, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await review.getByLabel(MEASURES.restore.label).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // The preview is the statement its author will receive: the review's lead, and what was typed as its reason.
    const preview = review.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.reviewed("2026-10-01 09:00 UTC", "reversed"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`Why korbat changed it: ${TYPED_REVIEW_REASON}`);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.reviewed));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    const reason = fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)!;
    expect(reason).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_APPEALED, kind: "review_reason", text: TYPED_REVIEW_REASON });
    // What the key confirmed is the review the page showed: of that decision, answering that appeal, with that reversal
    // and the digest of the saved reason. No decision on the case was sent in its place.
    expect(fixtures.state.reviews).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(fixtures.state.reviews[0]).toMatchObject({
      decisionId: DECISION_APPEALED,
      params: { stateVersion: 3, appealId: APPEAL_ONE, outcome: "reversed", rulesVersion: 2, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }], reasonDigest: reason.digest },
    });
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(decisionsBefore);
    // The case as the answer gave it: the next version, the removal lifted, the appeal answered, and nothing left to review.
    await shown(page.getByText("version 4", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByText("answered: reversed", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByText(`${MEASURES.remove.label}: lifted by the decision of`, { exact: false }));
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_REVIEW_REASON);
    // The appeals screen no longer lists it.
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Appeals" }).click();
    await shown(page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").first());
    expect(await page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").count()).toBe(1);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a post decision signs the strike the case answer says is due: the author's standing in bands above the evidence, the strike line under Restrict, the preview's strike, and the key confirming the removal with its strike", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_STRIKE}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    // The author's standing, in bands, above the evidence, and why it is shown.
    const standing = page.getByRole("region", { name: "The author's standing" });
    await shown(standing);
    for (const words of [STANDING_WORDS.bands.activeStrikes["2"], STANDING_WORDS.bands.suspensionsInYear["1"], STANDING_WORDS.bands.now.none, STANDING_WORDS.postStanding]) await shown(standing.getByText(words, { exact: true }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // While deciding no strike is given; deciding the case under the report's rule gives one, which is no choice.
    await shown(composer.getByText(STANDING_WORDS.strike.none.interim, { exact: true }));
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    await shown(composer.getByText(STANDING_WORDS.strike.due, { exact: true }));
    expect(await composer.getByText(STANDING_WORDS.strike.none.interim, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.strike.label, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(STRIKE_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_STRIKE).length === 2, "both texts saved when their fields lost focus");
    // The preview tells the strike as its author will read it: the third active strike, the band's two and this one.
    const preview = composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    const told = (await preview.allTextContents()).join(" ");
    expect(told).toContain("This decision gives your account a strike.");
    expect(told).toContain("With it your account had 3 active strikes when this was decided.");
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automationStrike);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    // What the key confirmed: the removal and the strike, which the page added because the answer said it was due.
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_STRIKE,
      params: { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }], unfounded: [], replaced: false },
    });
    // The case as the answer gave it: the strike in force with the day it stops counting, and the band one higher.
    await shown(page.getByText(`${MEASURES.strike.label}: in force; counts until`, { exact: false }));
    await shown(standing.getByText(STANDING_WORDS.bands.activeStrikes["3_or_more"], { exact: true }));
    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

  test("3f: at 360 by 740 px, Disable for an order on three of four items with one key: options that bind the fourth are refused before the key is asked; then the key confirms the order's facts and the three items, the check from outside lists each address as text, [clock.partial] and [effect.rest] say what is left, and a moderator may no longer correct the record", async () => {
    // At a phone's width, as every screen of orders is checked (design, section 8.10).
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });
    const order = orderFixture({ reference: "BKA-2026-7", posts: 4 });
    fixtures.state.orders.push(order);
    await page.goto(`${origin}/orders/${order.id}`);
    const block = effectBlock();
    for (const line of [ORDER_WORDS.order.effectWhat, ORDER_WORDS.order.effectPreserve, ORDER_WORDS.order.effectTold, ORDER_WORDS.order.effectAnyone]) await shown(block.getByText(line, { exact: true }));
    // Every item that can be disabled is ticked; the person unticks the fourth.
    await page.locator("li.block").filter({ hasText: ORDER_WORDS.order.item(4) }).getByLabel(ORDER_WORDS.order.effectTick).uncheck();
    const button = block.getByRole("button", { name: ORDER_WORDS.order.effectButton(3) });
    const before = await signatures();
    const options = fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed;
    const writes = fixtures.state.orderWrites.length;
    // The API asks the key to confirm the effect on four items: the key is never asked.
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await button.click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("step_up_mismatch") }));
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options + 1);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(fixtures.state.orderWrites).toHaveLength(writes);
    await cleanOnPhone();
    // Confirmed again, with options that bind the three items: one key for all of them.
    await button.click();
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.orderWrites.length === writes + 1, "the effect");
    const chosen = order.items
      .slice(0, 3)
      .map((item) => ({ itemId: item.id, postId: item.postId! }))
      .sort((a, b) => (a.postId < b.postId ? -1 : a.postId > b.postId ? 1 : 0));
    expect(fixtures.state.orderWrites.at(-1)).toEqual({
      what: "effected",
      id: order.id,
      key: true,
      body: { kind: "tco_removal", memberState: "DE", authority: order.authority, reference: "BKA-2026-7", sectionC: false, emergency: false, withholdFromAuthor: true, urgent: false, items: chosen },
    });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    const at = order.items[0]!.disabledAt!;
    await shown(page.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.order.checkOutside(bothTimes(at), 3)));
    for (const item of order.items.slice(0, 3)) await shown(page.locator("section.block ul.blocks li").filter({ hasText: item.link }).first());
    expect(await page.locator('a[href^="https://korbat.example/"]').count()).toBe(0);
    const deadline = bothTimes(order.clock!.deadlineAt!);
    await shown(page.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.clock.partial(3, 4, bothTimes(at), 1, deadline)));
    await shown(page.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.order.effectRest(1, deadline)));
    await shown(page.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.order.preservedUntil(bothTimes(order.items[0]!.preserveUntil!)), { exact: true }).first());
    await shown(effectBlock().getByRole("button", { name: ORDER_WORDS.order.effectButton(1) }));
    // Once an item is disabled, a correction is an admin's with the key: a moderator is offered Section C's tick alone.
    const correct = page.locator("section.block").filter({ has: page.getByRole("heading", { name: ORDER_WORDS.order.correctTitle }) });
    await shown(correct.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.order.correctSilence));
    expect(await correct.getByLabel(ORDER_WORDS.form.reference).count()).toBe(0);
    await texts();
    await cleanOnPhone();
  });

  test("3f Task 6: at 360 by 740 px, Download since my last copy asks the key, records the copy only once the whole file has arrived, and a download cut short records nothing", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });
    const head = Math.max(...fixtures.state.audit.map((row) => row.seq));
    try {
      await page.goto(`${origin}/audit`);
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.downloadFirst(AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX), { exact: true }));
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.key, { exact: true }));
      const before = await signatures();
      const button = page.getByRole("button", { name: RECOVERY_WORDS.downloadButton });
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.done(1, head, head), { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
      expect(fixtures.state.exports.at(-1)).toEqual({ after: 0, through: head });
      expect(fixtures.state.marks).toEqual([{ through: head, hash: fixtures.state.audit.find((row) => row.seq === head)!.hash }]);
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.download(head, AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX), { exact: true }));
      // Nothing newer: no key is asked.
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.none(head), { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);

  /** The case as the fixtures hold it, with a seal for good of its own, in force or lifted, whose custody is as given. */
  function withSealForGood(view: CaseView, custody: NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["custody"]>, inForce: boolean): CaseView {
    const interim = view.decisions[0]!;
    return {
      ...view,
      decisions: [
        ...view.decisions,
        {
          ...interim,
          id: "a3142536-4758-496a-9bd7-f20314253647",
          kind: "final",
          needsAdmin: true,
          decidedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 3_600_000).toISOString(),
          actions: [{ ...interim.actions[0]!, id: "b4253647-5869-4a7b-8ce8-031425364758", noEffect: null, inForce }],
          custody,
        },
      ],
    };
  }

  const RELEASE_LEAVE = "c5364758-6a7b-4c8d-9e0f-142536475869";
  /** A release block as the API answers it: a seal reported, assessed illegal, moved, with a leave from a court and a hostile reference. */
  function releaseBlock(overrides: Partial<NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["release"]>> = {}): NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["release"]> {
    return {
      reported: true,
      theirReference: HOSTILE.bidi,
      answer: "illegal",
      answeredAt: new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 24 * 3_600_000).toISOString(),
      handedOverAt: null,
      quarantined: true,
      preserved: false,
      leave: { id: RELEASE_LEAVE, from: "court", reference: "4 O 1/26", receivedOn: "2026-10-15", untold: false, untoldUntil: null },
      tellHeld: false,
      postIds: [POST_ID],
      remaining: 0,
      silenceDays: null,
      releasedAt: null,
      basis: null,
      backupsClearAt: null,
      noticeHeld: null,
      releasedPosts: 0,
      releasedImages: 0,
      ...overrides,
    };
  }
  /** The case with a seal for good in force whose decision carries this release block and its custody, all files moved. */
  function withRelease(view: CaseView, release: NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["release"]>): CaseView {
    const sealed = withSealForGood(view, { files: 2, moved: 2, movedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3_600_000).toISOString(), toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 }, true);
    return { ...sealed, decisions: sealed.decisions.map((decided, index) => (index === sealed.decisions.length - 1 ? { ...decided, release } : decided)) };
  }
  const releaseRegion = () => page.getByRole("region", { name: RELEASE_WORDS.title, exact: true });

  test("3d Task 2: at 360 by 740 px, the release block in each state: a leave with the control, an assessment without one, the answers that support nothing, a conflict, more posts than one release names, and the author's telling in its three values", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });
    fixtures.state.role = "admin";
    const view = fixtures.state.cases.get(CASE_FROZEN)!;
    const until = new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 24 * 3_600_000).toISOString();
    const states: [NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["release"]>, string[], boolean][] = [
      [releaseBlock(), [RELEASE_WORDS.leave("from a court"), RELEASE_WORDS.sign(1), `${RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.label}${RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.atOnce}`], true],
      [releaseBlock({ leave: null }), [RELEASE_WORDS.assessed], false],
      [releaseBlock({ leave: null, answer: "not_illegal" }), [RELEASE_WORDS.notIllegal], false],
      [releaseBlock({ leave: null, answer: "no_assessment" }), [RELEASE_WORDS.nothing], false],
      [releaseBlock({ leave: null, answer: null, answeredAt: null }), [RELEASE_WORDS.nothing, RELEASE_WORDS.facts.answer.none], false],
      [releaseBlock({ answer: "not_illegal" }), [RELEASE_WORDS.conflict], true],
      [releaseBlock({ remaining: 7 }), [RELEASE_WORDS.more(RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, 7)], true],
      [releaseBlock({ tellHeld: true, leave: { ...releaseBlock().leave!, untold: true, untoldUntil: until } }), [RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.untold(bothTimes(until))], true],
      [releaseBlock({ tellHeld: true, leave: { ...releaseBlock().leave!, untold: true, untoldUntil: null } }), [RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.untold(null)], true],
      [releaseBlock({ tellHeld: true }), [RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.record], true],
    ];
    try {
      await page.goto(`${origin}/`);
      for (const [block, words, control] of states) {
        fixtures.state.cases.set(CASE_FROZEN, withRelease(view, block));
        await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_FROZEN}`);
        await shown(releaseRegion());
        const text = (await releaseRegion().textContent()) ?? "";
        for (const sentence of words) expect(text, sentence).toContain(sentence);
        expect(text).toContain(RELEASE_WORDS.what);
        expect(text).toContain(RELEASE_WORDS.backups(RETENTION.backupDays));
        expect(text).toContain(RELEASE_WORDS.periodUnset);
        expect(await releaseRegion().getByRole("button", { name: RELEASE_WORDS.button }).count(), words[0]).toBe(control ? 1 : 0);
        // The authority's reference is an outsider's text, in its frame, never in a label's place.
        expect(await releaseRegion().locator(".frame").count()).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        await texts();
        await cleanOnPhone();
      }
    } finally {
      fixtures.state.cases.set(CASE_FROZEN, view);
      fixtures.state.role = "moderator";
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 900 });
    }
  });
```
