});

describe("3f: the staff mails whose words are their push's (W.4)", () => {
  const NOW = "2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z";
  /** A kind's mail as the alert tick sends it: the row's facts as text, and the time it is sent, for the day of its times. */
  const mail = (template: TemplateName, facts: Record<string, string>) => renderTemplate(template as Parameters<typeof renderTemplate>[0], { ...facts, now: NOW });

  test("each is the kind's title after korbat:, then its sentence and its line of what to do from ALERT_TEXTS, and the staff mails' last sentence", () => {
    const cases: [TemplateName, AlertKind, Record<string, string>][] = [
      ["contact_mail", "contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["contact_mail_escalated", "contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_due", "order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "15" }],
      ["mailbox_unreachable", "mailbox_unreachable", { since: "2026-10-15T23:00:00.000Z" }],
      ["alert_channel_down", "alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }],
      // Task 2: an order opened (with a deadline, and without a time of receipt), a record corrected, the daily unverified.
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "2", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", unknown: "0" }],
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "1", unknown: "1" }],
      ["order_corrected", "order_corrected", { count: "2", at: "2026-10-16T08:50:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_unverified", "order_unverified", { count: "1", textsMissing: "1", holdsOpen: "0", oldestAt: "2026-10-15T22:00:00.000Z" }],
    ];
    for (const [template, kind, facts] of cases) {
      const r = mail(template, facts);
      const counted = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? value : Number(value)]));
      const text = renderAlert(kind, counted, new Date(NOW));
      expect(r.subject, template).toBe(`korbat: ${text.title}`);
      expect(paragraphs(r.text), template).toEqual([text.sentence, text.todo, LAST_STAFF]);
      linkless(r);
    }
    expect(paragraphs(mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
    );
    expect(mail("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "0" }).subject).toBe("korbat: 0 minutes left");
  });

  test("3f's review: every kind whose mail is its sentence is one the alert tick mails, and each has its template: Task 5's two daily kinds too", () => {
    expect([...TICK_MAILED_KINDS].sort()).toEqual([...SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS].sort());
    for (const kind of SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "2"]));
      const r = mail(kind as TemplateName, facts);
      expect(r.subject, kind).toBe(`korbat: ${renderAlert(kind, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([n, v]) => [n, isTimeFact(n) ? v : Number(v)])), new Date(NOW)).title}`);
      linkless(r);
    }
  });

  test("they carry counts and UTC times only: a fact of another name, a time that is no time and a missing one are refused, and no handle or address is printed", () => {
    expect(() => mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => mail("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "yesterday" })).toThrow(/since/);
    expect(() => mail("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z", handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/now/);
    for (const template of ["contact_mail", "contact_mail_escalated", "order_due", "mailbox_unreachable", "alert_channel_down", "order_opened", "order_corrected", "order_unverified"] as const) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[template].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "3"]));
      expect(mail(template, facts).text, template).not.toMatch(/@/);
    }
  });
});

    }

    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ withholdFromAuthor: false })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ kind: "dsa_art9", withholdFromAuthor: false })).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("an order to provide information takes no link and does not withhold unless Section C; the other kinds take one to ten", () => {
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ kind: "dsa_art10", links: [], withholdFromAuthor: false })).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ kind: "dsa_art10", links: [], withholdFromAuthor: true })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ kind: "dsa_art10", links: [], sectionC: true, withholdFromAuthor: true })).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ kind: "dsa_art10", withholdFromAuthor: false })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ links: [] })).success).toBe(false);
    const links = Array.from({ length: ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction + 1 }, (_, i) => `https://korbat.example/post/${uuid(10 + i)}`);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ links: links.slice(0, ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction) })).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ links })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ links: [links[0], links[0]] })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ links: ["x".repeat(501)] })).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the state is a member state's code; the authority and the reference are one line of 1 to 200 characters", () => {
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ memberState: "US" })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ memberState: "de" })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ reference: "" })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ reference: "x".repeat(201) })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ authority: "two" + String.fromCharCode(10) + "lines" })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ authority: "over" + String.fromCharCode(0x202e) + "ride" })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderOpenRequest.safeParse(open({ extra: 1 })).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("OrderItemsRequest: one to ten links without repeats", () => {
    expect(OrderItemsRequest.safeParse({ links: ["https://korbat.example/u/someone"] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OrderItemsRequest.safeParse({ links: [] }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the correction (10.2, 10.3)", () => {

describe("OrderEventRecordedParams (10.3)", () => {
  const params = (kind: string, ground: string | null, messageId: string | null) => OrderEventRecordedParams.safeParse({ kind, ground, messageId }).success;

  test("a ground of the kind's list where it has one, and null otherwise", () => {
    for (const ground of ANNEX3_GROUNDS) expect(params("annex3_sent", ground, null), ground).toBe(true);
    expect(params("annex3_sent", null, null)).toBe(false);
    expect(params("annex3_sent", "withdrawn", null)).toBe(false);
    for (const ground of ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS) expect(params("closed_without_effect", ground, null), ground).toBe(true);
    expect(params("closed_without_effect", "force_majeure", null)).toBe(false);
    for (const kind of ["grounds_ceased", "annex2_sent", "receipt_confirmed", "reopened"]) expect(params(kind, "withdrawn", null), kind).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a message for a clarification and an extension, may be for a cease, and none for the rest", () => {
    expect(params("clarification_received", null, uuid(3))).toBe(true);
    expect(params("clarification_received", null, null)).toBe(false);
    expect(params("hold_extended", null, uuid(3))).toBe(true);
    expect(params("hold_extended", null, null)).toBe(false);
    expect(params("grounds_ceased", null, uuid(3))).toBe(true);
    expect(params("grounds_ceased", null, null)).toBe(true);
    for (const kind of ["annex2_sent", "receipt_confirmed", "reopened"]) expect(params(kind, null, uuid(3)), kind).toBe(false);
    // A hashed param takes the one spelling PostgreSQL writes.
    expect(params("clarification_received", null, "abcdef00-0000-4000-8000-000000000003")).toBe(true);
    expect(params("clarification_received", null, "ABCDEF00-0000-4000-8000-000000000003")).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("3f Task 3: giving effect (design, sections 10.1, 10.3 and W.2)", () => {
  const POST_A = "0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";
  const POST_B = "0b000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002";
  const ITEM_A = "1a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";
  const ITEM_B = "1b000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002";
  const params = {
    kind: "tco_removal",
    memberState: "DE",
    authority: "Bundeskriminalamt",
    reference: "2026/123",
    sectionC: false,
    emergency: false,
    withholdFromAuthor: true,
    urgent: false,
    items: [
      { itemId: ITEM_A, postId: POST_A },
      { itemId: ITEM_B, postId: POST_B },
    ],
  };

  test("OrderEffectedParams: strict, the items sorted by post without repeats, at most itemsPerAction; never a held notice's post shown to its author; urgent never on a removal order", () => {
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse(params).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, extra: 1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, items: [...params.items].reverse() }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, items: [params.items[0], params.items[0]] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, items: [] }).success).toBe(false);
    const eleven = Array.from({ length: ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction + 1 }, (_, i) => ({ itemId: `1a000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000${String(i).padStart(2, "0")}`, postId: `0a000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000${String(i).padStart(2, "0")}` }));
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, items: eleven }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, withholdFromAuthor: false }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const kind of ["tco_removal", "dsa_art9"]) expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, kind, sectionC: true, withholdFromAuthor: false }).success, kind).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, kind: "dsa_art9", withholdFromAuthor: false }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, urgent: true }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, kind: "dsa_art9", urgent: true }).success).toBe(true);
    // An order to provide information is never given effect.
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, kind: "dsa_art10" }).success).toBe(false);
    // Upper-case ids are refused: the params are hashed as sent.
    expect(OrderEffectedParams.safeParse({ ...params, items: [{ itemId: ITEM_A.toUpperCase(), postId: POST_A }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a reinstatement after an order is a third action shape of case_decided, alone in a correction that reverses; disable_by_order is in no action entry", () => {
    const correction = {
      kind: "correction",
      stateVersion: 3,
      throughSeq: 0,
      reviewsDecisionId: ITEM_A,
      snapshotId: ITEM_B,
      snapshotDigest: "a".repeat(64),

      ruleId: null,
      rulesVersion: 3,
      redressVersion: 3,
      category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY",
      categoryKeyword: null,
      actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", mediaId: null, orderGround: "withdrawn" }],
      factsDigest: null,
      reasonDigest: "b".repeat(64),
      legalReferenceDigest: null,
      unfounded: [],
      replaced: false,
    };
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse(correction).success).toBe(true);
    for (const ground of ORDER_GROUNDS) expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse({ ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", mediaId: null, orderGround: ground }] }).success, ground).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse({ ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", mediaId: null }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse({ ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", mediaId: null, orderGround: "not_addressed" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse({ ...correction, outcome: "partly_reversed" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse({ ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "disable_by_order", mediaId: null }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse({ ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", mediaId: null, orderGround: "withdrawn" }, { kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("an order decision's category and keyword by its order's kind, and the fixed drafts of a reinstatement (W.2)", () => {
    expect(ORDER_DECISION.tco_removal).toMatchObject({ category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", keyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT", preserves: true });
    expect(ORDER_DECISION.dsa_art9).toMatchObject({ category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE", keyword: null, preserves: false });
    expect(Object.keys(ORDER_DRAFTS.reinstate)).toEqual([...ORDER_GROUNDS]);
    expect(ORDER_DRAFTS.reinstate.wrong_item).toBe("korbat made a mistake: the order did not name this post. korbat disabled it wrongly, and regrets it.");
    expect(MEASURES.disable_by_order).toMatchObject({ interim: false, final: false, lifts: null, target: "post", label: "Disabled for an order" });
    expect(MEASURES.reinstate_by_order).toMatchObject({ lifts: ["disable_by_order"], target: "post", label: "Reinstate after an order" });
  });
});

  test("each kind's facts are the design's names, at most six, each a count or a time", () => {

describe("ALERT_TEXTS (W.4): one text serves both legs, and it carries counts and times only (invariant 15)", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z");
  /** One set of facts for a kind: every count is `n`, every time the given instant. */
  const factsOf = (kind: AlertKind, n: number, time: string, over: Partial<Record<string, number | string | undefined>> = {}): AlertFacts => {
    const facts: Record<string, number | string> = {};
    for (const name of ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts) facts[name] = isTimeFact(name) ? time : n;
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(over)) {
      if (!ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.includes(name)) continue;
      if (value === undefined) delete facts[name];
      else facts[name] = value;
    }
    return facts;
  };
  const DIGITS = /[0-9]/g;
  const all = (kind: AlertKind, facts: AlertFacts) => {
    const r = renderAlert(kind, facts, now);
    return [r.title, r.sentence, r.todo ?? ""].join(" | ");
  };

  test("rendered with two sets of facts, every kind's title, sentence and line differ only in their digits", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {
      // The flags of order_effected and order_opened chose a variant: both sets hold the same flags.
      const flags = { urgent: 0, unknown: 0 };
      const first = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 3, "2026-10-16T07:05:00.000Z", flags));
      const second = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 1234, "2026-10-16T22:49:59.999Z", flags));
      expect(first.replace(DIGITS, ""), kind).toBe(second.replace(DIGITS, ""));
      expect(first, kind).not.toBe(second);
    }
  });

  test("no entry holds an @, a link or a placeholder that is neither a fact of its kind nor a number of ORDER_RULES, QUARANTINE_RULES or EDGE_WORDS", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {
      const text = ALERT_TEXTS[kind];
      const words = [text.title, ...text.sentence.map((part) => part.text), text.todo ?? ""].join(" ");
      expect(words, kind).not.toContain("@");
      expect(words.toLowerCase(), kind).not.toContain("http");
      for (const name of alertPlaceholders(kind)) {
        expect([...ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts, ...Object.keys(ORDER_RULES), ...Object.keys(QUARANTINE_RULES), ...Object.keys(EDGE_WORDS)], `${kind}: {${name}}`).toContain(name);
      }
      // Every number a sentence of 3f prints comes from the facts or from ORDER_RULES: no digit is typed. 3c's burst
      // window is 3c's own number, which its push names as its mail does.
      if (ALERT_KINDS[kind].mail !== "own") expect(words.replace(/[{][a-zA-Z]+[}]/g, ""), kind).not.toMatch(DIGITS);
    }
  });

  test("a time prints as 14:05 UTC, with the day when it is not the day of the alert", () => {
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-16T14:05:59.000Z", now)).toBe("14:05 UTC");
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-15T23:59:00.000Z", now)).toBe("2026-10-15 23:59 UTC");
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z", now)).toBe("2026-10-17 00:00 UTC");
  });

  test("the words of the kinds Task 1 sends, as W.4 has them", () => {
    const mail = renderAlert("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now);
    expect(mail).toEqual({
      title: "Mail at the contact point",
      sentence: "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
      todo: `Read it in the mail host's app, never in korbat, and with it every other new message there: further mail within ${ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes} minutes raises no alarm of its own. Then open Contact point in the staff console. What ends this message's alarms is handling it there: opening an order from it, or closing it.`,
    });
    // A restart of an order's clock has no time of receipt.
    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe("A removal order's hour has started again: due 09:05 UTC.");
    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Nobody has answered: mail at the contact point",
      sentence: "Nobody has answered the mail that arrived at the authorities' contact point at 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
      todo: "This went to every staff phone. Whoever reads it first acts, and tells the others.",
    });
    const due = renderAlert("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: 15 }, now);
    expect(due.title).toBe("15 minutes left");
    expect(due.sentence).toBe("A removal order, or mail that may be one, is due 09:05 UTC: 15 minutes are left and it is not carried out in full.");
    expect(due.todo).toBe(
      "Give effect now, to every post the order names. Only if the order has a manifest error, or lacks what you need to find the content, send Annex III and record it: that is no way to stop this alarm. If nobody can act in time: the README, When nobody can act within the hour.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "2026-10-15T23:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "The contact point cannot be read",
      sentence: "korbat has not been able to read the contact-point mailbox since 2026-10-15 23:00 UTC.",
      todo: `Mail that arrives there raises no alert now. Check the mailbox in the mail host's app until this is repaired; an order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed". The operator checks the password and the mail host.`,
    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Phone alerts are down",
      sentence: "Phone alerts are down since 08:57 UTC: korbat's watcher or its push server does not answer.",
      todo: `Until it is repaired, korbat wakes nobody: the mail host's own app on the on-call phone, signed in to the contact-point mailbox and allowed to ring at night, is the only thing that does. Check now that it is. An order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed". The operator restarts the notify and ntfy services.`,
    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({ title: "Daily test", sentence: "Daily test, 08:00 UTC. If you read this on your phone, alerts reach it. Nothing to do.", todo: null });
  });

  test("the pushes of 3c's and 3e's kinds name nobody", () => {
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_urgent", { count: 2, oldestAt: "2026-10-16T08:30:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({ title: "Urgent lane", sentence: "2 cases wait in the urgent lane, the oldest since 08:30 UTC.", todo: null });
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: 4 }, now).sentence).toBe("4 cases or replies are waiting longer than their response time.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_burst", { count: 20 }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account confirmed 20 decisions in 15 minutes. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_reads", { limit: 200 }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account opened 200 different cases today. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_reveal", { at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account revealed who sent a report, at 08:59 UTC. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_csam_lifted", { at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Reported images are no longer protected",
      sentence: "A decision at 08:59 UTC ended the protection of reported images. Read the staff mail.",
      todo: null,
    });
  });

  test("the variants a fact chooses: an order given effect as urgent, with items still open; the counts of what an order misses", () => {
    expect(renderAlert("order_effected", { items: 3, at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", itemsOpen: 0, urgent: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was given effect at 08:59 UTC: 3 posts disabled.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_effected", { items: 2, at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", itemsOpen: 1, urgent: 1 }, now).sentence).toBe(
      "An order that is not verified was given effect as urgent at 08:59 UTC: 2 posts disabled. 1 items of the order are still open.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 2, dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:30:00.000Z", unknown: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 2 items. Due 09:30 UTC.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 1, unknown: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 1 items. No deadline runs.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 1, unknown: 1 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 1 items. Its deadline is unknown: act now.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_unverified", { count: 1, textsMissing: 0, holdsOpen: 2, oldestAt: "2026-10-14T08:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(
      "1 orders are given effect and not verified, or hold a post added after their check, the oldest since 2026-10-14 08:00 UTC. 2 hold a notice with no end recorded.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("hold_ending", { count: 2, at: "2026-10-20T00:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(`2 held notices are released within ${ORDER_RULES.holdWarningDays} days, the first on 2026-10-20 00:00 UTC.`);
    expect(renderAlert("report_owed", { count: 1, oldestAt: "2026-10-14T08:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(
      `1 reports to the authorities have been owed for more than ${ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours} hours, the oldest since 2026-10-14 08:00 UTC.`,
    );
  });

  test("a fact that is missing, of another kind, or a string that is no time is refused", () => {
    expect(() => renderAlert("contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: 1, handle: 7 }, now)).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("alert_test", { at: "mod_anna" }, now)).toThrow(/at/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: "4" }, now)).toThrow(/count/);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";

 * saved text must be, and the shapes the queue, the case and the home screen are parsed with.

const HEX = "ab".repeat(32);
const TIME = "2026-10-04T08:15:30.123Z";
/** The seven members of 3e on a ledger row of 3c, where each is null. */
const NO_STANDING_COLUMNS = { days: null, announced: null, basis: null, restsOn: null, earliestStart: null, countsUntil: null, period: null, restedOnBy: null, reply: null } as const;

describe("FindingRequest", () => {
  const finding = { target: { kind: "post", id: POST }, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" };

  test("a moderator's finding cites a korbat rule, R2 among them, about a post, an account or a korbat link", () => {
    for (const ruleId of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId }).success, ruleId).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.parse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).target).toEqual({ kind: "account", handle: "some_one" });
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "link", url: "https://korbat.example/post/" + POST } }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("it has no other ground than a rule: a finding never alleges illegality and never goes the path that records no sender", () => {
    for (const ground of ["illegal", "csam", "order", "law", ""]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ground }).success, ground).toBe(false);
    const { ground: _ground, ...withoutGround } = finding;
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse(withoutGround).success).toBe(false);
    // The members of the other grounds are refused, never ignored.
    for (const extra of [{ explanation: "words" }, { bonaFide: true }, { citedLaw: "a law" }, { keyword: "csam" }, { name: "A" }, { email: "a@b.example" }, { turnstileToken: "t" }]) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ...extra }).success, Object.keys(extra)[0]).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: "R7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its category is one of the Transparency Database's, but not the one that says a notifier was not sure", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success, category).toBe(category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE");
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the categories a finding may carry are exported as a list, in the Transparency Database's order, for the console's form: exactly those the request takes", () => {

    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toHaveLength(TDB_CATEGORIES.length - 1);
    expect(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success)).toEqual(FINDING_CATEGORIES);
  });

});

describe("a saved text", () => {
  const save = { kind: "note", text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion", salt: HEX, digest: HEX };

  test("is of one of the seven kinds, the recorded choice not to seal among them, with a 32-byte salt and a digest in lower-case hex", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_KINDS).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason", "reveal_reason", "note", "seal_declined"]);
    for (const kind of STAFF_TEXT_KINDS) expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind: "statement" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [HEX.toUpperCase(), HEX.slice(2), `${HEX}00`, "", "g".repeat(64)]) {
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, salt: bad }).success, `salt ${bad}`).toBe(false);
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, digest: bad }).success, `digest ${bad}`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, caseId: CASE }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the request's schema lets any text through: what a text must be is the route's to refuse, with a code of its own", () => {
    // A text that is too long or holds a control character is answered text_invalid, not invalid_request.
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: "x".repeat(STAFF_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: `a${String.fromCharCode(7)}b` }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("staffTextProblem: a well-formed text of at most 5000 UTF-16 units, with no control character but the line feed and no invisible direction or zero-width character", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_MAX).toBe(5000);
    const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
    expect(staffTextProblem(`two${LF}lines`)).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("")).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5000))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5001))).toBe("too_long");
    // An emoji is two units: 2500 of them fit, and one more unit does not.
    const emoji = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(staffTextProblem(emoji.repeat(2500))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`${emoji.repeat(2500)}x`)).toBe("too_long");
    // Half of a surrogate pair has no UTF-8 bytes.
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xd83d)}b`)).toBe("malformed");
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xde00)}`)).toBe("malformed");
    // NUL and every other C0 control but the line feed.
    for (let code = 0; code < 32; code++) {
      expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe(code === 10 ? null : "control");
    }
    // The invisible direction and spacing characters the notice texts refuse too; the joiners scripts and emoji need stay.
    for (const code of [0x202a, 0x202e, 0x2066, 0x2069, 0x200b, 0x2060, 0xfeff]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe("format");
    for (const code of [0x200c, 0x200d]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`r${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}sum${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the answers: the stored text's id and digest, the person's own drafts with their salts, and a snapshot's id and digest, never content", () => {
    expect(StaffTextSaved.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX })).toEqual({ id: CASE, digest: HEX });
    const draft = { id: CASE, kind: "facts", text: "The post names a home address.", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME };
    expect(StaffTextsResponse.parse({ texts: [draft] }).texts).toEqual([draft]);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffSnapshotTaken.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX, body: "content", media: [] }))).toEqual(["id", "digest"]);
  });
});

  const reporter = { kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", accountAge: "1_to_12_months", itemsFiled: "2_to_9", actedOn: "under_half", answeredUnseen: "none", named: null, contactGiven: null, confirmed: null, suppressed: null, contactLost: false };

    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse(reporter).success).toBe(true);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind: "notifier", label: SOURCE_LABELS.notifier, accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: false }).success).toBe(true);
    for (const kind of ["anonymous", "staff", "unlinked"] as const) {
      expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind, label: SOURCE_LABELS[kind], accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    }
    // Bands only: an exact count is no value of any of them.
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, itemsFiled: "7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, actedOn: "0.4" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, answeredUnseen: "3" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, accountAge: "3_days" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its label is one of the console's own: a reporter's letter or the fixed words of its kind, never a text an answer could choose", () => {
    expect(reporterLabel(0)).toBe("Reporter A");
    expect(reporterLabel(1)).toBe("Reporter B");
    expect(reporterLabel(25)).toBe("Reporter Z");
    expect(reporterLabel(26)).toBe("Reporter AA");
    expect(reporterLabel(27)).toBe("Reporter AB");
    expect(reporterLabel(26 + 26 * 26)).toBe("Reporter AAA");
    for (const label of ["korbat: verified notice from police", "Reporter a", "Reporter", "Reporter A ", "<b>Reporter A</b>", SOURCE_LABELS.staff]) {
      expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, label }).success, label).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind: "staff", label: "Reporter A" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

      basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME, terrorist: null, protective: TIME },
      // 3e Task 5: the account's record of reporting, in reports.
      reporting: { reports: 0, unfounded: 0, warnedOn: null, warnedAt: null, marksSince: null, mayWarn: false, mayRestrict: false, restrictedUntil: null, marked: [] },
    };
    const account = { ...view, target: { type: "account", id: POST, handle: "now_named", displayName: "A name", bio: "A bio", deleted: false }, suspicion: null, snapshots: [], items: [], decisions: [], strikeDue: null, authorStanding: null, standing };

    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, maxDays: 31 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, atOnce: ["ladder"] } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
    // A decision says which standing measures rest on it, when any does; older answers carry no such member.
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) {
      expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }]);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "spam" }] }] }).success).toBe(false);

      const { [member]: _gone, ...without } = item;
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [without] }).success, member).toBe(false);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, [member]: null }] }).success, member).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, markable: true, unfounded: true }] }).items[0]).toMatchObject({ markable: true, unfounded: true, markWithdrawn: false });
    const reporting = {
      reports: 8,
      unfounded: 5,
      warnedOn: "2026-09-01",
      warnedAt: TIME,
      marksSince: 2,
      mayWarn: false,
      mayRestrict: false,
      restrictedUntil: null,
      marked: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGHIJ", position: 2, sentOn: "2026-08-30", markedOn: "2026-08-31", sinceWarning: false }],
    };
    const parsed = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting.parse(reporting);
    expect(parsed).toEqual(reporting);
    const Reporting = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting;
    // A marked report is named by its reference and the item's place in it, never by who sent it.
    expect(Object.keys(Reporting.shape.marked.element.shape).sort()).toEqual(["markedOn", "position", "ref", "sentOn", "sinceWarning"]);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, marked: [{ ...reporting.marked[0], ref: "someone" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, unfounded: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, restrictedUntil: "2026-10-01" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A restriction of reporting rests on its warning: the warning's decision says so, for [review.warning].
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }]);
  });

  test("a withheld snapshot carries its id, time and digest and no content, whatever the answer held", () => {
    const withheld = CaseSnapshot.parse({ ...shown, withheld: true });
    expect(Object.keys(withheld).sort()).toEqual(["digest", "id", "takenAt", "withheld"]);

  test("a snapshot that is shown carries everything its digest covers: the console recomputes the digest from the answer", async () => {
    const parsed = CaseSnapshot.parse(shown);
    if (parsed.withheld) throw new Error("the snapshot is shown");
    const expected = await snapshotDigest({ ...shown, targetType: "post", postState: "visible" });
    expect(await snapshotDigest(parsed)).toBe(expected);
    const { salt: _salt, ...withoutSalt } = shown;
    expect(CaseSnapshot.safeParse(withoutSalt).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a seal's list holds at most the 500 rows the case answer carries", () => {
    const row = { postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 };
    const withList = (rows: number) => ({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!, actions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!, sealed: { posts: rows, images: rows, deletedPosts: 0, list: Array.from({ length: rows }, () => row) } }] }] });
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(500)).success).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(501)).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("suspicion holds counts and days only", () => {
    const bad = { ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: TIME, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } } };
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(bad).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, reach: { ...view.suspicion.reach, newestPostOn: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

    for (const cursor of ["", "a b", "a/b", "a=b", "x".repeat(401)]) expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor }).success, cursor).toBe(false);
  });

      deferUnproven: false,
      protectionLifted: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, kind: "dismissed" }] },
      sealsDeclined: { total: 0, items: [] },
      interimSeals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, posts: 2, images: 5 }] },
      repliesWaiting: { count: 2, oldestAt: TIME },
      strikeAccounts: 1,
      // 3f: the contact point and the alert channel.
      contact: { open: 2, oldestAt: TIME, dueAt: TIME },
      alerts: { channel: "down", since: TIME },
      ordersUnverified: { total: 1, items: [{ orderId: POST, effectAt: TIME }] },
      // 3f Task 5: a report owed for a case, from reports_owed(): a case, a kind and a time.
      reportsOwed: { total: 1, items: [{ caseId: CASE, kind: "sealed_images" as const, since: TIME }] },
      // 3f Task 6: the newest copy mark and whether the copy is overdue; the open gaps after a restore, the measures among
      // them, and when the newest import ran.
      copy: { newestAt: TIME, overdue: true },
      restore: { open: 3, measures: 2, importedAt: TIME },

    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(overview).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, copy: { newestAt: null } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, restore: { open: -1, measures: 0, importedAt: null } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, reportsOwed: { total: 1, items: [{ caseId: CASE, kind: "an authority", since: TIME }] } }).success).toBe(false);
    // Each of the three lists holds at most as many rows as the reveals' list does.
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, interimSeals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.interimSeals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, lanes: overview.lanes.slice(0, 2) }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, reveals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.reveals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, releaseOverdue: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("erasureOverdue is one count for each due rule of retention: all eight, each a whole number from 0", () => {
    const counts = { caseEvidence: 2, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 1, redactions: 0, images: 60, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 3 };
    expect(ErasureOverdue.parse(counts)).toEqual(counts);
    expect(Object.keys(ErasureOverdue.shape).sort()).toEqual(["accessLog", "caseEvidence", "contacts", "drafts", "images", "intakeRecords", "redactions", "statements"]);
    for (const key of Object.keys(counts)) {
      const { [key]: _left, ...missing } = counts as Record<string, number>;
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse(missing).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: -1 }).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: 1.5 }).success, key).toBe(false);
    }
    // The overview carries it: an answer without it is refused, so a console never reads "nothing is late" from a missing member.
    const parsed = StaffOverview.safeParse({ lanes: [], erasureOverdue: counts });
    expect(parsed.success).toBe(false);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffOverview.shape)).toContain("erasureOverdue");
  });
});

import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { is, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import { PgDialect, PgTable, getTableConfig, pgTable } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { apiRole, authRole, bytea, notifyRole, xid8 } from "../src/schema/helpers";
import * as schema from "../src/schema/index";

const tables = Object.values(schema).filter((v) => is(v, PgTable)) as PgTable[];
const byName = new Map(tables.map((t) => [getTableConfig(t).name, getTableConfig(t)]));

describe("auth schema", () => {
  test("auth tables live in the auth schema", () => {
    for (const name of ["users", "devices", "sessions", "email_codes", "passkeys", "auth_events"]) {
      expect(byName.get(name)?.schema, name).toBe("auth");
    }
  });
  test("sessions store only a hash id and carry both expiries", () => {
    const cols = byName.get("sessions")!.columns.map((c) => c.name);
    expect(cols).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["id", "user_id", "device_id", "expires_at", "absolute_expires_at", "reauth_at", "revoked_at"]));
  });
});

describe("row level security", () => {
  test("every table has RLS enabled and at least one policy", () => {
    expect(tables.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const t of tables) {
      const cfg = getTableConfig(t);
      expect(cfg.enableRLS, cfg.name).toBe(true);
      expect(cfg.policies.length, cfg.name).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });
});

describe("content schema", () => {
  test("posts carry a state enum and a body length check", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("posts")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    expect(cfg.columns.find((c) => c.name === "state")?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.checks.map((c) => c.name)).toContain("posts_body_len");
  });
  test("join tables have composite primary keys", () => {
    for (const name of ["follows", "likes", "reposts", "bookmarks", "blocks", "mutes"]) {
      expect(byName.get(name)!.primaryKeys.length, name).toBe(1);
      expect(byName.get(name)!.primaryKeys[0]!.columns.length, name).toBe(2);
    }
  });
});

describe("trust and safety schema", () => {
  test("there are 61 tables in total", () => {
    // 28 before 3c, minus the five retired tables, plus the twelve moderation tables and the four auth tables; then 3e's
    // three: suspension_replies, unfounded_marks and report_tallies; then 3f's first four: contact_messages, alert_outbox,
    // notify_state and notify_folders; then the three of order records: legal_orders, legal_order_items and
    // legal_order_events; then the four of the records to authorities: authority_notifications,
    // authority_notification_events, productions and auth.report_holds; then the two of recovery: restore_gaps and
    // copy_marks; then 3d's first, quarantine_files; then the release's four (Task 2): release_leaves, releases,
    // release_posts and release_notices; then the edge's outbox (Task 3), edge_purges.
    expect(tables.length).toBe(61);
  });
  test("3d's edge_purges (section 6.3): one row an image that stopped being public, its cause and its outcome under closed lists, both ends or neither, the job's index and the newest row's", () => {
    const purges = byName.get("edge_purges")!;
    const checkSql = (_table: string, name: string) => new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(purges.checks.find((c) => c.name === name)!.value).sql;
    expect(purges.schema ?? "public").toBe("public");
    expect(purges.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull])).toEqual([
      ["id", "bigint", true],
      ["media_id", "uuid", true],
      ["cause", "text", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["next_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["attempts", "smallint", true],
      ["outcome", "text", false],
      ["done_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
    ]);
    expect(purges.columns.find((c) => c.name === "id")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(purges.columns.find((c) => c.name === "id")?.generatedIdentity?.type).toBe("always");
    expect(purges.columns.find((c) => c.name === "attempts")?.default).toBe(0);
    // No foreign key: an image's row may be gone, by a deletion or the disposal, while its purge is still owed.
    expect(purges.foreignKeys).toEqual([]);
    expect(purges.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(["edge_purges_attempts", "edge_purges_cause", "edge_purges_done", "edge_purges_outcome"]);
    expect(checkSql("edge_purges", "edge_purges_cause")).toBe(`"edge_purges"."cause" in ('state', 'deleted', 'released')`);
    expect(checkSql("edge_purges", "edge_purges_outcome")).toBe(`"edge_purges"."outcome" in ('accepted', 'failed', 'off')`);
    expect(checkSql("edge_purges", "edge_purges_done")).toBe(`("edge_purges"."outcome" is null) = ("edge_purges"."done_at" is null)`);
    expect(purges.indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name: string }).name)]).sort()).toEqual([
      ["edge_purges_due_idx", ["next_at"]],
      ["edge_purges_media_idx", ["media_id", "id"]],
    ]);
    expect(purges.enableRLS).toBe(true);
    expect(purges.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to])).toEqual([["edge_purges_api_all", "all", apiRole]]);
  });
  test("3d's release (section 6.2): the leave, the release with its notice's state, its mark keyed on the post, and the day's notice; the API's role is granted nothing on the leave", () => {
    const leaves = byName.get("release_leaves")!;
    expect(leaves.columns.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(
      ["id", "notification_id", "leave_from", "reference", "received_on", "untold", "untold_until", "recorded_at", "recorded_by", "withdrawn_at", "withdrawn_by"].sort(),
    );
    expect(leaves.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(["release_leaves_from", "release_leaves_reference", "release_leaves_texts", "release_leaves_untold", "release_leaves_withdrawn"]);
    expect(leaves.foreignKeys).toEqual([]);
    expect(leaves.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to])).toEqual([["release_leaves_api_none", "select", apiRole]]);
    const releases = byName.get("releases")!;
    expect(releases.columns.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(
      [
        "id",
        "seal_action_id",
        "upload_refusal_id",
        "post_ids",
        "basis",
        "leave_id",
        "their_reference",
        "released_by",
        "released_at",
        "replay_of",
        "backups_clear_at",
        "author_notice",
        "author_notice_at",
        "imported_at",
      ].sort(),
    );
    expect(releases.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(["releases_basis", "releases_leave", "releases_notice", "releases_reference", "releases_replay"]);
    // The admin who released is a profile; no foreign key names a seal, a leave or a refusal: a replay may come first.
    expect(releases.foreignKeys.map((fk) => fk.reference().foreignTable[Symbol.for("drizzle:Name") as never])).toEqual(["profiles"]);
    const marks = byName.get("release_posts")!;
    expect(marks.primaryKeys.length + marks.columns.filter((c) => c.primary).length).toBe(1);
    expect(marks.columns.find((c) => c.primary)?.name).toBe("post_id");
    expect(marks.foreignKeys.map((fk) => fk.reference().foreignTable[Symbol.for("drizzle:Name") as never])).toEqual(["releases"]);
    const notices = byName.get("release_notices")!;
    expect(notices.columns.find((c) => c.primary)?.name).toBe("subject_id");
    for (const table of [leaves, releases, marks, notices]) expect(table.enableRLS, table.name).toBe(true);
  });
  test("3d's quarantine_files: a file's row keyed by its image and its name, with its three ends and no right for the API (section 6.1)", () => {
    const files = byName.get("quarantine_files")!;
    expect(files.schema ?? "public").toBe("public");
    expect(files.columns.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(
      ["media_id", "file", "post_id", "size", "sha256", "moved_at", "returned_at", "destroyed_at", "release_id", "lost_at", "lost_told", "imported_at", "unknown"].sort(),
    );
    expect(files.primaryKeys.map((k) => [k.getName(), k.columns.map((c) => c.name)])).toEqual([["quarantine_files_pkey", ["media_id", "file"]]]);
    expect(files.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(["quarantine_files_digest", "quarantine_files_ends", "quarantine_files_file", "quarantine_files_release", "quarantine_files_told"]);
    // Task 2: a destroyed file names the release it was destroyed for.
    expect(files.foreignKeys.map((fk) => fk.reference().foreignTable[Symbol.for("drizzle:Name") as never])).toEqual(["releases"]);
    expect(files.indexes.map((i) => i.config.name).sort()).toEqual(["quarantine_files_post_idx", "quarantine_files_untold_idx"]);
    expect(files.enableRLS).toBe(true);
    expect(files.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to])).toEqual([["quarantine_files_api_none", "select", apiRole]]);
  });
  test("3f's recovery tables: a gap's class and disposition, its closing and the copy marks (section 6.6)", () => {
    const gaps = byName.get("restore_gaps")!;
    expect(gaps.schema ?? "public").toBe("public");
    expect(gaps.columns.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(
      ["id", "import_id", "place", "hash", "action", "target_type", "target_id", "metadata", "acted_at", "imported_at", "class", "closed_at", "closed_by", "disposition"].sort(),
    );
    expect(gaps.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(["restore_gaps_class", "restore_gaps_closed", "restore_gaps_disposition", "restore_gaps_hash", "restore_gaps_place"]);
    expect(gaps.uniqueConstraints.map((u) => u.name)).toEqual(["restore_gaps_place_key"]);
    expect(gaps.indexes.map((i) => i.config.name)).toEqual(["restore_gaps_open_idx"]);
    expect(gaps.enableRLS).toBe(true);
    const marks = byName.get("copy_marks")!;
    expect(marks.columns.map((c) => c.name).sort()).toEqual(["at", "id", "place", "staff_id"]);
    expect(marks.checks.map((c) => c.name)).toEqual(["copy_marks_place"]);
    expect(marks.enableRLS).toBe(true);
  });
  test("the tables 3c retired are gone, with their enums and the reputation column", () => {
    for (const name of ["reports", "strikes", "transparency_log"]) expect(byName.has(name), name).toBe(false);
    for (const name of ["targetType", "reportStatus", "caseAction", "appealStatus", "reports", "strikes", "transparencyLog"]) {
      expect(Object.keys(schema), name).not.toContain(name);
    }
    expect(byName.get("profiles")!.columns.map((c) => c.name)).not.toContain("reputation");
  });
  test("audit_log policies allow only insert and select", () => {
    const kinds = byName.get("audit_log")!.policies.map((p) => p.for).sort();
    expect(kinds).toEqual(["insert", "select"]);
  });
});

    expect(cfg.columns.find((c) => c.name === "retired_at")?.notNull).toBe(false);

    expect(cfg.columns.find((c) => c.name === "profile_id")?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.columns.find((c) => c.name === "changed_at")?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.columns.find((c) => c.name === "changed_at")?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    const fk = cfg.foreignKeys.map((k) => ({ table: getTableConfig(k.reference().foreignTable).name, columns: k.reference().foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }));
    expect(fk).toEqual([{ table: "profiles", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" }]);

    expect(handleChangedAt).toBeDefined();
    expect(handleChangedAt?.notNull).toBe(false);

    expect(purgedAt?.notNull).toBe(false);

  test("one phone per account: a unique index on phone_hash that leaves out the accounts without one", () => {

    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["phone_hash"]);
    expect(idx?.config.where).toBeDefined();

  test("email codes can be for deleting the account, and every account event of 1b has a type", () => {

    expect(values.slice(values.indexOf("not_me"), values.indexOf("account_deleted") + 1)).toEqual([
      "not_me",
      "profile_updated",
      "handle_changed",
      "email_changed",
      "badge_verified",
      "badge_removed",
      "export_created",
      "account_deleted",
    ]);
