```tsx
import {
  ANNEX3_GROUNDS,
  ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS,
  EU_MEMBER_STATES,
  HOLD_END_REASON_LABELS,
  ORDER_CHANNELS,
  ORDER_CHANNEL_LABELS,
  ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS,
  ORDER_CORRECTION_RULE_WORDS,
  ORDER_EVENT_WORDS,
  ORDER_GROUND_LABELS,
  ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS,
  ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASON_LABELS,
  ORDER_KINDS,
  ORDER_KIND_LABELS,
  ORDER_RULES,
  SCRUTINY_OUTCOME_LABELS,
  STATE_FACTS,
  type ContactMessage,
  type MemberState,
  type OrderConsoleEvent,
  type OrderCorrectFacts,
  type OrderEffectedParams,
  type OrderEventRecordedParams,
  type OrderItemCloseReason,
  type OrderItemView,
  type OrderView,
  type StaffMe,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS, describeError, ORDER_WORDS, RECOVERY_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId, type OrderId } from "../router";
import { correctOrderWithKey, effectOrderWithKey, recordOrderEventWithKey } from "../step-up";
import { bothTimes, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "../webauthn";
import { clockLine, OrderFacts } from "./Orders";

/**
 * An order (3f design, section 8.5), in Task 2's blocks: 1 the clock, refreshed every 20 seconds; 2 the check; 3 the
 * items, with "Close this item without effect" and "Add links"; 5 what was sent and received, each confirmed by the key;
 * 6 the forms' values as text; 7 what the command line owes; 8 the author's notice; 9 the events; 10 "Correct what the
 * order shows". Task 3 adds block 4 ("Disable for an order", the items' ticks and the check from outside), "Extension
 * received" in block 5, an item's preservation, reinstatement and case, and [hold.warn]. The authority, the reference and
 * each link are an outsider's words and drawn as such; no image and no text of a post that is not public is shown.
 */

const W = ORDER_WORDS.order;

/** Block 2: the check, worded by the order's kind, with the home state's register entries. */
export function CheckBlock({ order, me }: { order: OrderView; me: Pick<StaffMe, "homeState"> }) {
  const facts = me.homeState === null ? undefined : STATE_FACTS[me.homeState as MemberState];
  const state = EU_MEMBER_STATES[order.memberState];
  if (order.kind !== "tco_removal") {
    return (
      <section className="block">
        <p>{W.registerDsa}</p>
        {!order.verified ? <p className="notice">{W.verifyFirst}</p> : null}
      </section>
    );
  }
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <p>
        {W.register(state).before}
        <UserText>{order.authority}</UserText>
        {W.register(state).after}
      </p>
      <p className="notice">{W.doubt}</p>
      {facts !== undefined ? (
        <ul className="blocks">
          {facts.authorities.map((authority) => (
            <li key={authority.id}>{W.entry(authority.name, authority.registerEntry ?? W.stateUnknown)}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}

/** What an item resolved to and what became of it (block 3). */
function ItemFacts({ item }: { item: OrderItemView }) {
  return (
    <>
      {item.post !== null ? (
        <p>
          {W.resolved(bothTimes(item.post.createdAt), item.post.images).before}
          <UserText>{item.post.authorHandle ?? ""}</UserText>
          {W.resolved(bothTimes(item.post.createdAt), item.post.images).after}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {item.post !== null && item.post.preview !== null ? (
        <figure className="frame">
          <p>
            <UserText>{item.post.preview}</UserText>
          </p>
        </figure>
      ) : null}
      {item.linkKind === "image" ? <p className="hint">{W.image}</p> : null}
      {item.linkKind === "account" ? <p className="notice">{W.account}</p> : null}
      {item.linkKind === "other" ? <p className="notice">{W.missing}</p> : null}
      {item.post?.deletedOn ? <p>{W.deleted(item.post.deletedOn)}</p> : null}
      <p>
        {item.closedAt !== null && item.closedReason !== null
          ? W.closedItem(bothTimes(item.closedAt), ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASON_LABELS[item.closedReason])
          : item.disabledAt !== null
            ? W.disabledAt(bothTimes(item.disabledAt))
            : W.notDisabled}
      </p>
      {item.inForce && item.noEffect !== null ? <p className="hint">{item.noEffect === "already" ? W.alreadyNow : W.deletedNow}</p> : null}
      {/* 3d Task 3 (section 8.4): the same purge line as on a case, for each image of a disabled item that left the public. */}
      {item.disabledAt !== null && item.purges.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="purges">
          {item.purges.map((purge) => (
            <li key={purge.mediaId} className={purge.outcome === "failed" ? "notice" : "hint"}>
              {AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge(purge.outcome, bothTimes(purge.at))}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
      {item.inForce && item.preserveUntil !== null && item.preserveEndedAt === null ? <p>{W.preservedUntil(bothTimes(item.preserveUntil))}</p> : null}
      {/* Task 4: the preservation's end erased the post's content; its UTC day, which the notice names too. */}
      {item.erasedAt !== null ? <p>{W.erased(item.erasedAt.slice(0, 10))}</p> : null}
      {item.reinstatedAt !== null && !item.inForce ? (
        <p>{W.reinstatedAt(bothTimes(item.reinstatedAt), item.reinstatedGround === null ? "" : (GROUND_WORDS[item.reinstatedGround] ?? item.reinstatedGround))}</p>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/** Task 3: the items "Disable for an order" can take now, in their order: a post, not in force, not closed, on an open order. */
export function effectable(order: OrderView): OrderItemView[] {
  if (order.closedAt !== null || order.kind === "dsa_art10") return [];
  return order.items.filter((item) => item.postId !== null && !item.inForce && item.closedAt === null);
}

/** Whether an item is ticked: as the person set it, or by default the first itemsPerAction of those that can be disabled. */
export function isTicked(order: OrderView, ticks: Readonly<Record<string, boolean>>, itemId: string): boolean {
  const index = effectable(order).findIndex((item) => item.id === itemId);
  if (index < 0) return false;
  return ticks[itemId] ?? index < ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction;
}

/**
 * The params of order_effected (10.3) from the order as shown and the ticked items: each item's id and post, sorted by
 * post, the order's facts as the page read them, and `urgent` as ticked.
 */
export function effectParamsOf(order: OrderView, itemIds: readonly string[], urgent: boolean): OrderEffectedParams {
  const items = order.items
    .filter((item) => itemIds.includes(item.id) && item.postId !== null)
    .map((item) => ({ itemId: item.id, postId: item.postId as string }))
    .sort((a, b) => (a.postId < b.postId ? -1 : a.postId > b.postId ? 1 : 0));
  return {
    kind: order.kind === "dsa_art9" ? "dsa_art9" : "tco_removal",
    memberState: order.memberState,
    authority: order.authority,
    reference: order.reference,
    sectionC: order.sectionC,
    emergency: order.emergency,
    withholdFromAuthor: order.withholdFromAuthor,
    urgent,
    items,
  };
}

/** One item's block, with its closing while it is open. */
function ItemBlock({
  item,
  order,
  reason,
  busy,
  ticked,
  onReason,
  onClose,
  onTick,
  onOpenCase,
}: {
  item: OrderItemView;
  order: OrderView;
  reason: OrderItemCloseReason | null;
  busy: boolean;
  ticked: boolean;
  onReason(reason: OrderItemCloseReason): void;
  onClose(): void;
  onTick(ticked: boolean): void;
  onOpenCase?: (id: CaseId) => void;
}) {
  const open = item.disabledAt === null && item.closedAt === null;
  const caseId = item.disabledAt !== null && item.caseId !== null ? parseCaseId(item.caseId) : null;
  const canTick = effectable(order).some((candidate) => candidate.id === item.id);
  return (
    <li className="block">
      <p>{W.item(item.position)}</p>
      <figure className="frame">
        <figcaption>{ORDER_WORDS.orders.frame}</figcaption>
        <p>
          <UserText>{item.link}</UserText>
        </p>
      </figure>
      <ItemFacts item={item} />
      {caseId !== null && onOpenCase !== undefined ? (
        <p>
          <CaseLink id={caseId} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
            Open the case
          </CaseLink>
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {canTick ? (
        <label className="choice">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={ticked} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => onTick(event.target.checked)} />
          {W.effectTick}
        </label>
      ) : null}
      {item.unverified && order.verified ? <p className="notice">{W.unchecked(bothTimes(item.addedAt))}</p> : null}
      {open && order.mayCorrect !== null ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>{W.closeItem}</legend>
          <ul className="choices">
            {ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS.map((value) => (
              <li key={value}>
                <label className="choice">
                  <input type="radio" name={`close-${item.id}`} checked={reason === value} disabled={busy} onChange={() => onReason(value)} />
                  {ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASON_LABELS[value]}
                </label>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {reason === "withdrawn" ? <p className="hint">{W.withdrawnHint}</p> : null}
          <p className="hint">{W.closeItemHint}</p>
          <button type="button" disabled={busy || reason === null} onClick={onClose}>
            {W.closeItem}
          </button>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}
    </li>
  );
}

/** The words of each console event the screen offers (block 5), with what it records. */
const EVENT_WORDS: Record<OrderConsoleEvent, { button: string; what: (order: OrderView) => string }> = {
  annex3_sent: { button: W.annex3, what: () => W.annex3What },
  grounds_ceased: { button: W.ceased, what: () => W.ceasedWhat },
  clarification_received: { button: W.clarified, what: () => W.clarifiedWhat },
  annex2_sent: { button: W.annex2, what: () => W.annex2What },
  receipt_confirmed: { button: W.informed, what: () => W.informedWhat },
  closed_without_effect: { button: W.close, what: () => W.closeWhat },
  reopened: { button: W.reopen, what: () => W.reopenWhat },
  // Task 3: an admin records a removal order's one extension; the database says when it would otherwise release.
  hold_extended: { button: W.extended, what: (order) => W.extendedWhat(order.hold?.until ? bothTimes(order.hold.until) : "") },
};

/** Block 5: each event the database would take now, with its choice of ground or message, confirmed by the key. */
export function EventsBlock({
  order,
  messages,
  busy,
  onRecord,
}: {
  order: OrderView;
  messages: ContactMessage[];
  busy: boolean;
  onRecord(params: OrderEventRecordedParams): void;
}) {
  const [ground, setGround] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const offered = order.mayEvents;
  if (offered.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.eventsTitle}</h3>
      {offered.map((kind) => {
        const grounds: readonly string[] | null = kind === "annex3_sent" ? ANNEX3_GROUNDS : kind === "closed_without_effect" ? ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS : null;
        const needsMessage = kind === "clarification_received" || kind === "hold_extended";
        const chosen = grounds === null ? null : (ground[kind] ?? null);
        const message = picked[kind] ?? null;
        const ready = (grounds === null || chosen !== null) && (!needsMessage || message !== null);
        return (
          <fieldset key={kind}>
            <legend>{EVENT_WORDS[kind].button}</legend>
            <p className="hint">{EVENT_WORDS[kind].what(order)}</p>
            {grounds !== null ? (
              <ul className="choices">
                {grounds.map((value) => (
                  <li key={value}>
                    <label className="choice">
                      <input type="radio" name={`ground-${kind}`} checked={chosen === value} disabled={busy} onChange={() => setGround((g) => ({ ...g, [kind]: value }))} />
                      {kind === "annex3_sent" ? ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS[value as (typeof ANNEX3_GROUNDS)[number]] : ORDER_GROUND_LABELS[value as (typeof ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS)[number]]}
                    </label>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : null}
            {needsMessage ? (
              <ul className="choices">
                {messages.map((m) => (
                  <li key={m.id}>
                    <label className="choice">
                      <input type="radio" name={`message-${kind}`} checked={message === m.id} disabled={busy} onChange={() => setPicked((p) => ({ ...p, [kind]: m.id }))} />
                      {`${ORDER_WORDS.contact.received(bothTimes(m.receivedAt))}, ${ORDER_WORDS.contact.folders[m.folder]}`}
                    </label>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : null}
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || !ready} onClick={() => onRecord({ kind, ground: chosen as OrderEventRecordedParams["ground"], messageId: needsMessage ? message : null })}>
              {`${EVENT_WORDS[kind].button}: ${W.confirmKey}`}
            </button>
          </fieldset>
        );
      })}
    </section>
  );
}

/** A time as the forms ask for it: in UTC with its offset written out ("2026-10-10 01:00:12 +00:00"). */
export function utcWithOffset(iso: string): string {
  return `${iso.slice(0, 10)} ${iso.slice(11, 19)} +00:00`;
}

/** Block 6: the forms' values as text, for a removal order. */
export function FormsBlock({ order, me }: { order: OrderView; me: Pick<StaffMe, "homeState" | "contactPoint"> }) {
  if (order.kind !== "tco_removal") return null;
  const copy = me.homeState === null ? null : (STATE_FACTS[me.homeState as MemberState]?.annexCopy ?? null);
  const ground = order.clock?.stopGround ?? null;
  const state = `${EU_MEMBER_STATES[order.memberState]} (${order.memberState})`;
  const lines = W.annex3Text(order.reference, order.authority, state, order.receivedAt === null ? "" : utcWithOffset(order.receivedAt), ground === null ? "" : ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS[ground]);
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.formsTitle}</h3>
      <pre className="form-values">
        <UserText>{[...lines, W.contactLine(me.contactPoint ?? W.stateUnknown), W.sendTo(copy ?? W.stateUnknown)].join(String.fromCharCode(10))}</UserText>
      </pre>
    </section>
  );
}

/** Block 7: what the command line still owes, one line each. */
export function OwedBlock({ order }: { order: OrderView }) {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  const added = order.items.filter((item) => item.unverified).length;
  if (order.owed.verification) lines.push(order.verified && added > 0 ? W.owesVerifyAgain(added) : W.owesVerify);
  if (order.owed.issuedAt) lines.push(W.owesIssued);
  if (order.owed.holdUntil) lines.push(W.owesHoldUntil);
  if (order.owed.texts) lines.push(order.kind === "dsa_art9" && !order.items.some((i) => i.disabledAt !== null) ? W.owesTextsDsa : W.owesTexts);
  if (order.owed.tellPerson) lines.push(W.owesTellRule);
  if (order.owed.document) lines.push(W.owesDocument);
  if (order.owed.scrutinyUntil !== null) lines.push(ORDER_WORDS.orders.scrutinyUntil(bothTimes(order.owed.scrutinyUntil)));
  if (lines.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.owesTitle}</h3>
      {lines.map((line) => (
        <p key={line}>{line}</p>
      ))}
    </section>
  );
}

/** Block 8: the author's notice: told, or held until when and on which rule, and released or ended. */
export function NoticeBlock({ order, now = Date.now() }: { order: OrderView; now?: number }) {
  const hold = order.hold;
  const lines: string[] = [];
  if (hold === null) {
    for (const item of order.items) if (item.disabledAt !== null) lines.push(W.toldAt(bothTimes(item.disabledAt)));
  } else if (hold.open) lines.push(W.holdOpen);
  else if (hold.until !== null) lines.push(hold.basis === "regulation" ? W.holdUntil(bothTimes(hold.until), order.issuedAt === null ? "receipt" : "order", hold.extended) : W.holdAuthority(bothTimes(hold.until)));
  if (hold?.releasedAt) lines.push(W.released(bothTimes(hold.releasedAt)));
  if (hold?.endedAt && hold.endReason) lines.push(W.ended(bothTimes(hold.endedAt), HOLD_END_REASON_LABELS[hold.endReason]));
  // [hold.warn] (Task 3): in the last holdWarningDays before a running hold's end.
  if (hold !== null && hold.until !== null && hold.releasedAt === null && hold.endedAt === null) {
    const left = Date.parse(hold.until) - now;
    if (left > 0 && left <= ORDER_RULES.holdWarningDays * 86_400_000) lines.push(W.holdWarn(bothTimes(hold.until)));
  }
  if (lines.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.noticeTitle}</h3>
      {lines.map((line) => (
        <p key={line}>{line}</p>
      ))}
    </section>
  );
}

/** Every ground's words, for an event's phrase. */
const GROUND_WORDS: Record<string, string> = { ...ANNEX3_GROUND_LABELS, ...ORDER_GROUND_LABELS, ...HOLD_END_REASON_LABELS, ...SCRUTINY_OUTCOME_LABELS, ...ORDER_CORRECTION_RULE_WORDS };

/** One event's words (W.1), filled from the event. */
export function eventWords(order: OrderView, event: OrderView["events"][number]): string {
  const position = order.items.find((item) => item.id === event.itemId)?.position ?? 0;
  const ground = event.ground === null ? "" : (GROUND_WORDS[event.ground] ?? event.ground);
  const at = bothTimes(event.effectiveAt ?? event.at);
  return ORDER_EVENT_WORDS[event.kind]
    .replace("{ground}", ground)
    .replace("{reason}", ground)
    .replace("{rule}", ground)
    .replace("{outcome}", ground)
    .replace("{effectiveAt}", at)
    .replace("{n}", String(position))
    .replace("{until}", "");
}

/** Block 9: the events, newest first, each with who wrote it. */
export function EventsList({ order }: { order: OrderView }) {
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.eventsList}</h3>
      <ul className="blocks">
        {[...order.events].reverse().map((event) => (
          <li key={event.id}>
            <p>{`${bothTimes(event.at)}: ${eventWords(order, event)}`}</p>
            <p className="hint">
              {event.via === "console" && event.by !== null ? (
                <>
                  @<UserText>{event.by}</UserText>, console
                </>
              ) : event.via === "cli" ? (
                W.byCli
              ) : (
                W.bySystem
              )}
            </p>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

/** What block 10 holds while it is filled in: every member the form took, as the order shows it now. */
interface CorrectionState {
  kind: OrderView["kind"];
  memberState: MemberState;
  authority: string;
  reference: string;
  channel: OrderView["channel"];
  sectionC: boolean;
  emergency: boolean;
  withholdFromAuthor: boolean;
}

const correctionOf = (order: OrderView): CorrectionState => ({
  kind: order.kind,
  memberState: order.memberState,
  authority: order.authority,
  reference: order.reference,
  channel: order.channel,
  sectionC: order.sectionC,
  emergency: order.emergency,
  withholdFromAuthor: order.withholdFromAuthor,
});

/** The members that changed, and only those: the correction sends what changes and nothing else. */
export function changedFacts(order: OrderView, state: CorrectionState): OrderCorrectFacts {
  const facts: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const before = correctionOf(order);
  for (const key of Object.keys(state) as (keyof CorrectionState)[]) if (state[key] !== before[key]) facts[key] = state[key];
  // A channel is the console's only for an order opened without a message.
  if (order.messageId !== null) delete facts.channel;
  return facts as OrderCorrectFacts;
}

/**
 * Block 10, "Correct what the order shows": the controls the rule allows (mayCorrect). Under caution only "the author must
 * not be told" from no to yes; under entry and admin every member, an admin's with the key.
 */
export function CorrectBlock({ order, busy, onCorrect }: { order: OrderView; busy: boolean; onCorrect(facts: OrderCorrectFacts): void }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<CorrectionState>(() => correctionOf(order));
  useEffect(() => setState(correctionOf(order)), [order]);
  if (order.mayCorrect === null) return null;
  const set = (patch: Partial<CorrectionState>) => setState((current) => ({ ...current, ...patch }));
  const facts = changedFacts(order, state);
  if (order.mayCorrect === "caution") {
    if (order.sectionC) return null;
    return (
      <section className="block">
        <h3>{W.correctTitle}</h3>
        <p className="hint">{W.correctSilence}</p>
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onCorrect({ sectionC: true })}>
          {ORDER_WORDS.form.sectionCChoices.tco[0]}
        </button>
      </section>
    );
  }
  return (
    <section className="block">
      <h3>{W.correctTitle}</h3>
      <p className="hint">{W.correctWhat}</p>
      <label className="field">
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.kind}
        <select value={state.kind} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ kind: event.target.value as CorrectionState["kind"] })}>
          {ORDER_KINDS.map((kind) => (
            <option key={kind} value={kind}>
              {ORDER_KIND_LABELS[kind]}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="field">
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.state}
        <select value={state.memberState} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ memberState: event.target.value as MemberState })}>
          {(Object.keys(EU_MEMBER_STATES) as MemberState[]).map((code) => (
            <option key={code} value={code}>
              {`${EU_MEMBER_STATES[code]} (${code})`}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="field">
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.authority}
        <input type="text" value={state.authority} maxLength={400} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ authority: event.target.value })} />
      </label>
      <label className="field">
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.reference}
        <input type="text" value={state.reference} maxLength={400} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ reference: event.target.value })} />
      </label>
      {order.messageId === null ? (
        <label className="field">
          {ORDER_WORDS.form.channel}
          <select value={state.channel} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ channel: event.target.value as CorrectionState["channel"] })}>
            {ORDER_CHANNELS.map((channel) => (
              <option key={channel} value={channel}>
                {ORDER_CHANNEL_LABELS[channel]}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
      ) : null}
      <label className="choice">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={state.sectionC} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ sectionC: event.target.checked, withholdFromAuthor: event.target.checked || state.withholdFromAuthor })} />
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.sectionCChoices.tco[0]}
      </label>
      {state.sectionC && !order.sectionC ? <p className="hint">{W.correctSilence}</p> : null}
      {!state.sectionC && order.sectionC ? <p className="hint">{W.correctUnsilence}</p> : null}
      <label className="choice">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={state.emergency} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => set({ emergency: event.target.checked })} />
        {ORDER_WORDS.form.emergency}
      </label>
      {state.kind === "dsa_art9" ? (
        <label className="choice">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={state.withholdFromAuthor || state.sectionC} disabled={busy || state.sectionC} onChange={(event) => set({ withholdFromAuthor: event.target.checked })} />
          {ORDER_WORDS.form.withhold}
        </label>
      ) : null}
      <button type="button" disabled={busy || Object.keys(facts).length === 0} onClick={() => onCorrect(facts)}>
        {order.mayCorrect === "admin" ? `${W.correctButton}: ${W.confirmKey}` : W.correctButton}
      </button>
    </section>
  );
}

/** What the screen keeps of its last effect, for [orders.checkOutside]: the effect's time and each address it disabled. */
export interface Effected {
  at: string;
  links: string[];
}

/**
 * Block 4, "Disable for an order" (Task 3): the lines the order's kind and silence call for, the urgent tick for an admin
 * on a DSA order that is not verified, and one button for all ticked items, confirmed by one key. After an effect, the
 * check from outside with each address as text, and [effect.rest] while items are still open.
 */
export function EffectBlock({
  order,
  role,
  ticks,
  urgent,
  busy,
  effected,
  onUrgent,
  onEffect,
}: {
  order: OrderView;
  role: StaffMe["role"];
  ticks: Readonly<Record<string, boolean>>;
  urgent: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  effected: Effected | null;
  onUrgent(urgent: boolean): void;
  onEffect(params: OrderEffectedParams): void;
}) {
  const candidates = effectable(order);
  const open = order.clock?.itemsOpen ?? order.items.filter((item) => item.closedAt === null && item.disabledAt === null).length;
  const deadline = order.clock?.deadlineAt ?? order.dueAt;
  const after =
    effected === null ? null : (
      <section className="block">
        <p className="notice">{W.checkOutside(bothTimes(effected.at), effected.links.length)}</p>
        <ul className="blocks">
          {effected.links.map((link) => (
            <li key={link}>
              <UserText>{link}</UserText>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {open > 0 ? <p className="notice">{W.effectRest(open, deadline === null ? null : bothTimes(deadline))}</p> : null}
      </section>
    );
  if (candidates.length === 0) return after;
  const tco = order.kind === "tco_removal";
  const withholds = tco || order.withholdFromAuthor;
  const told = tco ? !order.sectionC : !order.withholdFromAuthor;
  const until = order.hold?.until ?? null;
  const lines: string[] = [withholds ? W.effectWhat : W.effectRemoved];
  if (tco) {
    // Task 6 (8.5, 8.8): an item whose disabling a restore lost and whose preservation never ended keeps its end; the
    // others count six months from now.
    const again = candidates.filter((item) => item.gap && item.preserveUntil !== null && item.preserveEndedAt === null);
    if (again.length < candidates.length) lines.push(W.effectPreserve);
    for (const end of [...new Set(again.map((item) => item.preserveUntil!))]) lines.push(RECOVERY_WORDS.effectPreserveAgain(bothTimes(end)));
  }
  if (told) lines.push(W.effectTold);
  else if (tco) lines.push(until === null ? W.effectHeldNoReceipt : W.effectHeld(bothTimes(until)));
  else lines.push(until === null || order.hold?.open ? W.effectHeldOpen : W.effectHeldDsa(bothTimes(until)));
  const unverifiedDsa = order.kind === "dsa_art9" && !order.verified;
  const chosen = candidates.filter((item) => isTicked(order, ticks, item.id)).map((item) => item.id);
  const allowed = !unverifiedDsa || (role === "admin" && urgent);
  return (
    <>
      {after}
      <section className="block">
        <h3>{W.effectTitle}</h3>
        {lines.map((line) => (
          <p key={line} className="hint">
            {line}
          </p>
        ))}
        {unverifiedDsa && role === "admin" ? (
          <>
            <label className="choice">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={urgent} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => onUrgent(event.target.checked)} />
              {W.effectUrgent}
            </label>
            <p className="hint">{W.effectUrgentWhat}</p>
          </>
        ) : null}
        {unverifiedDsa && role !== "admin" ? <p className="notice">{W.verifyFirst}</p> : null}
        <p className="hint">{W.effectAnyone}</p>
        {candidates.length > ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction ? <p className="notice">{W.effectMax}</p> : null}
        {unverifiedDsa && role !== "admin" ? null : (
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={busy || !allowed || chosen.length === 0 || chosen.length > ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction}
            onClick={() => onEffect(effectParamsOf(order, chosen, unverifiedDsa && urgent))}
          >
            {W.effectButton(chosen.length)}
          </button>
        )}
      </section>
    </>
  );
}

export interface OrderPageProps {
  order: OrderView;
  me: Pick<StaffMe, "homeState" | "contactPoint" | "role">;
  now: number;
  messages: ContactMessage[];
  busy: boolean;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  /** The reason chosen to close each open item. */
  reasons: Readonly<Record<string, OrderItemCloseReason>>;
  links: string;
  onReason(itemId: string, reason: OrderItemCloseReason): void;
  onCloseItem(itemId: string): void;
  onLinks(text: string): void;
  onAddLinks(): void;
  onRecord(params: OrderEventRecordedParams): void;
  onCorrect(facts: OrderCorrectFacts): void;
  /** Task 3: each item's tick as the person set it, the urgent tick, the last effect, and their handlers. */
  ticks?: Readonly<Record<string, boolean>>;
  urgent?: boolean;
  effected?: Effected | null;
  onTick?: (itemId: string, ticked: boolean) => void;
  onUrgent?: (urgent: boolean) => void;
  onEffect?: (params: OrderEffectedParams) => void;
  onOpenCase?: (id: CaseId) => void;
}

const nothing = () => undefined;

/** The order's page, blocks in order; at 360 px the first screenful holds the clock. */
export function OrderPage(props: OrderPageProps) {
  const { order, me, now, messages, busy, notice, error, reasons, links } = props;
  const ticks = props.ticks ?? {};
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="order-title">
      <h2 id="order-title">{ORDER_KIND_LABELS[order.kind]}</h2>
      <p className={order.state === "overdue" || order.state === "unknown_deadline" ? "error" : "notice"}>{clockLine({ ...order, items: order.items.length }, now)}</p>
      {notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <OrderFacts order={order} />
      <CheckBlock order={order} me={me} />
      <section className="block">
        <h3>{W.itemsTitle}</h3>
        <ul className="blocks items">
          {order.items.map((item) => (
            <ItemBlock
              key={item.id}
              item={item}
              order={order}
              reason={reasons[item.id] ?? null}
              busy={busy}
              ticked={isTicked(order, ticks, item.id)}
              onReason={(reason) => props.onReason(item.id, reason)}
              onClose={() => props.onCloseItem(item.id)}
              onTick={(ticked) => (props.onTick ?? nothing)(item.id, ticked)}
              {...(props.onOpenCase === undefined ? {} : { onOpenCase: props.onOpenCase })}
            />
          ))}
        </ul>
        {order.closedAt === null && order.kind !== "dsa_art10" ? (
          <label className="field">
            {W.addLinks}
            <textarea value={links} rows={3} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => props.onLinks(event.target.value)} />
            <span className="hint">{W.added}</span>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || links.trim() === ""} onClick={props.onAddLinks}>
              {W.addLinks}
            </button>
          </label>
        ) : null}
      </section>
      <EffectBlock
        order={order}
        role={me.role}
        ticks={ticks}
        urgent={props.urgent ?? false}
        busy={busy}
        effected={props.effected ?? null}
        onUrgent={props.onUrgent ?? nothing}
        onEffect={props.onEffect ?? nothing}
      />
      <EventsBlock order={order} messages={messages} busy={busy} onRecord={props.onRecord} />
      <FormsBlock order={order} me={me} />
      <OwedBlock order={order} />
      <NoticeBlock order={order} now={now} />
      <EventsList order={order} />
      <CorrectBlock order={order} busy={busy} onCorrect={props.onCorrect} />
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * The order's screen: read on opening and every 20 seconds without the mark; each action reads it again from its answer.
 * An event is confirmed by the key; a correction too under the rule admin, and without one under entry and caution.
 */
export function Order({
  id,
  api,
  me,
  credentials,
  opened,
  onOpenCase,
}: {
  id: OrderId;
  api: StaffApi;
  me: StaffMe;
  credentials: CredentialsLike;
  opened: { unsure: boolean } | null;
  onOpenCase?: (id: CaseId) => void;
}) {
  const [order, setOrder] = useState<Loadable<OrderView>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ContactMessage[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(opened === null ? null : opened.unsure ? `${ORDER_WORDS.form.done} ${ORDER_WORDS.form.unsure}` : ORDER_WORDS.form.done);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reasons, setReasons] = useState<Record<string, OrderItemCloseReason>>({});
  const [links, setLinks] = useState("");
  const [ticks, setTicks] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [urgent, setUrgent] = useState(false);
  const [effected, setEffected] = useState<Effected | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    const read = async (activity: boolean) => {
      try {
        const value = await api.order(id, { activity });
        if (alive.current) {
          setOrder({ state: "ready", value });
          setNow(Date.now());
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (alive.current) setOrder({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
      }
    };
    void read(true);
    void api.contact(null, false, { activity: true }).then(
      (page) => alive.current && setMessages(page.items),
      () => undefined,
    );
    const timer = setInterval(() => void read(false), 20_000);
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, [api, id]);

  /** Runs an action, then shows the order as its answer stands. */
  const act = async (run: () => Promise<OrderView>, done: string | null) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      const value = await run();
      if (alive.current) {
        setOrder({ state: "ready", value });
        setNow(Date.now());
        if (done !== null) setNotice(done);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const deps = { api, credentials };
  const correct = (value: OrderView, facts: OrderCorrectFacts) =>
    act(() => (value.mayCorrect === "admin" ? correctOrderWithKey(deps, id, facts) : api.correctOrder(id, { facts }, { activity: true })), W.corrected);
  /** Block 4: one key for the ticked items; the answer's newest effect_given is the time the check from outside names. */
  const effect = (params: OrderEffectedParams) =>
    act(async () => {
      const value = await effectOrderWithKey(deps, id, params);
      const at = [...value.events].reverse().find((event) => event.kind === "effect_given")?.at ?? new Date().toISOString();
      const done = new Set(params.items.map((item) => item.itemId));
      if (alive.current) {
        setEffected({ at, links: value.items.filter((item) => done.has(item.id)).map((item) => item.link) });
        setTicks({});
        setUrgent(false);
      }
      return value;
    }, null);

  return (
    <Loaded
      value={order}
      render={(value) => (
        <OrderPage
          order={value}
          me={me}
          now={now}
          messages={messages}
          busy={busy}
          notice={notice}
          error={error}
          reasons={reasons}
          links={links}
          onReason={(itemId, reason) => setReasons((current) => ({ ...current, [itemId]: reason }))}
          onCloseItem={(itemId) => {
            const reason = reasons[itemId];
            if (reason !== undefined) void correct(value, { closeItems: [{ itemId, reason }] });
          }}
          onLinks={setLinks}
          onAddLinks={() => {
            const list = links.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).map((line) => line.trim()).filter((line) => line !== "");
            void act(() => api.addOrderItems(id, { links: list }, { activity: true }), null).then(() => setLinks(""));
          }}
          onRecord={(params) => void act(() => recordOrderEventWithKey(deps, id, params), null)}
          onCorrect={(facts) => void correct(value, facts)}
          ticks={ticks}
          urgent={urgent}
          effected={effected}
          onTick={(itemId, ticked) => setTicks((current) => ({ ...current, [itemId]: ticked }))}
          onUrgent={setUrgent}
          onEffect={(params) => void effect(params)}
          {...(onOpenCase === undefined ? {} : { onOpenCase })}
        />
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

### Replace `apps/api/.env.example` (whole file)

```text
NODE_ENV=development
PORT=3000
LOG_LEVEL=debug
DATABASE_URL_API=postgres://korbat_api:change-me-api@localhost:55432/korbat
```

```ts
import { RETENTION, type AlertFacts, type ReleaseNoticeView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { MailRefused, type MailMessage, type NoticeUpdateLine } from "../../mail/mailer";
import type { DecisionMailSubject } from "../../mail/templates";
import type { AuthDeps } from "../context";
import { decrypt, encrypt, randomToken, safeEqual } from "../crypto";
import { emailHash } from "../identifiers";
import { HOUR } from "../limits";
import { noticeTime } from "./notify";

/**
 * The auth module's side of reports and notices (3c design, section 5): a signed-out notifier's name and address, which
 * live here, encrypted, where the API's role cannot reach them, and every mail of the moderation module, which never
 * sees an address or a mail token. The moderation module names a contact by an id it chose, names an account by its id,
 * and passes typed messages: no caller passes free text, and this module builds every link itself.
 */

const DAY = 24 * HOUR;

/** An address that is not confirmed gets at most one receipt in this long; further ones are folded into the next daily mail. */
export const RECEIPT_CAP_MS = DAY;

/** The receipt of a report or a notice: its reference, when it was received, and the korbat links it named, in the order named. */
export interface NoticeReceivedMessage {
  template: "notice_received";
  ref: string;
  receivedAt: Date;
  items: readonly string[];
}

/** The daily update of decisions on the reports an account sent: its lines, as the moderation module composed them. */
export interface AccountUpdateMessage {
  template: "notice_update";
  lines: readonly NoticeUpdateLine[];
}

/**
 * The statement of reasons to the author of what a decision restricts or lifts: the subject by its key, and the
 * statement's paragraphs exactly as they were rendered for the author's screen. 3e (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6):
 * a suspension or termination taken at once, and the lift of one (or its end when a reversal broke its basis), are
 * mailed under a subject and a lead of their own, with the same paragraphs; the moderation module picks the template
 * (mailTemplateOf). Times are instants, printed here as the notices print them.
 */
export type DecisionMessage =
  | { template: "moderation_decision"; subject: DecisionMailSubject; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: an announced measure, with its days (null for a termination), the reply window in hours and the earliest start.
  | { template: "suspension_announced"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; days: number | null; window: number; earliestStart: string; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "suspension_started_at_once"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; days: number | null; endsAt: string | null; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: the answer to the person's reply, which kept the measure in force or reversed it.
  | { template: "reply_answered"; outcome: "kept" | "reversed"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "suspension_lifted"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; why: "lifted" | "basis"; period: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: a withdrawal signed `replaced`, with the withdrawn decision's time and whether the person had replied to it.
  | { template: "suspension_lifted"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; why: "replaced"; decidedAt: string; replied: boolean; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 5: a warning about the account's reports; a restriction of them, with its days and its end.
  | { template: "reporting_warned"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "reporting_restricted"; days: number; endsAt: string; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3f Task 3 (design, W.5): an order's notice, a reinstatement after one, and the authority's words added to a notice
  // already told. Each says only that a notice is there or has grown: its paragraphs are not mailed, and are empty.
  | { template: "order_notice" | "order_reinstated_notice" | "order_notice_added"; paragraphs: readonly string[] };

/** The templates of a decision's statement mail: a stop of the address never holds one back. */
const DECISION_TEMPLATES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  "moderation_decision",
  "suspension_announced",
  "suspension_started_at_once",
  "reply_answered",
  "suspension_lifted",
  "reporting_warned",
  "reporting_restricted",
  "order_notice",
  "order_reinstated_notice",
  "order_notice_added",
]);

/** Whether an account's message is a decision's statement. */
const isDecisionMessage = (message: { template: string }): message is DecisionMessage => DECISION_TEMPLATES.has(message.template);

/** What the statement's paragraphs are joined with in a mail's data: one paragraph per line. */
const LINE_BREAK = String.fromCharCode(10);

/** A decision's message as its template's flat data: one data value for the statement, one paragraph per line, exactly as it was rendered. */
function decisionData(message: DecisionMessage): Record<string, string> {
  const statement = message.paragraphs.join(LINE_BREAK);
  switch (message.template) {
    case "moderation_decision":
      return { subject: message.subject, statement };
    case "suspension_announced":
      return { measure: message.measure, statement, window: String(message.window), earliestStart: noticeTime(new Date(message.earliestStart)), ...(message.days === null ? {} : { days: String(message.days) }) };
    case "suspension_started_at_once":
      return { measure: message.measure, statement, ...(message.days === null ? {} : { days: String(message.days) }), ...(message.endsAt === null ? {} : { endsAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.endsAt)) }) };
    case "reply_answered":
      return { outcome: message.outcome, statement };
    case "suspension_lifted":
      return message.why === "replaced"
        ? { measure: message.measure, why: message.why, decidedAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.decidedAt)), replied: String(message.replied), statement }
        : { measure: message.measure, why: message.why, period: message.period, statement };
    case "reporting_warned":
      return { statement };
    case "reporting_restricted":
      return { statement, days: String(message.days), endsAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.endsAt)) };
    case "order_notice":
    case "order_reinstated_notice":
    case "order_notice_added":
      // A fixed body: nothing of the notice goes by mail.
      return {};
  }
}

/** What may be sent to a signed-out notifier's contact by itself: the receipt. Its updates go by address, through mailNotifierUpdates. */
export type NotifierMessage = NoticeReceivedMessage;
/**
 * 3d (design, sections 7.1 and 7.15; W.8): the notice that korbat lost the files of an image of the account's post while
 * they were kept apart in the quarantine, with the post's creation time. No stop of the address holds it back: it is no
 * mail about the account's reports.
 */
export interface ImageLostMessage {
  template: "image_lost";
  postCreatedAt: Date;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 7.2 and 7.15; W.6 and W.8): the author's notice of a release of sealed images of their
 * posts, with the view its paragraphs are rendered from: the ground, the times, the posts' times and the counts, never an
 * authority, a reference or an assessment. No stop of the address holds it back: it is about the account's own posts.
 */
export interface ReleaseNoticeMessage {
  template: "release_notice";
  view: ReleaseNoticeView;
}

/** What may be sent to an account: the receipt and the daily update of its reports, the statement of a decision about it, and (3d) the notices of a lost image and of a release. */
export type AccountMessage = NoticeReceivedMessage | AccountUpdateMessage | DecisionMessage | ImageLostMessage | ReleaseNoticeMessage;

/** One contact's share of the daily update: the lines of its notice, and its receipt when the 24-hour cap folded it. */
export interface NotifierUpdatePart {
  contactId: string;
  /** The reference of the contact's notice. */
  ref: string;
  lines: readonly NoticeUpdateLine[];
  receipt?: { ref: string; receivedAt: Date; items: readonly string[] };
}

/** What became of one contact's share: as a mail's result, or "unavailable" when the relay could not take that address's mail or the contact could not be read. */
export type NotifierUpdateResult = "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "forgotten" | "refused" | "unavailable";

/**
 * The staff alerts: counts, times and a staff account's public handle, never a link or content. The urgent lane's alert;
 * the cases that wait longer than their lane's response time, and those that hold a measure taken while deciding for
 * more than a day; the staff account that confirmed many decisions in a short time; the one that reached its daily case
 * limit; every reveal of who sent a report, with the day's count; and every decision that lifted the protection of
 * images reported as child sexual abuse material.
 */
export type StaffMessage =
  | StaffAlertMessage
  // 3f's review (people4): `phones`, whether the phone alerts are on (NOTIFY), so the mail never says a push went to a
  // phone when nothing publishes one, and says instead that it is the only alert.
  | { template: "moderation_urgent"; count: number; oldest: Date; phones: boolean }
  | { template: "moderation_waiting"; lanes: readonly { lane: 0 | 1 | 2; count: number; oldest: Date }[]; interim: number; replies?: { count: number; oldest: Date } | null; phones: boolean }
  | { template: "moderation_burst"; handle: string; count: number }
  | { template: "moderation_reads"; handle: string; limit: number }
  | { template: "moderation_reveal"; handle: string; at: Date; count: number; limit: number }
  | { template: "moderation_csam_lifted"; handle: string; at: Date; what: "unsealed" | "dismissed" };

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 7.2, 7.19 and 18, W.4): the staff alerts whose mail is their push's sentence, which the alert tick
 * mails from a row of alert_outbox: the row's facts, counts and times only, and nothing else. Later tasks of 3f add their
 * kinds here as they first write them.
 */
export type StaffAlertKind =
  | "contact_mail"
  | "contact_mail_escalated"
  | "order_due"
  | "mailbox_unreachable"
  | "alert_channel_down"
  | "order_opened"
  | "order_corrected"
  | "order_unverified"
  // Task 3: an order given effect, an order's measure lifted, and a held notice about to be released.
  | "order_effected"
  | "order_reinstated"
  | "hold_ending"
  // Task 6: the copy of the audit log's tail is overdue, and someone who did not take the last copy took one.
  | "copy_overdue"
  | "copy_taken"
  // Task 5's two daily kinds, joined in 3f's review: a report to an authority owed, a hand-over's copy not destroyed.
  | "report_owed"
  | "handover_undestroyed"
  // 3d Task 1: a move of sealed files that is due, which alert_steps() writes daily, and files the quarantine's record
  // says are lost, which staff.js quarantine-record writes with its record.
  | "quarantine_due"
  | "quarantine_lost"
  // 3d Task 2: a released file still recorded in the quarantine, which alert_steps() writes daily, and an admin's release
  // of sealed images, which staffAlert writes after the release's commit.
  | "release_undestroyed"
  | "seal_released"
  // 3d Task 3: the edge's job gave up on purges, which it writes as its own row of the outbox.
  | "edge_purge_failed";
export interface StaffAlertMessage {
  template: StaffAlertKind;
  facts: AlertFacts;
}

/**
 * A staff alert's template data: every member as the text the template prints. A 3f alert's facts go as they are, each
 * count as its digits, with the time it is sent: the template prints a time with its day only when that is not today's.
 */
function staffData(message: StaffMessage, now: Date): Record<string, string> {
  switch (message.template) {
    case "contact_mail":
    case "contact_mail_escalated":
    case "order_due":
    case "mailbox_unreachable":
    case "alert_channel_down":
    case "order_opened":
    case "order_corrected":
    case "order_unverified":
    case "order_effected":
    case "order_reinstated":
    case "hold_ending":
    case "copy_overdue":
    case "copy_taken":
    case "report_owed":
    case "handover_undestroyed":
    case "quarantine_due":
    case "quarantine_lost":
    case "release_undestroyed":
    case "seal_released":
    case "edge_purge_failed":
      return { ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(message.facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, String(value)])), now: now.toISOString() };
    case "moderation_urgent":
      return { count: String(message.count), oldest: noticeTime(message.oldest), phones: message.phones ? "on" : "off" };
    case "moderation_waiting": {
      // A lane's pair only for a lane with a case past its time, and the measures' count only when it is not 0.
      const data: Record<string, string> = { phones: message.phones ? "on" : "off" };
      for (const lane of message.lanes) {
        if (lane.count <= 0) continue;
        data[`lane${lane.lane}Count`] = String(lane.count);
        data[`lane${lane.lane}Oldest`] = noticeTime(lane.oldest);
      }
      if (message.interim > 0) data.interimCount = String(message.interim);
      // 3e Task 4: the replies unanswered for longer than korbat's aim, only when there are any.
      if (message.replies && message.replies.count > 0) {
        data.replyCount = String(message.replies.count);
        data.replyOldest = noticeTime(message.replies.oldest);
      }
      return data;
    }
    case "moderation_burst":
      return { handle: message.handle, count: String(message.count) };
    case "moderation_csam_lifted":
      return { handle: message.handle, time: noticeTime(message.at), what: message.what };
    case "moderation_reads":
      return { handle: message.handle, limit: String(message.limit) };
    case "moderation_reveal":
      return { handle: message.handle, time: noticeTime(message.at), count: String(message.count), limit: String(message.limit) };
  }
}

export type NotifierMailResult = "sent" | "folded" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "forgotten" | "refused";
export type AccountMailResult = "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "refused";

/** What staff may know of a signed-out notifier without a reveal: never the name or the address themselves. */
export interface NotifierFacts {
  /** False for an id no contact has: it was never stored, or the janitor has forgotten it. Then the other four are false too. */
  found: boolean;
  named: boolean;
  contactGiven: boolean;
  confirmed: boolean;
  suppressed: boolean;
}

/** A contact's ciphertexts open under the key, or under a key it replaced. Nothing read is ever written back under the newer key. */
const open = (deps: Pick<AuthDeps, "config">, payload: string): string => decrypt(payload, [deps.config.notifierKey, ...deps.config.notifierPreviousKeys]).toString("utf8");
const seal = (deps: AuthDeps, plain: string): string => encrypt(Buffer.from(plain, "utf8"), deps.config.notifierKey);

/** The same day `months` calendar months later in UTC; a day the target month lacks becomes that month's last day. */
function monthsLater(at: Date, months: number): Date {
  const month = at.getUTCMonth() + months;
  const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
  return new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month, Math.min(at.getUTCDate(), lastDay), at.getUTCHours(), at.getUTCMinutes(), at.getUTCSeconds(), at.getUTCMilliseconds()));
}

/** The cap's marker for an address, by its keyed hash: set when a receipt goes to it unconfirmed, gone a day later. */
const receiptCapKey = (hash: string) => `notifier-receipt:${hash}`;

/** The receipt's template data. The page link is this module's: the status page's address with the contact's mail token in the fragment, which no server log sees. */
function receiptData(deps: AuthDeps, message: NoticeReceivedMessage, pageUrl?: string): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    ref: message.ref,
    time: noticeTime(message.receivedAt),
    items: message.items.join(", "),
    ...(pageUrl === undefined ? {} : { pageUrl }),
    termsUrl: `${deps.config.appOrigin}/terms`,
  };
}

/** Sends one mail. "refused" when the relay refused the recipient for good; any other failure is thrown, for the caller to try again. */
async function deliver(deps: AuthDeps, message: MailMessage): Promise<"sent" | "refused"> {
  try {
    await deps.mailer.send(message);
    return "sent";
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof MailRefused) return "refused";
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Stores a signed-out notifier's contact under the id the moderation module wrote on the notice: the name and the
 * address normalised and encrypted under the notifier key, the address's keyed hash for the cap and for stops, and, with
 * an address, a fresh mail token encrypted beside it. A disposable address is taken: a notifier may want one. The contact
 * is forgotten 13 months on unless the notice is still owed something by then.
 */
export async function storeNotifierContact(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, contact: { name?: string; email?: string }): Promise<void> {
  const name = contact.name?.trim() || null;
  const email = contact.email?.trim().toLowerCase() || null;
  await deps.repo.createNotifierContact({
    id: contactId,
    nameEnc: name === null ? null : seal(deps, name),
    emailEnc: email === null ? null : seal(deps, email),
    emailHash: email === null ? null : emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, email),
    // The token of the mails' link: it alone confirms or stops the address, so whoever typed someone else's address cannot.
    mailTokenEnc: email === null ? null : seal(deps, randomToken()),
    forgetAfter: monthsLater(deps.now(), RETENTION.contactMaxMonths),
  });
}

/**
 * Sends a signed-out notifier's receipt, under three rules. A stopped address gets nothing ("suppressed"). An address
 * that is not confirmed gets one receipt in 24 hours, and a further one is "folded": it rides in the next daily mail, so
 * typing someone's address into the form many times sends them one mail. A confirmed address has no cap. "forgotten"
 * when no contact has the id, "no_address" when the contact left none. A failure of the relay that is not about the
 * address is thrown, and gives the day's one receipt back first, so the retry is sent rather than folded.
 */
export async function mailNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, message: NotifierMessage): Promise<NotifierMailResult> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  if (!contact) return "forgotten";
  if (!contact.emailEnc || !contact.emailHash || !contact.mailTokenEnc) return "no_address";
  const hash = contact.emailHash;
  if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash)) return "suppressed";
  // Opened before the cap is taken: a ciphertext no configured key opens throws here and spends nothing.
  const to = open(deps, contact.emailEnc);
  const pageUrl = `${deps.config.appOrigin}/notice/${message.ref}#t=${open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc)}`;
  const confirmed = (await deps.repo.confirmedNotifierHashes([hash], deps.now())).has(hash);
  if (!confirmed && !(await deps.kv.setIfAbsent(receiptCapKey(hash), "1", RECEIPT_CAP_MS))) return "folded";
  try {
    return await deliver(deps, { to, template: "notice_received", data: receiptData(deps, message, pageUrl) });
  } catch (err) {
    if (!confirmed) await deps.kv.del(receiptCapKey(hash)).catch((failure: unknown) => deps.log.warn({ err: failure }, "notifier receipt: the day's one receipt could not be given back after a failed send"));
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Sends a mail to an account's own address, which its sign-in code confirmed: no cap and no confirmation. A stop of
 * that address applies to the two report mails, the receipt and the daily update, and never to a statement of reasons.
 * The update of an account is signed in: it carries its lines and neither a receipt nor a page link, since an account
 * follows its reports in the app. "no_address" for an account that is deleted or was never there.
 */
export async function mailAccount(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string, message: AccountMessage): Promise<AccountMailResult> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return "no_address";
  if (isDecisionMessage(message)) {
    // A statement is never held back by a stop of the address.
    return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: message.template, data: decisionData(message) });
  }
  // 3d: nor is the notice of a lost image, which is about the account's own post and not about its reports.
  if (message.template === "image_lost") return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "image_lost", data: { createdAt: noticeTime(message.postCreatedAt) } });
  // 3d Task 2: nor is the notice of a release. Its paragraphs are rendered from these flat members by the template, from
  // the same function as the app's notice screen; the times go as ISO text and are printed as korbat's mails print them.
  if (message.template === "release_notice") {
    const view = message.view;
    return deliver(deps, {
      to: user.email,
      template: "release_notice",
      data: {
        basis: view.basis,
        releasedAt: view.releasedAt,
        backupsClearAt: view.backupsClearAt,
        upload: view.upload ? "yes" : "no",
        postCount: String(view.postCount),
        images: String(view.images),
        createdAt: view.posts[0]?.createdAt ?? "",
      },
    });
  }
  const hash = emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email);
  if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash)) return "suppressed";
  if (message.template === "notice_update") return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [...message.lines], receipts: [], pages: [] } });
  return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "notice_received", data: receiptData(deps, message) });
}

/**
 * The daily update to signed-out notifiers (3c design, sections 5 and 7.8): the parts are grouped by their contacts'
 * address, which only this module can see, and each address gets one notice_update with every part's lines, every
 * carried receipt with its page link, and the page link of each other notice it has a line for. A page link is the
 * status page's address with that contact's own mail token in the fragment, the same link its receipt carried.
 *
 * It applies a stop of the address, and neither the confirmation nor the 24-hour cap: nothing is withheld for want of a
 * confirmed address. It answers for each contact, and throws for none: an address whose mail the relay could not take is
 * "unavailable", so its lines stay pending while every other address's update is still sent. Each contact is read in a
 * try of its own: one that cannot be read (a ciphertext no configured key opens) is logged with its id, never an
 * address, and answered "unavailable" too.
 */
export async function mailNotifierUpdates(deps: AuthDeps, parts: readonly NotifierUpdatePart[]): Promise<Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>> {
  const results = new Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>();
  /** The readable parts, by their address's keyed hash, in the order given. */
  const byAddress = new Map<string, { to: string; parts: { part: NotifierUpdatePart; pageUrl: string }[] }>();
  for (const part of parts) {
    try {
      const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(part.contactId);
      if (!contact) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "forgotten");
        continue;
      }
      if (!contact.emailEnc || !contact.emailHash || !contact.mailTokenEnc) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "no_address");
        continue;
      }
      if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([contact.emailHash])).has(contact.emailHash)) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "suppressed");
        continue;
      }
      const to = open(deps, contact.emailEnc);
      const pageUrl = `${deps.config.appOrigin}/notice/${part.ref}#t=${open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc)}`;
      const group = byAddress.get(contact.emailHash) ?? { to, parts: [] };
      group.parts.push({ part, pageUrl });
      byAddress.set(contact.emailHash, group);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, contactId: part.contactId }, "notifier update: the contact could not be read; its lines stay pending");
      results.set(part.contactId, "unavailable");
    }
  }
  for (const group of byAddress.values()) {
    const receipts = group.parts.flatMap(({ part, pageUrl }) => (part.receipt ? [{ ref: part.receipt.ref, time: noticeTime(part.receipt.receivedAt), items: part.receipt.items.join(", "), pageUrl }] : []));
    // A notice whose receipt rides in this update has its page with the receipt; every other notice with a line gets a page paragraph.
    const pages = group.parts.flatMap(({ part, pageUrl }) => (part.receipt || part.lines.length === 0 ? [] : [{ ref: part.ref, pageUrl }]));
    const lines = group.parts.flatMap(({ part }) => [...part.lines]);
    let result: NotifierUpdateResult;
    try {
      result = await deliver(deps, {
        to: group.to,
        template: "notice_update",
        data: { signedIn: false, lines, receipts, pages, ...(receipts.length > 0 ? { termsUrl: `${deps.config.appOrigin}/terms` } : {}) },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // The relay could not take this address's mail: the other addresses' mails still go. The contacts' ids, never the address.
      deps.log.warn({ err, contactIds: group.parts.map(({ part }) => part.contactId) }, "notifier update: not sent; its lines stay pending for the next round");
      result = "unavailable";
    }
    for (const { part } of group.parts) results.set(part.contactId, result);
  }
  // In the order the parts were given, whatever order the addresses were mailed in.
  return new Map(parts.map((part) => [part.contactId, results.get(part.contactId) ?? "unavailable"]));
}

/**
 * Sends a staff alert to every live staff account's address, best effort: a failed send is logged and never thrown, and
 * the answer is the number of addresses the relay took, 0 when it took none or there is no live staff account. It
 * applies no throttle: the moderation module keeps every throttle, as a key in the shared limit store.
 */
export async function mailStaff(deps: AuthDeps, message: StaffMessage): Promise<number> {
  const data = staffData(message, deps.now());
  let addresses: string[];
  try {
    addresses = await deps.repo.liveStaffAddresses();
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, template: message.template }, "staff alert: the staff accounts could not be read");
    return 0;
  }
  let accepted = 0;
  for (const to of addresses) {
    try {
      await deps.mailer.send({ to, template: message.template, data });
      accepted++;
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, template: message.template }, "staff alert email failed");
    }
  }
  return accepted;
}

/** For each id: whether a contact has it, whether a name and an address were given, and whether the address is confirmed or stopped now. */
export async function notifierFacts(deps: AuthDeps, contactIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, NotifierFacts>> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.notifierContactFacts(contactIds);
  const hashes = rows.flatMap((row) => (row.emailHash === null ? [] : [row.emailHash]));
  const [confirmed, suppressed] = await Promise.all([deps.repo.confirmedNotifierHashes(hashes, deps.now()), deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes(hashes)]);
  const byId = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
  return new Map(
    contactIds.map((id): [string, NotifierFacts] => {
      const row = byId.get(id);
      if (!row) return [id, { found: false, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false }];
      return [id, { found: true, named: row.named, contactGiven: row.contactGiven, confirmed: row.emailHash !== null && confirmed.has(row.emailHash), suppressed: row.emailHash !== null && suppressed.has(row.emailHash) }];
    }),
  );
}

/** The name a notifier gave, or null: for a confirmed reveal only. The address is never handed out. */
export async function notifierName(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  return contact?.nameEnc ? open(deps, contact.nameEnc) : null;
}

/** The contact's address hash when the token is its mail token, compared in constant time; null for anything else. */
async function addressOfToken(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  if (!contact?.mailTokenEnc || !contact.emailHash) return null;
  let mailToken: string;
  try {
    mailToken = open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc);
  } catch (err) {
    // A contact no configured key opens matches nothing; the fault is the operator's to see, with the contact's id and no address.
    deps.log.error({ err, contactId }, "notifier contact: its mail token could not be decrypted");
    return null;
  }
  return safeEqual(mailToken, token) ? contact.emailHash : null;
}

/** Whether the token is the contact's mail token; false when the contact has none. */
export async function notifierMailTokenMatches(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token)) !== null;
}

/**
 * "I sent this": with the contact's mail token, records the address as confirmed for 30 days and lifts any stop of it.
 * False, and nothing done, for any other token: typing someone's address proves nothing about it.
 */
export async function confirmNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const hash = await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token);
  if (hash === null) return false;
  const now = deps.now();
  await deps.repo.confirmNotifierAddress(hash, now, new Date(now.getTime() + RETENTION.confirmationDays * DAY));
  return true;
}

/** "Stop": with the contact's mail token, korbat sends this address no more mails about reports. Its notices are still processed. */
export async function stopNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const hash = await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token);
  if (hash === null) return false;
  await deps.repo.suppressNotifierAddress(hash);
  return true;
}

/** Whether the account's address asked korbat to stop its report mails. */
export async function accountReportMailStopped(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return false;
  const hash = emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email);
  return (await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash);
}

/** Lifts a stop of the account's address, for the account's own Settings: the session proves the address. True when there was one. */
export async function resumeAccountReportMail(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return false;
  return deps.repo.liftNotifierSuppression(emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email));
}

/** Moves the day these contacts are forgotten. */
export function forgetNotifierAfter(deps: AuthDeps, contactIds: readonly string[], at: Date): Promise<void> {
  return deps.repo.setNotifierForgetAfter(contactIds, at);
}

/** The contacts that gave this address, with the names they gave: for an access request from a signed-out notifier, from the command line only. */
export async function findNotifierContacts(deps: Pick<AuthDeps, "repo" | "config">, email: string): Promise<{ id: string; name: string | null }[]> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.notifierContactsByEmailHash(emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, email));
  return rows.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, name: row.nameEnc ? open(deps, row.nameEnc) : null }));
}

/** How many contacts and confirmations the janitor should have removed more than a day ago: a count only, for the console's overview. */
export function overdueContacts(deps: AuthDeps): Promise<number> {
  return deps.repo.countNotifierRowsDue(new Date(deps.now().getTime() - DAY));
}
```

```ts
 * characters and neither starting nor ending with a hyphen; no scheme, port, path or final dot.

const PRINTABLE = /^[^\p{C}\p{Zl}\p{Zp}]+$/u;

}

/** localhost and its subdomains (RFC 6761): names that only ever mean this machine. */
function isLocalhost(name: string): boolean {

  EDGE_ZONE_ID: blankAsUnset.pipe(z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/, "must be the zone's id: 32 hexadecimal characters").optional()),

   * The provider's API token with the one permission Zone, Cache Purge: a secret, in no log line, audit row or answer.
   * One word of the provider's characters, so its value can never carry a line of its own into the request's headers.
   */
  EDGE_API_TOKEN: optionalSecret.pipe(z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,200}$/, "must be the provider's API token: one word of letters, digits, dashes and underscores").optional()),
  /** The public hostname images are served under at the edge, bare: a prefix is <EDGE_HOST>/api/media/<id>/. */
  EDGE_HOST: blankAsUnset.pipe(z.string().toLowerCase().regex(RP_ID, "must be a bare domain name such as korbat.example: no scheme, port or path").optional()),
}).superRefine((c, ctx) => {
  const refuse = (path: string, message: string) => ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: [path], message });
  // 3d (design, section 5, review ruling 11): in every environment, a test adapter never runs on a site people can reach.
  if (c.EDGE_PURGE === "test" && c.APP_SITE === "open") refuse("EDGE_PURGE", "EDGE_PURGE=test is refused while APP_SITE is open: a test adapter answers only on a site that is closed");
  // An adapter named without its settings stops the process at start, as every missing setting does.
  if (c.EDGE_PURGE === "cloudflare") {
    for (const name of ["EDGE_ZONE_ID", "EDGE_API_TOKEN", "EDGE_HOST"] as const) if (c[name] === undefined) refuse(name, `${name} is required when EDGE_PURGE is cloudflare`);
  }
  // 3f: a contact point is published for one Member State, whose facts the console then reads.
  if (c.CONTACT_POINT !== undefined && c.HOME_STATE === undefined) refuse("HOME_STATE", "HOME_STATE is required once CONTACT_POINT is set");
  // In every environment: an origin the app trusts is an allowed Origin for the app's cookie writes, a credentialed CORS
  // origin of the app's API and, outside production, an accepted origin for personal passkeys (3a design, section 8).
  if (c.CONSOLE_ORIGIN !== undefined) {
    if (sameOrigin(c.CONSOLE_ORIGIN, c.APP_ORIGIN)) refuse("CONSOLE_ORIGIN", "CONSOLE_ORIGIN must not be APP_ORIGIN: the staff console needs an origin of its own");
    if (c.TRUSTED_ORIGINS.some((origin) => sameOrigin(origin, c.CONSOLE_ORIGIN!))) {
      refuse("CONSOLE_ORIGIN", "CONSOLE_ORIGIN must not be listed in TRUSTED_ORIGINS: the app would accept the console's requests as its own");
    }
  }
  if (c.NODE_ENV !== "production") return;
  if (TURNSTILE_TEST_SECRET.test(c.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY)) refuse("TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY", "is a Turnstile test secret; production needs the secret of your own widget");
  if (!c.APP_ORIGIN.startsWith("https://")) refuse("APP_ORIGIN", "must be an https origin in production");
  for (const origin of c.TRUSTED_ORIGINS) if (!origin.startsWith("https://")) refuse("TRUSTED_ORIGINS", `${origin} is not an https origin`);
  // The development provider would hand the badge to anyone who types 000000.
  if (c.VERIFY_PROVIDER === "dev") refuse("VERIFY_PROVIDER", "VERIFY_PROVIDER=dev is for development only");
  if (c.VERIFY_PROVIDER === "vonage") {
    if (!c.VONAGE_API_KEY) refuse("VONAGE_API_KEY", "is required when VERIFY_PROVIDER is vonage");
    if (!c.VONAGE_API_SECRET) refuse("VONAGE_API_SECRET", "is required when VERIFY_PROVIDER is vonage");
  }
  // Browsers accept an RP ID only on its own host or a subdomain of it, and never an address; localhost would
  // bind every passkey to one machine. The dot keeps a bare top-level name out (browsers refuse public suffixes
  // such as co.uk themselves).
  const host = hostOf(c.APP_ORIGIN);
  const rpId = c.WEBAUTHN_RP_ID ?? host;
  if (isIP(rpId) || isIP(host)) {
    refuse("WEBAUTHN_RP_ID", "WEBAUTHN_RP_ID cannot be an IP address, nor can APP_ORIGIN name one: WebAuthn refuses them, so production needs a domain name");
  } else if (isLocalhost(rpId) || isLocalhost(host)) {
    refuse("WEBAUTHN_RP_ID", "WEBAUTHN_RP_ID cannot be localhost in production, nor can APP_ORIGIN name it");
  } else if (rpId !== host && !(host.endsWith(`.${rpId}`) && rpId.includes("."))) {
    refuse("WEBAUTHN_RP_ID", `WEBAUTHN_RP_ID must be the host of APP_ORIGIN (${host}) or a parent domain of it that has a dot`);
  }
  if (c.CONSOLE_ORIGIN === undefined) return;
  if (!c.CONSOLE_ORIGIN.startsWith("https://")) refuse("CONSOLE_ORIGIN", "CONSOLE_ORIGIN must be an https origin in production");
  const consoleHost = hostOf(c.CONSOLE_ORIGIN);
  // Ports separate neither sites nor cookies, so the console needs a hostname of its own. On a parent domain of the app's
  // hostname, the app's pages could ask for staff keys, whose relying party ID would then cover the app.
  if (consoleHost === host) refuse("CONSOLE_ORIGIN", `CONSOLE_ORIGIN must not be on the hostname of APP_ORIGIN (${host}), whatever its port`);
  if (host.endsWith(`.${consoleHost}`)) refuse("CONSOLE_ORIGIN", `APP_ORIGIN's hostname must not be a subdomain of the console's (${consoleHost})`);
  // The relying-party rules, like the app's above, bind staff keys to the console alone.
  const consoleRpId = c.CONSOLE_RP_ID ?? consoleHost;
  if (isIP(consoleHost) || isLocalhost(consoleHost)) {
    refuse("CONSOLE_RP_ID", "CONSOLE_RP_ID cannot be an IP address or localhost in production, nor can CONSOLE_ORIGIN name one: production needs a domain name");
  } else if (consoleRpId !== consoleHost) {
    refuse("CONSOLE_RP_ID", `CONSOLE_RP_ID must be the hostname of CONSOLE_ORIGIN (${consoleHost}) in production`);
  }
  if (consoleRpId === rpId) refuse("CONSOLE_RP_ID", `CONSOLE_RP_ID must differ from the app's relying party ID (${rpId}), so staff keys never work in the app`);
}).transform((c) => ({
  ...c,
  WEBAUTHN_RP_ID: c.WEBAUTHN_RP_ID ?? hostOf(c.APP_ORIGIN),
  CONSOLE_RP_ID: c.CONSOLE_RP_ID ?? (c.CONSOLE_ORIGIN === undefined ? undefined : hostOf(c.CONSOLE_ORIGIN)),
  NOTIFY: c.NOTIFY ?? (c.NODE_ENV === "production" ? "on" : "off"),
}));

export type Config = z.infer<typeof schema>;

export function loadConfig(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): Config {
  const result = schema.safeParse(env);
  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid environment:\n${z.prettifyError(result.error)}`);
  }
  return result.data;
}
```

```ts
  verify: verificationProviderFrom(config),
});

  storeDir: config.MEDIA_STORE_DIR,
  formats: config.MEDIA_FORMATS,

  reconcile: config.MEDIA_RECONCILE,
```
