```ts
/**
 * Authorities' orders (3f design, sections 5, 7.3 and 8.3). In this task: the messages at the contact point. The watcher
 * records that a message arrived and when, and never who sent it or what it says; a person reads it in the mail host's own
 * app, and then either opens an order from it (Task 2) or closes it here with what it was. Closing restricts nothing and
 * tells nobody, so it needs no key: one transaction, the disposition and then the audit row `contact_closed`.
 */

const PLACE = /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{6}Z$/;
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

/** The list's cursor: the last row's time of receipt to the microsecond and its id, as an opaque word. */
const encodeCursor = (row: { place: string; id: string }): string => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify([row.place, row.id]), "utf8").toString("base64url");

/** Reads a cursor back; anything this module did not write is refused, never guessed at. */
function decodeCursor(cursor: string): { place: string; id: string } {
  let parts: unknown;
  try {
    parts = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(cursor, "base64url").toString("utf8"));
  } catch {
    throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(parts) || parts.length !== 2) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  const [place, id] = parts as unknown[];
  if (typeof place !== "string" || !PLACE.test(place) || typeof id !== "string" || !UUID.test(id)) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  return { place, id };
}

/**
 * GET /api/staff/contact: the messages newest first by the time of receipt, CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE a page; with open=1 only
 * those without a disposition. No sender and no subject exist to show. Each carries the orders opened from it.
 */
export async function contactPage(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, query: ContactQuery): Promise<ContactPage> {
  const after = query.cursor === undefined ? null : decodeCursor(query.cursor);
  // One row more than a page, to know whether another page follows.
  const rows = await contactMessages(deps.apiDb, { open: query.open === "1", after, limit: CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE + 1 });
  const page = rows.slice(0, CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE);
  const orders = await ordersOfMessages(deps.apiDb, page.map((row) => row.id));
  return {
    items: page.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      folder: row.folder,
      receivedAt: row.receivedAt.toISOString(),
      seenAt: row.seenAt.toISOString(),
      stale: row.stale,
      disposition: row.disposition,
      handledAt: row.handledAt === null ? null : row.handledAt.toISOString(),
      handledBy: row.handledBy,
      orders: orders.get(row.id) ?? [],
    })),
    nextCursor: rows.length > CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE ? encodeCursor(page.at(-1)!) : null,
  };
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/contact/:message/close (section 7.3 step 3): the disposition and who set it, only while the message has
 * none (the trigger stamps when), then the audit row, last, with the disposition, the time of receipt and the folder. A
 * message that has a disposition already is message_handled, and a disposition never changes; an unknown id is
 * not_found.
 */
export async function closeContact(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, session: ActiveStaffSession, messageId: string, request: ContactCloseRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<void> {
  await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const closed = await closeMessage(tx, messageId, request.disposition, session.userId);
    if (closed === null) throw new ModerationError((await messageExists(tx, messageId)) ? "message_handled" : "not_found");
    await appendAuditRow(tx, {
      actorId: session.userId,
      action: "contact_closed",
      targetType: "contact_message",
      targetId: messageId,
      requestId: ctx.requestId,
      staffSession: session.handle,
      metadata: { disposition: request.disposition, receivedAt: closed.receivedAt.toISOString(), folder: closed.folder },
    });
  });
}

/**
 * StaffOverview.contact: the messages nobody has handled, the oldest one's time of receipt, and the earliest deadline of a
 * message that is not handled or of an order that still has an open item, also once it has passed (section 10.2).
 */
export async function contactOverview(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">): Promise<StaffOverview["contact"]> {
  const [counts, order] = await Promise.all([contactCounts(deps.apiDb), nearestOrderDeadline(deps.apiDb)]);
  const due = [counts.dueAt, order].filter((at): at is Date => at !== null).sort((a, b) => a.getTime() - b.getTime())[0] ?? null;
  return { open: counts.open, oldestAt: counts.oldestAt?.toISOString() ?? null, dueAt: due?.toISOString() ?? null };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- order records (3f design, sections 7.4, 7.5 and 7.8)

/** What a confirmed action of an order answers: its view, or that the confirming key or account ended, or the challenge ran out. */
export type OrderOutcome = OrderView | "ended" | "late";

/** The locks a recorded event may wait for: the order, the acting account, the message, the key and the audit head. */
const EVENT_WAITS = 5;
/** A correction's: the order, the acting account, the key and the audit head; and one more for each author's profile, decision and post. */
const CORRECTION_WAITS = 4;
/** A correction without a key has no challenge to count from: its lock waits end at this bound, as the command line's do. */
const CORRECTION_LOCK_MS = 10_000;

/** The sha256 of a link, in hex: a link is not copied into the audit chain (section 10.5), its digest and length are. */
const linkDigest = (link: string) => createHash("sha256").update(link, "utf8").digest("hex");

/** An item as the audit rows of opening and adding name it: by its post when its link resolved, else by its link's digest. */
function auditItem(item: WrittenItem): Record<string, unknown> {
  const base = { itemId: item.id, position: item.position, addedAt: item.addedAt.toISOString() };
  return item.postId !== null ? { ...base, postId: item.postId } : { ...base, linkSha256: linkDigest(item.link), linkLength: Array.from(item.link).length };
}

/** What an order's link names now, for its item: a link that named a post or an image with no post found names nothing. */
function linkKindOf(appOrigin: string, link: string, postId: string | null): OrderLinkKind {
  const target = orderLinkTarget(appOrigin, link);
  if ((target.kind === "post" || target.kind === "image") && postId === null) return "other";
  return target.kind;
}

/**
 * The links of an order as its items (section 7.4 step 2), resolved against the app's origin and never fetched: a post's
 * page names the post when a row of posts has it, in any state; an image's address names the post the image is attached
 * to (the media module's imagePost); a profile's page and anything else name no post. Two links that name one post, among
 * these and the order's items already, are refused (invalid_request, 422). A plain function of the module's index, for
 * the console's route and for `staff.js order-open`, on the caller's connection or transaction.
 */
export async function orderItemsFor(q: Db | DbTx, appOrigin: string, links: readonly string[], existingPostIds: readonly string[] = []): Promise<NewOrderItem[]> {
  const targets = links.map((link) => ({ link, target: orderLinkTarget(appOrigin, link) }));
  const named = await existingPosts(q, targets.flatMap(({ target }) => (target.kind === "post" ? [target.postId] : [])));
  const items: NewOrderItem[] = [];
  for (const { link, target } of targets) {
    let postId: string | null = null;
    if (target.kind === "post" && named.has(target.postId)) postId = target.postId;
    if (target.kind === "image") postId = await imagePost(q, target.mediaId);
    items.push({ link, postId });
  }
  const posts = [...existingPostIds, ...items.flatMap((item) => (item.postId === null ? [] : [item.postId]))];
  if (new Set(posts).size !== posts.length) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request", 422, "Two links name the same post.");
  return items;
}

/** Whether the order's issuing state is not the operator's; with no home state named, every order counts as from elsewhere. */
const crossBorderOf = (deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "config">, memberState: string) => deps.config.HOME_STATE === undefined || memberState !== deps.config.HOME_STATE;

/**
 * A refusal the database raised in an order's transaction, as the module's error: its codes, the shared invalid_request
 * (422 here: a member or an item the order does not take) and not_found; anything else is thrown as it is.
 */
function orderRefusal(err: unknown): ModerationError | null {
  const raised = raisedMessage(err);
  if (raised === "invalid_request") return new ModerationError("invalid_request", 422);
  if (raised === "not_found") return new ModerationError("not_found");
  if (raised === "rate_limited") return new ModerationError("rate_limited");
  if (raised !== null && isModerationErrorCode(raised)) return new ModerationError(raised);
  return null;
}

/** order_exists with the order that stands, read after the refusal, so the console links to it (section 7.4 step 5). */
async function orderExists(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, memberState: string, authority: string, reference: string): Promise<ModerationError> {
  const orderId = await orderByReference(deps.apiDb, memberState, authority, reference);
  return new ModerationError("order_exists", undefined, undefined, undefined, orderId === null ? undefined : { orderId });
}

/** The day's limit of order records, counted by the API before anything is written (section 7.4 step 1). */
async function checkRecordLimit(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, staffId: string): Promise<void> {
  const opened = await ordersOpenedToday(deps.apiDb, staffId);
  if (opened.count >= ORDER_RULES.recordsPerDay) throw new ModerationError("rate_limited", 429, undefined, opened.retryAfterSeconds);
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/orders (section 7.4): the day's limit; the message, which must exist (not_found; order_needs_message
 * when it went between the read and the insert); the links as items; then one transaction, the rows of insertOrder and
 * the audit row `order_opened` last. No key: the record restricts nothing, copies nothing and tells nobody. After the
 * commit every staff account is alerted (`order_opened`), with the count of items and the deadline, or that it is unknown.
 */
export async function openOrder(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, request: OrderOpenRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<OrderView> {
  await checkRecordLimit(deps, session.userId);
  if (request.messageId !== null && !(await messageExists(deps.apiDb, request.messageId))) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  const items = await orderItemsFor(deps.apiDb, deps.config.APP_ORIGIN, request.links);
  const crossBorder = crossBorderOf(deps, request.memberState);
  const id = randomUUID();
  let inserted: InsertedOrder;
  try {
    inserted = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', '10s', true)`);
      const written = await insertOrder(tx, {
        id,
        kind: request.kind,
        memberState: request.memberState,
        authority: request.authority,
        reference: request.reference,
        channel: request.channel,
        messageId: request.messageId,
        sectionC: request.sectionC,
        emergency: request.emergency,
        crossBorder,
        withholdFromAuthor: request.withholdFromAuthor,
        openedBy: session.userId,
        items,
      });
      await appendAuditRow(tx, {
        actorId: session.userId,
        action: "order_opened",
        targetType: "order",
        targetId: id,
        requestId: ctx.requestId,
        staffSession: session.handle,
        metadata: {
          kind: request.kind,
          memberState: request.memberState,
          authority: request.authority,
          reference: request.reference,
          channel: written.channel,
          messageId: request.messageId,
          receivedAt: written.receivedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
          sentAt: null,
          openedAt: written.openedAt.toISOString(),
          sectionC: request.sectionC,
          emergency: request.emergency,
          crossBorder,
          withholdFromAuthor: written.withholdFromAuthor,
          via: "console",
          items: written.items.map(auditItem),
        },
      });
      return written;
    });
  } catch (err) {
    if (violatedUniqueConstraint(err) === "legal_orders_reference_key") throw await orderExists(deps, request.memberState, request.authority, request.reference);
    const refusal = orderRefusal(err);
    if (refusal !== null) throw refusal.code === "rate_limited" ? new ModerationError("rate_limited", 429, undefined, (await ordersOpenedToday(deps.apiDb, session.userId)).retryAfterSeconds) : refusal;
    throw err;
  }
  // The deadline a removal order has from its receipt; none for a DSA order, and unknown for a removal order without one.
  const hasClock = request.kind === "tco_removal";
  const facts: AlertFacts = {
    items: inserted.items.length,
    ...(hasClock && inserted.receivedAt !== null ? { dueAt: new Date(inserted.receivedAt.getTime() + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000).toISOString() } : {}),
    unknown: hasClock && inserted.receivedAt === null ? 1 : 0,
  };
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    await staffAlert(deps, null, 0, { template: "order_opened", facts });
  });
  return (await orderView(deps, id, session))!;
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/orders/:order/items (section 7.4, "More items"): up to itemsPerAction more links to an order that is
 * not closed, up to ORDER_ITEMS_MAX in all, under the order's advisory lock so two additions take distinct positions; the
 * audit row `order_items_added` last. An item added after the order's verification is unverified until order-verify runs
 * again.
 */
export async function addItems(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, orderId: string, request: OrderItemsRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<OrderView> {
  const before = await orderRow(deps.apiDb, orderId);
  if (before === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  if (before.closedAt !== null) throw new ModerationError("order_closed");
  try {
    await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', '10s', true)`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(${`korbat.order_items:${orderId}`}, 0))`);
      const current = await orderItems(tx, orderId);
      if (current.length + request.links.length > ORDER_ITEMS_MAX) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request", 422, `An order holds at most ${ORDER_ITEMS_MAX} items.`);
      const items = await orderItemsFor(tx, deps.config.APP_ORIGIN, request.links, current.flatMap((item) => (item.postId === null ? [] : [item.postId])));
      const written = await addOrderItems(tx, orderId, items);
      await appendAuditRow(tx, {
        actorId: session.userId,
        action: "order_items_added",
        targetType: "order",
        targetId: orderId,
        requestId: ctx.requestId,
        staffSession: session.handle,
        metadata: { items: written.map(auditItem) },
      });
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const refusal = orderRefusal(err);
    if (refusal !== null) throw refusal;
    throw err;
  }
  return (await orderView(deps, orderId, session))!;
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/orders/:order/events, once its step-up verified (section 7.5): one transaction, its lock waits bounded
 * by the challenge's life; order_event_record decides everything under the order's row, with the session's account as
 * the acting one; then the audit row `order_event_recorded` through append_confirmed_audit, naming the event, which
 * legal_order_events_confirmed holds to it at commit. "ended" and "late" as for a decision; one more try after a deadlock
 * while the challenge has time.
 */
export async function recordEvent(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<OrderOutcome> {
  if (confirmed.action !== "order_event_recorded") throw new Error("only an order's event is recorded this way");
  const params = OrderEventRecordedParams.parse(confirmed.params);
  const orderId = confirmed.target.id;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      const outcome = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx): Promise<"done" | "late"> => {
        if (!(await boundLockWaits(tx, confirmed.expiresAt, EVENT_WAITS))) return "late";
        const eventId = await recordOrderEvent(tx, orderId, params.kind, params.ground, params.messageId, session.userId);
        const effectiveAt = await eventEffectiveAt(tx, eventId);
        await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
          actorId: session.userId,
          keyId: confirmed.keyId,
          action: "order_event_recorded",
          targetType: "order",
          targetId: orderId,
          metadata: { params: confirmed.params, eventId, effectiveAt },
          staffSession: session.handle,
          actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
          stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
          requestId: ctx.requestId,
          expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
        });
        return "done";
      });
      if (outcome === "late") return "late";
      return (await orderView(deps, orderId, session))!;
    } catch (err) {
      const raised = raisedMessage(err);
      if (raised === "staff_confirmation_ended") return "ended";
      if (raised === "staff_confirmation_late") return "late";
      const refusal = orderRefusal(err);
      if (refusal !== null) throw refusal;
      if (!isDeadlock(err) && !isBoundReached(err)) throw err;
      if (attempt > 1 || confirmed.expiresAt.getTime() - deps.now().getTime() <= RETRY_MARGIN_MS) return "late";
    }
  }
}

/** A correction's member as its audit row names it: the request's word and the row's old value, never a text about a person. */
const CORRECTED_MEMBERS = ["kind", "memberState", "authority", "reference", "channel", "sectionC", "emergency", "withholdFromAuthor", "crossBorder"] as const;
const rowValue = (row: OrderRow, member: (typeof CORRECTED_MEMBERS)[number]): unknown =>
  ({ kind: row.kind, memberState: row.memberState, authority: row.authority, reference: row.reference, channel: row.channel, sectionC: row.sectionC, emergency: row.emergency, withholdFromAuthor: row.withholdFromAuthor, crossBorder: row.crossBorder })[member];

/**
 * POST /api/staff/orders/:order/correct (section 7.4, "Correcting what a person entered"): one transaction. For an order
 * that is given effect the authors of its disabled posts are locked first, "no key update" in id order, as the effect
 * transaction begins; then order_correct, to whose facts the API adds crossBorder with memberState, decides under the
 * order's row which rule allows it (entry, caution, admin) and writes it; then the audit row `order_corrected`, with the
 * rule, the changed members (old and new values; a closed item as its id and reason) and the event, through
 * append_confirmed_audit under a key and as a plain row otherwise. A correction under the rule admin without a key is
 * "step_up_required", and nothing is kept. A deadlock or a bound reached runs the transaction once more (order_correct
 * takes the order's items before its row, as the effect does, so the two no longer meet that way). After the commit
 * every staff account is alerted (`order_corrected`).
 */
export async function correctOrderRecord(
  deps: ModerationDeps,
  session: ActiveStaffSession,
  orderId: string,
  facts: OrderCorrectFacts,
  confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed | null,
  ctx: { requestId: string },
): Promise<OrderOutcome | "step_up_required"> {
  if (confirmed !== null && (confirmed.action !== "order_corrected" || confirmed.target.id !== orderId)) throw new Error("a correction's key confirms that correction");
  const dbFacts: Record<string, unknown> = { ...facts };
  if (facts.memberState !== undefined) dbFacts.crossBorder = crossBorderOf(deps, facts.memberState);
  let changed: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
  let counted = 0;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      const outcome = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx): Promise<"done" | "late" | "step_up_required"> => {
        const before = await orderRow(tx, orderId);
        if (before === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
        const authors = before.givenEffect ? await disabledAuthors(tx, orderId) : [];
        const waits = CORRECTION_WAITS + authors.length + 2 * before.items;
        if (confirmed !== null) {
          if (!(await boundLockWaits(tx, confirmed.expiresAt, waits))) return "late";
        } else {
          await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', ${`${CORRECTION_LOCK_MS}ms`}::text, true)`);
        }
        if (authors.length > 0) await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, authors, "no key update");
        const eventId = await correctOrder(tx, orderId, dbFacts, session.userId);
        const rule = await eventGround(tx, eventId);
        // Under the rule admin a key must confirm: without one, the transaction's rows go.
        if (rule === "admin" && confirmed === null) throw new StepUpNeeded();
        const after = (await orderRow(tx, orderId))!;
        changed = CORRECTED_MEMBERS.filter((member) => member in dbFacts && rowValue(before, member) !== rowValue(after, member)).map((member) => ({
          member,
          from: rowValue(before, member),
          to: rowValue(after, member),
        }));
        for (const item of facts.closeItems ?? []) changed.push({ member: "closeItems", itemId: item.itemId, reason: item.reason });
        counted = changed.length;
        const metadata = { rule, changed, eventId, ...(confirmed !== null ? { params: confirmed.params } : {}) };
        if (confirmed !== null) {
          await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
            actorId: session.userId,
            keyId: confirmed.keyId,
            action: "order_corrected",
            targetType: "order",
            targetId: orderId,
            metadata,
            staffSession: session.handle,
            actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
            stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
            requestId: ctx.requestId,
            expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
          });
        } else {
          await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: session.userId, action: "order_corrected", targetType: "order", targetId: orderId, requestId: ctx.requestId, staffSession: session.handle, metadata });
        }
        return "done";
      }).catch((err: unknown) => {
        // A correction the key must confirm, sent without one: the transaction's rows go, and nothing is kept.
        if (err instanceof StepUpNeeded) return "step_up_required" as const;
        throw err;
      });
      if (outcome !== "done") return outcome;
      break;
    } catch (err) {
      const raised = raisedMessage(err);
      if (raised === "staff_confirmation_ended") return "ended";
      if (raised === "staff_confirmation_late") return "late";
      if (raised === "order_exists") {
        const now = await orderRow(deps.apiDb, orderId);
        throw await orderExists(deps, facts.memberState ?? now?.memberState ?? "", facts.authority ?? now?.authority ?? "", facts.reference ?? now?.reference ?? "");
      }
      const refusal = orderRefusal(err);
      if (refusal !== null) throw refusal;
      // 3f's review (database4): a deadlock or a bound reached changed nothing; the transaction runs once more, while a
      // key's challenge has more than a minute left, and a second time it answers a refusal, never an error: "late" under a
      // key, and service_unavailable without one, so the person tries again.
      if (!isDeadlock(err) && !isBoundReached(err)) throw err;
      if (attempt > 1 || (confirmed !== null && confirmed.expiresAt.getTime() - deps.now().getTime() <= RETRY_MARGIN_MS)) {
        if (confirmed !== null) return "late";
        throw new ModerationError("service_unavailable");
      }
    }
  }
  const at = deps.now().toISOString();
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    await staffAlert(deps, null, 0, { template: "order_corrected", facts: { count: counted, at } });
  });
  return (await orderView(deps, orderId, session))!;
}

/** Thrown inside a correction's transaction to roll it back when the rule needs a key that was not sent. */
class StepUpNeeded extends Error {}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the reads

/**
 * An order's state on the list (section 10.2): closed; for a DSA order given_effect once it is given effect in full,
 * else no_clock; for a removal order given_effect only once it is given effect in full (every item disabled or closed
 * with a reason, one at least disabled), and while an item is open the state of its clock.
 */
function stateOf(row: OrderRow, now: number): OrderState {
  if (row.closedAt !== null) return "closed";
  const inFull = row.givenEffect && row.itemsOpen === 0;
  const clock = row.clock;
  if (row.kind !== "tco_removal" || clock === null) return inFull ? "given_effect" : "no_clock";
  if (inFull) return "given_effect";
  if (clock.stopped) return "stopped";
  if (clock.clockStart === null || clock.deadlineAt === null) return "unknown_deadline";
  return Date.parse(clock.deadlineAt) < now ? "overdue" : "running";
}

function summaryOf(row: OrderRow): OrderSummary {
  const now = Date.parse(row.now);
  return {
    id: row.id,
    kind: row.kind,
    memberState: row.memberState as OrderSummary["memberState"],
    authority: row.authority,
    reference: row.reference,
    openedAt: row.openedAt,
    state: stateOf(row, now),
    clock: row.clock,
    dueAt: row.kind === "tco_removal" ? null : row.dueAt,
    closedAt: row.closedAt,
    closeGround: row.closeGround,
    items: row.items,
    itemsInForce: row.itemsInForce,
    verified: row.verifiedAt !== null,
    noticesHeld: row.noticesHeld,
  };
}

/** The deadline a summary sorts by: a running clock's, a DSA order's, or none (after every deadline). */
const sortKey = (summary: OrderSummary): number => {
  if (summary.state === "unknown_deadline") return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  const due = summary.clock?.deadlineAt ?? summary.dueAt;
  return due === null ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : Date.parse(due);
};

/** GET /api/staff/orders (section 7.5): the orders not closed, the nearest deadline first, then those closed in the last 30 days. */
export async function ordersPage(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">): Promise<OrdersPage> {
  const rows = (await orderRows(deps.apiDb)).map(summaryOf);
  const open = rows.filter((order) => order.closedAt === null).sort((a, b) => sortKey(a) - sortKey(b) || b.openedAt.localeCompare(a.openedAt));
  const closed = rows.filter((order) => order.closedAt !== null).sort((a, b) => b.closedAt!.localeCompare(a.closedAt!));
  return { open, closed };
}

/** Which console events order_event_record would take now from this account (an aid for the console: the database decides). */
function eventsAllowed(row: OrderRow, admin: boolean): OrderConsoleEvent[] {
  const closed = row.closedAt !== null;
  const tco = row.kind === "tco_removal";
  const stopped = row.clock?.stopped ?? false;
  const allowed: OrderConsoleEvent[] = [];
  if (!closed && tco && !stopped) allowed.push("annex3_sent");
  if (!closed && tco && stopped && row.clock?.stopGround === "force_majeure") allowed.push("grounds_ceased");
  if (!closed && tco && stopped && row.clock?.stopGround !== "force_majeure") allowed.push("clarification_received");
  if (!closed && tco && row.givenEffect) allowed.push("annex2_sent");
  if (!closed && !tco) allowed.push("receipt_confirmed");
  if (admin && !closed && row.itemsInForce === 0) allowed.push("closed_without_effect");
  if (admin && closed) allowed.push("reopened");
  if (admin && !closed && tco && row.sectionC && !row.holdExtended && row.holdEndedAt === null && row.releasedAt === null) allowed.push("hold_extended");
  return allowed;
}

/** What the command line still owes an order (section 7.5). */
function owedOf(row: OrderRow, now: number): OrderView["owed"] {
  const scrutinyEnd = row.receivedAt === null ? null : Date.parse(row.receivedAt) + ORDER_SCRUTINY_HOURS * 3_600_000;
  return {
    received: row.receivedAt === null,
    verification: row.verifiedAt === null || row.itemsUnverified,
    issuedAt: row.kind === "tco_removal" && row.sectionC && row.issuedAt === null,
    texts: row.kind !== "dsa_art10" && (!row.hasReasons || !row.hasRedress || (row.kind === "dsa_art9" && !row.hasScope)),
    document: !row.hasDocument,
    holdUntil: row.kind !== "tco_removal" && row.sectionC && row.holdOpen,
    tellPerson: row.kind === "dsa_art10" && row.tellPerson === null,
    scrutinyUntil:
      row.kind === "tco_removal" && row.crossBorder && !row.scrutinyRequested && scrutinyEnd !== null && scrutinyEnd > now ? new Date(scrutinyEnd).toISOString() : null,
  };
}

/** GET /api/staff/orders/:order (section 7.5), as the given account may act on it; null for an unknown order. */
export async function orderView(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "config" | "media">, orderId: string, viewer: Pick<ActiveStaffSession, "role">): Promise<OrderView | null> {
  const row = await orderRow(deps.apiDb, orderId);
  if (row === null) return null;
  const [items, events, gapped] = await Promise.all([orderItems(deps.apiDb, orderId), orderEvents(deps.apiDb, orderId), itemsWithOpenGaps(deps.apiDb, orderId)]);
  const images = await imageCounts(deps.apiDb, items.flatMap((item) => (item.postId === null ? [] : [item.postId])));
  // 3d Task 3 (sections 7.4 and 8.4): the purge lines of each disabled item's images, through the media module, which alone
  // names the edge's outbox; an item never disabled has none.
  const purges = await deps.media.postPurges(items.flatMap((item) => (item.postId !== null && item.disabledAt !== null ? [item.postId] : [])));
  const now = Date.parse(row.now);
  const admin = viewer.role === "admin";
  const summary = summaryOf(row);
  return {
    ...summary,
    channel: row.channel,
    messageId: row.messageId,
    receivedAt: row.receivedAt,
    sentAt: row.sentAt,
    issuedAt: row.issuedAt,
    sectionC: row.sectionC,
    emergency: row.emergency,
    crossBorder: row.crossBorder,
    withholdFromAuthor: row.withholdFromAuthor,
    preserve: row.preserve,
    openedBy: row.openedBy,
    openedVia: row.openedVia,
    importedAt: row.importedAt,
    tellPerson: row.kind === "dsa_art10" && row.tellPerson !== null ? { rule: row.tellPerson, at: row.tellPersonAt } : null,
    items: items.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id,
      position: item.position,
      link: item.link,
      linkKind: linkKindOf(deps.config.APP_ORIGIN, item.link, item.postId),
      addedAt: item.addedAt,
      unverified: row.verifiedAt === null || Date.parse(item.addedAt) > Date.parse(row.verifiedAt),
      postId: item.postId,
      post:
        item.post === null
          ? null
          : {
              authorHandle: item.post.authorHandle,
              state: item.post.state as NonNullable<OrderItemView["post"]>["state"],
              images: images.get(item.postId!) ?? 0,
              // A post that is not public shows its state's word and no text: the order's screen is no second way to read it.
              preview: item.post.state === "visible" ? Array.from(item.post.body).slice(0, ORDER_ITEM_PREVIEW).join("") : null,
              createdAt: item.post.createdAt,
              deletedOn: item.post.deletedOn,
            },
      decisionId: item.decisionId,
      caseId: item.caseId,
      inForce: item.inForce,
      disabledAt: item.disabledAt,
      noEffect: item.noEffect,
      preserveUntil: item.preserveUntil,
      preserveEndedAt: item.preserveEndedAt,
      erasedAt: item.erasedAt,
      reinstatedAt: item.reinstatedAt,
      reinstatedGround: item.reinstatedGround,
      closedAt: item.closedAt,
      closedReason: item.closedReason,
      // Task 6: an open restore gap names the item, whose disabling the restore lost: "Disable for an order" takes it again.
      gap: gapped.has(item.id),
      purges: item.postId !== null && item.disabledAt !== null ? (purges.get(item.postId) ?? []) : [],
    })),
    events: events.map((event) => ({ ...event })),
    owed: owedOf(row, now),
    hold: row.sectionC
      ? {
          until: row.holdUntil,
          basis: row.kind === "tco_removal" ? "regulation" : "authority",
          open: row.holdOpen,
          extended: row.holdExtended,
          endedAt: row.holdEndedAt,
          endReason: row.holdEndReason,
          releasedAt: row.releasedAt,
          noticesHeld: row.noticesHeld,
        }
      : null,
    mayClose: admin && row.closedAt === null && row.itemsInForce === 0,
    mayEvents: eventsAllowed(row, admin),
    mayCorrect: row.closedAt !== null ? null : !row.givenEffect ? "entry" : admin ? "admin" : "caution",
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- giving effect (Task 3, section 7.6)

/**
 * The lock waits of "Disable for an order" on `n` items (section 7.6, step 1): once the order, the deciding account's
 * row, the cap's advisory lock, the key and the audit head; and for each item the author's profile, the case, the item's
 * row, the account's row, the post and up to four images.
 */
export const ORDER_EFFECT_WAITS = (n: number) => 5 + 9 * n;

/** The order's facts as the key signs them (10.3), from its row: what the effect compares, member by member. */
const signedFacts = (row: OrderRow) => ({
  kind: row.kind,
  memberState: row.memberState,
  authority: row.authority,
  reference: row.reference,
  sectionC: row.sectionC,
  emergency: row.emergency,
  withholdFromAuthor: row.withholdFromAuthor,
});

/**
 * The rows of "Disable for an order" inside the effect's transaction, after the authors' profiles are held and before
 * the audit row (section 7.6, steps 3 to 5): one intake of the kind order (channel authority, no sender, no text, no
 * receipt); for each item in post order the post's open case and the intake's item, whose attach trigger takes the case,
 * then the item's intake_item_id; for each item in post order a snapshot of its own, the order decision and its one
 * disable_by_order, whose triggers force everything else. Answers each item's decision. The module's tests call it with
 * an audit row of their own, to meet decision_holds' refusals.
 *
 * Once every item's row is held, an item that is closed now and was not in `closedAtRead` (the items the effect found
 * closed when it read the order) is refused as order_changed (3f's review, database4): a correction that closed it
 * committed while the effect waited for its row, or before the effect ran again after a deadlock, and the key signed
 * the effect on an item that was open. An item closed already when the person chose it is given effect, as built.
 */
export async function effectRows(
  deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "social" | "media">,
  tx: DbTx,
  deciderId: string,
  params: OrderEffectedParams,
  closedAtRead: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(),
): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const ordered = ORDER_DECISION[params.kind];
  const intakeId = await insertIntake(tx, {
    kind: "order",
    ref: newRef(),
    lookupHash: null,
    channel: "authority",
    reporterId: null,
    findingBy: null,
    contactId: null,
    ruleId: null,
    allegesIllegal: true,
    csam: false,
    category: ordered.category,
    categoryKeyword: null,
    citedLaw: null,
    explanation: null,
    bonaFide: false,
  });
  // The cases in their targets' order, each taken by its intake item's attach trigger before any post is locked.
  const cases = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const [index, item] of params.items.entries()) {
    const caseId = await openCase(tx, "post", item.postId);
    if (caseId === null) throw new ModerationError("case_closed");
    const inserted = await insertItem(tx, { intakeId, caseId, targetType: "post", targetId: item.postId, position: index + 1, lane: 0, mediaId: null, namedHandle: null });
    await setItemIntake(tx, item.itemId, inserted.id);
    cases.set(item.itemId, caseId);
  }
  // A statement of its own after the item locks: a closing that committed meanwhile is read here.
  const closedNow = await closedItems(tx, params.items.map((item) => item.itemId));
  if ([...closedNow].some((id) => !closedAtRead.has(id))) throw new ModerationError("order_changed");
  const takenAt = await snapshotTime(tx);
  const decisionIds: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const item of params.items) {
    const caseId = cases.get(item.itemId)!;
    // Each item gets a snapshot of its own, also when the case's newest is equal: the preservation keeps this row.
    const post = await deps.social.capturePost(tx, item.postId);
    if (!post) throw new ModerationError("order_changed");
    const held = await deps.media.hold(tx, [{ caseId, postId: item.postId }]);
    const snapshot = await storeSnapshot(tx, takenAt, {
      caseId,
      targetType: "post",
      targetId: item.postId,
      authorHandle: post.authorHandle,
      postState: post.state,
      postCreatedAt: post.createdAt.toISOString(),
      replyToId: post.replyToId,
      quoteOfId: post.quoteOfId,
      body: post.body,
      media: held.get(item.postId) ?? [],
      displayName: null,
      bio: null,
      handle: null,
    });
    const decisionId = randomUUID();
    await insertOrderDecision(tx, {
      id: decisionId,
      caseId,
      itemId: item.itemId,
      stateVersion: await caseVersion(tx, caseId),
      rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION,
      redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION,
      category: ordered.category,
      keyword: ordered.keyword,
      snapshotId: snapshot.id,
      snapshotDigest: snapshot.digest,
      decidedBy: deciderId,
    });
    await insertAction(tx, decisionId, { kind: "disable_by_order", mediaId: null });
    decisionIds[item.itemId] = decisionId;
  }
  return decisionIds;
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/orders/:order/effect, once its step-up verified (section 7.6): "Disable for an order" on up to ten items
 * with one key touch.
 *
 * Before the transaction (reads; the database decides again): the order exists (not_found), is open (order_closed) and
 * is no order to provide information (invalid_decision); an unverified DSA Article 9 order is given effect only by an
 * admin who signed `urgent` (order_not_verified); the signed facts equal the order's row and every item is the order's
 * and names its post (order_changed: the console reads the order again); each post's author is read.
 *
 * The transaction, in section 5's lock order: the bound on its lock waits; the authors' profiles "no key update" in one
 * statement; one intake of the kind order (channel authority, no sender, no text, no receipt); for each item in post
 * order the post's open case and the intake's item, whose attach trigger takes the case, then the item's intake_item_id;
 * for each item in post order a snapshot of its own, the order decision and its one disable_by_order, whose triggers
 * force everything else; last the audit row order_effected with the params and decisionIds. decision_holds holds each
 * decision to that row at commit. A deadlock or a bound reached runs it once more while more than a minute of the
 * challenge is left; a case that closed under it (case_closed) once more too.
 *
 * After the commit, each in a try of its own: what follows a decision (the statement's mail for a told notice, the
 * count of the account's decisions), and the alert order_effected to every staff account.
 */
export async function giveEffect(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<OrderOutcome> {
  // A confirmation of anything else never gives effect: a wiring fault, not a refusal.
  if (confirmed.action !== "order_effected" || confirmed.target.type !== "order" || confirmed.keyId !== session.keyId) throw new Error("an effect needs the step-up that confirmed it");
  const params = OrderEffectedParams.parse(confirmed.params);
  const orderId = confirmed.target.id;
  const row = await orderRow(deps.apiDb, orderId);
  if (row === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  if (row.closedAt !== null) throw new ModerationError("order_closed");
  if (row.kind === "dsa_art10") throw new ModerationError("invalid_decision");
  if (row.kind === "dsa_art9" && row.verifiedAt === null && !(session.role === "admin" && params.urgent)) throw new ModerationError("order_not_verified");
  const signed = { kind: params.kind, memberState: params.memberState, authority: params.authority, reference: params.reference, sectionC: params.sectionC, emergency: params.emergency, withholdFromAuthor: params.withholdFromAuthor };
  if (JSON.stringify(signed) !== JSON.stringify(signedFacts(row))) throw new ModerationError("order_changed");
  const items = await effectItems(deps.apiDb, orderId, params.items.map((item) => item.itemId));
  const byId = new Map(items.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
  if (params.items.some((item) => byId.get(item.itemId)?.postId !== item.postId)) throw new ModerationError("order_changed");
  const closedAtRead = new Set(items.filter((item) => item.closed).map((item) => item.id));
  // A post's author never changes; a post purged since the read has none, and the person reads the order again.
  const authors = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const item of params.items) {
    const author = await deps.social.postAuthor(item.postId);
    if (author === null) throw new ModerationError("order_changed");
    authors.set(item.postId, author);
  }
  // Task 6 (7.6 step 5): after a restore, the open gaps of the class order_effect that name one of these items; the
  // request carries nothing for them, and the transaction closes each with its item's decision.
  const gaps = await openEffectGaps(deps.apiDb, params.items.map((item) => item.itemId));
  let decisionIds: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      const outcome = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx): Promise<"done" | "late"> => {
        if (!(await boundLockWaits(tx, confirmed.expiresAt, ORDER_EFFECT_WAITS(params.items.length)))) return "late";
        await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [...new Set(authors.values())].sort(), "no key update");
        decisionIds = await effectRows(deps, tx, session.userId, params, closedAtRead);
        // Each gap after the ledger rows and before the audit row (7.6 step 6), in the items' order, so the decisions'
        // own check at commit covers the closings. The audit row names them, item by item, as a decision's names its gap.
        const gapIds: Record<string, string> = {};
        for (const item of params.items) {
          const gap = gaps.get(item.itemId);
          if (gap === undefined) continue;
          await closeGap(tx, gap, decisionIds[item.itemId]!, session.userId);
          gapIds[item.itemId] = gap;
        }
        await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
          actorId: session.userId,
          keyId: confirmed.keyId,
          action: "order_effected",
          targetType: "order",
          targetId: orderId,
          metadata: { params: confirmed.params, decisionIds, ...(Object.keys(gapIds).length > 0 ? { gapIds } : {}) },
          staffSession: session.handle,
          actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
          stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
          requestId: ctx.requestId,
          expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
        });
        return "done";
      });
      if (outcome === "late") return "late";
      break;
    } catch (err) {
      const raised = raisedMessage(err);
      if (raised === "staff_confirmation_ended") return "ended";
      if (raised === "staff_confirmation_late") return "late";
      const retryable = isDeadlock(err) || isBoundReached(err) || isSerializationFailure(err) || (err instanceof ModerationError && err.code === "case_closed");
      if (!retryable) {
        if (err instanceof ModerationError) throw err;
        const refusal = orderRefusal(err);
        if (refusal !== null) {
          const detail = raisedDetail(err);
          if (detail !== null) deps.log.info({ refusal: refusal.code, detail }, "moderation: an order's effect was refused");
          throw refusal;
        }
        throw err;
      }
      if (attempt > 1 || confirmed.expiresAt.getTime() - deps.now().getTime() <= RETRY_MARGIN_MS) {
        if (err instanceof ModerationError && err.code === "case_closed") throw err;
        return "late";
      }
    }
  }
  const view = (await orderView(deps, orderId, session))!;
  const decided = Object.values(decisionIds);
  for (const decisionId of decided) deps.background.start(() => afterDecision(deps, session.userId, decisionId));
  const at = deps.now().toISOString();
  const itemsOpen = view.items.filter((item) => item.disabledAt === null && item.closedAt === null).length;
  const urgent = params.urgent && row.kind === "dsa_art9" && row.verifiedAt === null ? 1 : 0;
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    await staffAlert(deps, null, 0, { template: "order_effected", facts: { items: decided.length, at, itemsOpen, urgent } });
  });
  return view;
}
```

### Replace `infra/.env.example` (whole file)

```text
# Copy to infra/.env and change every password. Never commit infra/.env.
POSTGRES_USER=postgres
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=change-me-superuser
POSTGRES_DB=korbat
KORBAT_MIGRATE_DB_PASSWORD=change-me-migrate
KORBAT_API_DB_PASSWORD=change-me-api
KORBAT_AUTH_DB_PASSWORD=change-me-auth
# The database role of the contact point's watcher, notify (3f). infra/postgres/init/01-roles.sh makes it on a new data
# directory; on one that exists the README's Upgrading makes it once. notify's own settings are below, under 3f.
KORBAT_NOTIFY_DB_PASSWORD=change-me-notify
# Valkey (the session cache and rate-limit counters) refuses every command without it.
REDIS_PASSWORD=change-me-redis

# Images. The formats korbat accepts: remove one to refuse it and keep its decoder blocked, for
# example after a security advisory against that decoder, then restart api and worker.
MEDIA_FORMATS=jpeg,png,webp,gif,avif
# Uploads are refused while a media volume has less free space than this many bytes (2 GiB). The
# volumes share a disk with Postgres, and a full disk stops the database.
MEDIA_MIN_FREE_BYTES=2147483648
# The sweeper's pass that deletes images without a database row: on refuses when there are many of
# them (a database restored from an older snapshot looks like that), off skips it during a restore,
# force deletes them once you have checked.
MEDIA_RECONCILE=on

API_LOG_LEVEL=info
# Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API cross-origin. Empty in prod (same origin via Caddy).
API_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:8081

# Auth. `node scripts/gen-dev-env.mjs` fills the keys with random values and shares them with apps/api/.env.
# Origin the web app is served from (Caddy). Production: https://<your domain>.
API_APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8080
# Which header names the client: cloudflare when the tunnel is the only way in (the API then trusts
# cf-connecting-ip), caddy when Caddy's port is reachable directly. Never none behind a proxy.
API_TRUST_PROXY=caddy
API_AUTH_HMAC_KEY=change-me-key-auth-hmac
API_IP_HASH_KEY=change-me-key-ip-hash
API_TOTP_ENC_KEY=v1:change-me-key-totp
# Earlier TOTP keys, comma-separated, kept only while secrets they encrypted are still stored; a secret
# read with one is re-encrypted with API_TOTP_ENC_KEY.
API_TOTP_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS=
# Encrypts what a signed-out notifier leaves to be told about their notice: a name, an address and the token of the
# mails' link. Keep it secret and backed up as API_TOTP_ENC_KEY is: without it korbat can neither mail a notifier nor
# say who sent a notice.
API_NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY=v1:change-me-key-notifier
# Earlier notifier keys, comma-separated. A contact is never encrypted again, so a key stays here while a contact it
# encrypted is still stored.
API_NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS=
# Cloudflare's documented always-pass test secret. Production uses the secret of your Turnstile widget.
API_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY=1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA
# Mailpit from compose.dev.yml. Production: the EU relay, e.g. smtps://user:pass@smtp-relay.example:465
API_SMTP_URL=smtp://mailpit:1025
API_MAIL_FROM="korbat <no-reply@korbat.local>"
API_TERMS_VERSION=draft-2026-09
# Who checks the phone number behind the verified badge: off turns the badge off, dev accepts the code
# 000000 (development only; production refuses it), vonage texts a real code through Vonage Verify with the
# key and secret from the Vonage dashboard (the runbook in the 1b design says how).
API_VERIFY_PROVIDER=off
# Whether the web app's account settings show the verified badge section: on or off. Set it together with
# API_VERIFY_PROVIDER: off while that is off, on once it is dev or vonage (a section shown without a provider
# answers every Send code with "Verification is not available"). The web image reads it as EXPO_PUBLIC_BADGE,
# which Expo inlines at export time.
WEB_BADGE=off
API_VONAGE_API_KEY=
API_VONAGE_API_SECRET=
# The sender name of the verification text: 1 to 18 characters, none of / { } : $.
API_VERIFY_BRAND=korbat
# Passkeys. The RP ID every passkey is bound to: empty means the host of API_APP_ORIGIN. It may instead be a parent
# domain of that host (korbat.example for app.korbat.example). The staff console does not use it: staff keys have their
# own RP ID. Production refuses an IP address or localhost. Choose it before the first passkey is added: changing it
# later strands every passkey.
API_WEBAUTHN_RP_ID=
# The site name password managers show next to a korbat passkey: 1 to 64 printable characters; empty means korbat.
API_WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME=

# The staff console: the origin staff open it at, served by Caddy's second site (port 8090 in its container). Empty
# switches the console off: every /api/staff path then answers 404. It must differ from API_APP_ORIGIN and never appear
# in API_TRUSTED_ORIGINS. In development it is localhost on the port compose.dev.yml publishes the console on
# (DEV_CONSOLE_PORT below); open it there, never at 127.0.0.1. Production: https://<the console's own hostname>, a
# hostname apart from the app's.
API_CONSOLE_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8090
# The RP ID staff keys are bound to: empty means the hostname of API_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, which production requires. Choose
# the console's hostname before the first staff key is enrolled: moving the console later means enrolling every key
# again.
API_CONSOLE_RP_ID=

# Moderation. The hour of the UTC day, 0 to 23, at which the day's decisions on reports and notices are released to those
# who sent them, in one batch, so that nobody can tell from a mail's minute when a decision was made; empty means 7.
API_MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR=7
# The queue's emergency switch, published in the terms: on sorts cases whose open reports all come from unproven sources
# after the others of their lane, never below a less severe lane. off, the default, orders by lane and age alone.
API_MODERATION_DEFER_UNPROVEN=off
# The retention job, which erases what is due and deletes kept image rows that nothing retains any more: on unless set
# to off. While it is off nothing is erased or deleted, the API logs a warning at every start, and the console counts
# what is late. off only for a restore window: README, Restoring, step 5
API_MODERATION_RETENTION=on

# Authorities' orders and the alert channel (3f). Whether the API judges the alert channel's health: on mails "Phone
# alerts are down" when the watcher's beat or a push is late; off (the default outside production) only skips that
# check, and the console's home says that phone alerts are switched off on this server. Leave it off until the
# contact-point mailbox exists (README, Upgrading).
API_NOTIFY=off
# The operator's Member State, as an ISO code of a state whose facts the contracts hold (Germany's, DE, is the worked
# example), from which the console tells an order from another Member State; and the published contact point for
# authorities, an address. Leave the contact point empty until the owner's list is done (README, Before going public):
# the home state is required once it is set. The migrate service reads the home state too, for staff.js order-open.
API_HOME_STATE=DE
API_CONTACT_POINT=
# The report hold (3f): while a report of an account's sealed images to the authorities is owed, a deletion of the
# account keeps its email address, and nothing else of it, for at most seven days, and its deletion mail says so. on is
# the default; off restores the purge that overwrites the address at once, and then a report needs the address taken
# before the account is deleted (README, Notifications and hand-overs).
API_REPORT_HOLD=on
# The edge's purge (3d): when an image stops being public, the API asks the network provider to drop its copies at the
# edge, by prefix, several images a request. off (the default) asks nothing, and the image's header is then
# the only bound on a copy. test is for the suites and is refused while APP_SITE is open. cloudflare needs the zone's
# id, an API token with the one permission Zone, Cache Purge (a secret: keep it as the keys above are, and it is in no
# log line), and the public hostname images are served under, without a scheme or a path (README, The edge).
API_EDGE_PURGE=off
API_EDGE_ZONE_ID=
API_EDGE_API_TOKEN=
API_EDGE_HOST=
# The watcher and the push server run under the Compose profile notify, switched on here once the mailbox and the phones
# exist: COMPOSE_PROFILES=notify. Nothing below is needed for the stack to start while it is off. The mailbox: IMAP over
# TLS on port 993, an application password that can only read, and the name of the junk folder as the mail host names it.
# The publisher's ntfy token is also in infra/ntfy/server.yml; production refuses the example's.
# COMPOSE_PROFILES=notify
# NOTIFY_IMAP_HOST=
# NOTIFY_IMAP_USER=
# NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD=
# NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK=Junk
# NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN=
# The push network's fixed subnet, which the app's and the console's sites refuse; Caddy is on that network with
# the profile off too. The default lies outside the pools Docker gives its own networks (172.17.0.0/16 to 172.31.0.0/16,
# and 192.168.0.0/16): set another only if this host's own network uses it.
# PUSH_SUBNET=172.16.91.0/24
# The watcher's fixed address on that network, which infra/ntfy/server.yml exempts from ntfy's request limit
# (visitor-request-limit-exempt-hosts): with another subnet, set an address inside it here and in that file's line.
# NOTIFY_PUSH_IP=172.16.91.254

# The app's site (3f): open, or closed while a restored database is checked, when it answers 503 to every path, the
# API's included; the console's site stays open. Caddy reads it when it starts and refuses to start on any other value.
# The API reads it too (3d), when it starts: it refuses a test adapter while the site is open.
APP_SITE=open

# Public Turnstile site key baked into the web image. Cloudflare's always-pass test key for development;
# production uses the site key of the same widget as API_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.
WEB_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=1x00000000000000000000AA
# The address people write to when the report form does not work for them, to ask for their data, or about a decision.
# It is baked into the web image as EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL: the report form names it when the human check fails or
# the limits are reached, and the terms page shows it. The image refuses to build without an address, and a
# production build refuses a placeholder (a domain ending in .local, .localhost, .test, .invalid or .example, or
# example.com, example.org or example.net). A person reads this mailbox every working day.
WEB_CONTACT_EMAIL=contact@korbat.local
# 3f: the contact point for authorities and the Member State korbat is established in, baked into the web image as
# EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_POINT and EXPO_PUBLIC_HOME_STATE for the terms' sections on them: the page cannot read the API's
# API_CONTACT_POINT and API_HOME_STATE, which hold the same two values. The terms print the contact point only while it
# is set, and the image refuses a point without its state. Set both, with the API's, as the last step of the README's
# Before going public, then rebuild the caddy service.
WEB_CONTACT_POINT=
WEB_HOME_STATE=DE

# development or production. It is the API's NODE_ENV (production refuses Turnstile test keys, plain-http
# origins and a relay without TLS) and a build argument of the web image (production refuses the
# Turnstile test site key). Set it to production before building the images for the public.
KORBAT_ENV=development
# on when cloudflared is the only way in: Caddy then keeps CF-Connecting-IP for the API (and
# API_TRUST_PROXY is cloudflare). off drops the header, so nobody on the network can claim an address.
TUNNEL=off
# Cloudflare Tunnel token (Zero Trust > Networks > Tunnels). Only needed with --profile tunnel. The
# tunnel has three public hostnames: the app's, pointing at http://caddy:8080, the staff console's (the hostname of
# API_CONSOLE_ORIGIN), pointing at http://caddy:8090, and the phones' push hostname (3f), pointing at
# http://caddy:8091. Leave the HTTP Host Header setting of each empty, so the API sees the hostname the browser used.
TUNNEL_TOKEN=

# The development stack's host ports, read only by infra/compose.dev.yml. Set one when another container
# on this machine holds the default, and give apps/api/.env the same port. Defaults: 55432, 56379, 3000,
# 8080, 8090, 51025, 58025, 8091, 2586.
# DEV_PG_PORT=55432
# DEV_REDIS_PORT=56379
# DEV_API_PORT=3000
# DEV_CADDY_PORT=8080
# The staff console's port: API_CONSOLE_ORIGIN must name the same port on localhost (http://localhost:<port>).
# DEV_CONSOLE_PORT=8090
# DEV_SMTP_PORT=51025
# DEV_MAILPIT_PORT=58025
# 3f, with the profile notify: the push site, which a test client subscribes through, and ntfy's own port, which only
# `pnpm --filter @korbat/api notify:dev` publishes to (NOTIFY_PUSH_URL in apps/api/.env).
# DEV_PUSH_PORT=8091
# DEV_NTFY_PORT=2586
```

### Replace `infra/compose.yml` (whole file)

```yaml
name: korbat

x-logging: &logging
  driver: json-file
  options: { max-size: "20m", max-file: "5" }

x-node-common: &node-common
  restart: unless-stopped
  read_only: true
  tmpfs: ["/tmp"]
  security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
  logging: *logging

services:
  postgres:
    # PostgreSQL 18. From 18 on the image keeps the cluster under /var/lib/postgresql/<major>/docker, so
    # the volume is mounted one level up and a later major can pg_upgrade inside it. A cluster from the
    # earlier pgdata volume (PostgreSQL 16) is moved over by scripts/pg-major-upgrade.mjs.
    image: postgres:18.6-alpine@sha256:77f585114c32fbca283dc835b0596f4e52b51b4c6662d7810b2f4084f60a1873
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *logging
    mem_limit: 1g
    memswap_limit: 1g
    pids_limit: 256
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB}
      KORBAT_MIGRATE_DB_PASSWORD: ${KORBAT_MIGRATE_DB_PASSWORD}
      KORBAT_API_DB_PASSWORD: ${KORBAT_API_DB_PASSWORD}
      KORBAT_AUTH_DB_PASSWORD: ${KORBAT_AUTH_DB_PASSWORD}
      # The contact point's watcher's role (3f), which 01-roles.sh makes on a new data directory. Not required: a stack
      # without the watcher runs without it.
      KORBAT_NOTIFY_DB_PASSWORD: ${KORBAT_NOTIFY_DB_PASSWORD:-}
    volumes:
      - pgdata18:/var/lib/postgresql
      - ./postgres/init:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
    # watch: the watcher's own network to the database, which holds nothing else.
    networks: [data, watch]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER} -d ${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  redis:
    # Valkey, the BSD-licensed fork of Redis, under the service name the URLs already use. A password
    # is required: nothing on the data network may read the session cache without it.
    image: valkey/valkey:9.1.2-alpine@sha256:48332870af354a799964c0012ae1194a0bf2bf894eb508f945810596dc2d8d11
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *logging
    mem_limit: 384m
    memswap_limit: 384m
    pids_limit: 64
    environment:
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ${REDIS_PASSWORD:?set REDIS_PASSWORD in infra/.env}
    command: ["sh", "-c", "exec valkey-server --appendonly yes --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy noeviction --requirepass $$REDIS_PASSWORD"]
    volumes:
    # A fresh volume: Valkey 9 cannot read the RDB format 12 that Redis 7.4 wrote into `redisdata`, and that
    # volume held only transient state (limits, codes in flight, cached sessions, queued image jobs).
      - valkeydata:/data
    networks: [data]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "VALKEYCLI_AUTH=$$REDIS_PASSWORD valkey-cli ping | grep -q PONG"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  migrate:
    <<: *node-common
    restart: "no"
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: apps/api/Dockerfile
    command: ["node", "dist/migrate.js"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: postgres://korbat_migrate:${KORBAT_MIGRATE_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB}
      MIGRATIONS_DIR: /app/migrations
      # `staff.js enroll` runs here, as the migrator, the one role the running API never holds, and records on each link
      # the console's origin and relying party ID it is issued for. Empty, the console is off and enroll refuses.
      CONSOLE_ORIGIN: ${API_CONSOLE_ORIGIN:-}
      CONSOLE_RP_ID: ${API_CONSOLE_RP_ID:-}
      # 3f: staff.js order-open runs here too, and reads the home state (whether an order is cross-border) and the app's
      # origin (how a link is read, as the console's route reads it). Neither is required: enroll and the migrations run
      # without them, and order-open refuses with one sentence while either is empty.
      HOME_STATE: ${API_HOME_STATE:-}
      APP_ORIGIN: ${API_APP_ORIGIN:-}
    networks: [data]
    depends_on:
      postgres: { condition: service_healthy }

  api:
    <<: *node-common
    # The image's name, the one Compose gives it by default, written out: notify (3f) runs the same image, so it is
    # built once.
    image: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-api
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: apps/api/Dockerfile
      args:
        KORBAT_VERSION: ${KORBAT_VERSION:-0.0.0}
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    pids_limit: 256
    environment:
      # development or production, from infra/.env; production turns on the guards against test keys, plain-http
      # origins and a relay without TLS. The worker below always runs as production.
      NODE_ENV: ${KORBAT_ENV:?set KORBAT_ENV to development or production in infra/.env}
      PORT: "3000"
      LOG_LEVEL: ${API_LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      DATABASE_URL_API: postgres://korbat_api:${KORBAT_API_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB}
      DATABASE_URL_AUTH: postgres://korbat_auth:${KORBAT_AUTH_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB}
      REDIS_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD}@redis:6379
      TRUSTED_ORIGINS: ${API_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-}
      # Which header names the client: the stack refuses to start without a choice.
      TRUST_PROXY: ${API_TRUST_PROXY:?set API_TRUST_PROXY in infra/.env}
      # Auth settings. The stack refuses to start while any of these is missing from infra/.env.
      APP_ORIGIN: ${API_APP_ORIGIN:?set API_APP_ORIGIN in infra/.env}
      AUTH_HMAC_KEY: ${API_AUTH_HMAC_KEY:?set API_AUTH_HMAC_KEY in infra/.env}
      IP_HASH_KEY: ${API_IP_HASH_KEY:?set API_IP_HASH_KEY in infra/.env}
      TOTP_ENC_KEY: ${API_TOTP_ENC_KEY:?set API_TOTP_ENC_KEY in infra/.env}
      TOTP_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS: ${API_TOTP_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS:-}
      # Encrypts a signed-out notifier's name and address; earlier keys stay accepted for decryption.
      NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY: ${API_NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY:?set API_NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY in infra/.env}
      NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS: ${API_NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS:-}
      TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: ${API_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY:?set API_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY in infra/.env}
      SMTP_URL: ${API_SMTP_URL:?set API_SMTP_URL in infra/.env}
      MAIL_FROM: ${API_MAIL_FROM:?set API_MAIL_FROM in infra/.env}
      TERMS_VERSION: ${API_TERMS_VERSION:?set API_TERMS_VERSION in infra/.env}
      # The verified badge's phone check. off (the default) hides the badge; vonage needs the two credentials.
      VERIFY_PROVIDER: ${API_VERIFY_PROVIDER:-off}
      VONAGE_API_KEY: ${API_VONAGE_API_KEY:-}
      VONAGE_API_SECRET: ${API_VONAGE_API_SECRET:-}
      VERIFY_BRAND: ${API_VERIFY_BRAND:-korbat}
      # Passkeys. Empty values leave the API's defaults: the host of APP_ORIGIN as the RP ID and korbat as the name.
      WEBAUTHN_RP_ID: ${API_WEBAUTHN_RP_ID:-}
      WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME: ${API_WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME:-}
      # The staff console, served by Caddy's second site: the origin staff open it at, and the RP ID staff keys are bound
      # to (empty means the console's hostname). An empty origin switches the console off: every /api/staff path then
      # answers 404. The migrate service gets the same two values for `staff.js enroll`.
      CONSOLE_ORIGIN: ${API_CONSOLE_ORIGIN:-}
      CONSOLE_RP_ID: ${API_CONSOLE_RP_ID:-}
      # Moderation: the UTC hour of the daily release of decisions to those who reported, the queue's emergency switch, and
      # the retention job's switch, which is off only for a restore window (README, Restoring, step 5).
      MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR: ${API_MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR:-7}
      MODERATION_DEFER_UNPROVEN: ${API_MODERATION_DEFER_UNPROVEN:-off}
      MODERATION_RETENTION: ${API_MODERATION_RETENTION:-on}
      # Authorities' orders (3f): whether the alert tick judges the alert channel's health. Empty means on in production;
      # off until the contact point's mailbox exists (README, Upgrading).
      NOTIFY: ${API_NOTIFY:-}
      # The operator's Member State, a state whose facts the contracts hold (DE is filled in), and the published contact
      # point for authorities. Both empty until the owner's list is done; the home state is required once the contact
      # point is set.
      HOME_STATE: ${API_HOME_STATE:-}
      CONTACT_POINT: ${API_CONTACT_POINT:-}
      # 3f Task 5: whether a deletion keeps an account's address, at most seven days, while a report of its sealed images
      # to the authorities is owed. Empty means on; off restores the purge that overwrites the address at once.
      REPORT_HOLD: ${API_REPORT_HOLD:-}
      # 3d: the app's site switch, Caddy's (3f), handed to the API too, which refuses a test adapter while the site is open.
      APP_SITE: ${APP_SITE:-open}
      # 3d Task 3: the purge of an image's copies at the edge once it stops being public: off (empty, the default), test
      # (refused while APP_SITE is open) or cloudflare, which needs the zone's id, the API token with the one permission
      # Zone, Cache Purge, and the public hostname images are served under (README, The edge).
      EDGE_PURGE: ${API_EDGE_PURGE:-}
      EDGE_ZONE_ID: ${API_EDGE_ZONE_ID:-}
      EDGE_API_TOKEN: ${API_EDGE_API_TOKEN:-}
      EDGE_HOST: ${API_EDGE_HOST:-}
      # Images. The API writes uploads and only reads what the worker stored.
      MEDIA_UPLOADS_DIR: /media/uploads
      MEDIA_STORE_DIR: /media/store
      MEDIA_FORMATS: ${MEDIA_FORMATS:-jpeg,png,webp,gif,avif}
      MEDIA_MIN_FREE_BYTES: ${MEDIA_MIN_FREE_BYTES:-2147483648}
      MEDIA_RECONCILE: ${MEDIA_RECONCILE:-on}
    volumes:
      - media-uploads:/media/uploads
      - media-store:/media/store:ro
    networks: [app, data]
    depends_on:
      migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully }
      redis: { condition: service_healthy }
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  # The image worker runs the decoder, the most exploitable code in the stack. It has no network at
  # all, no credentials and no capabilities: it reads uploads and writes the store, and that is
  # everything it can reach. The memory limit was sized on worst-case images (2b design, Research).
  worker:
    <<: *node-common
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: apps/worker/Dockerfile
    network_mode: none
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    mem_limit: 768m
    memswap_limit: 768m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 64
    tmpfs: ["/tmp:size=64m"]
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      LOG_LEVEL: ${API_LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      MEDIA_UPLOADS_DIR: /media/uploads
      MEDIA_STORE_DIR: /media/store
      MEDIA_FORMATS: ${MEDIA_FORMATS:-jpeg,png,webp,gif,avif}
    volumes:
      - media-uploads:/media/uploads:ro
      - media-store:/media/store
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "process.exit(Date.now() - JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/media/store/heartbeat', 'utf8')).at < 60000 ? 0 : 1)"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 4

  # The contact point's watcher (3f design, section 5): the API's image with dist/notify.js, under the profile notify. It
  # reads the contact-point mailbox over IMAP and publishes the alerts to ntfy. On the network watch it reaches PostgreSQL
  # as korbat_notify, whose grants are four tables, and nothing else; on push it reaches ntfy. It never joins data, where
  # the API listens and the limit store is. It exits rather than hang, and Docker starts it again. No setting of it is
  # required by Compose: the program names the one it is missing and exits.
  notify:
    <<: *node-common
    image: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-api
    profiles: ["notify"]
    command: ["node", "dist/notify.js"]
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    # Measured in this image (3f Task 1): about 82 MB resident idle, a peak of 93 MB during a first read of 10,000 old
    # messages, which took 21 seconds and fell back to 81 MB; under this limit the container's peak was 85 MB, with no
    # kill. 128 MB keeps more than a third above that peak.
    mem_limit: 128m
    memswap_limit: 128m
    pids_limit: 64
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: ${KORBAT_ENV:-production}
      LOG_LEVEL: ${API_LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      DATABASE_URL_NOTIFY: postgres://korbat_notify:${KORBAT_NOTIFY_DB_PASSWORD:-}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-}
      NOTIFY_IMAP_HOST: ${NOTIFY_IMAP_HOST:-}
      NOTIFY_IMAP_USER: ${NOTIFY_IMAP_USER:-}
      NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD: ${NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD:-}
      NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK: ${NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK:-}
      NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN: ${NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN:-}
    # A fixed address on push (3f's review, operations3), which infra/ntfy/server.yml exempts from ntfy's request limit
    # (visitor-request-limit-exempt-hosts): ntfy lets any one address publish 60 times and then once every 5 seconds (lab
    # L1), which would hold an order's alert behind a flood of contact mail. It lies inside PUSH_SUBNET, at the top of
    # the range, which Docker hands out last; change it, and the file's line, with the subnet.
    networks:
      watch: {}
      push:
        ipv4_address: ${NOTIFY_PUSH_IP:-172.16.91.254}
    depends_on:
      migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully }
      ntfy: { condition: service_started }
    # The watcher writes the time of every round it ends; two minutes without one is a hang.
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "process.exit(Date.now() - Number(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/korbat-notify-beat', 'utf8')) < 120000 ? 0 : 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # The hand-over of one seal's files (3f design, sections 5 and 7.14), under the profile handover, started by the operator
  # alone: docker compose --profile handover run --rm -T -v <directory>:/handover handover < list > digests. The API's
  # image with dist/handover.js, which opens no database and no socket: no network at all, no credential, no capability,
  # the image store and (3d) the quarantine read-only, the quarantine looked in first. It has no bind mount here: the
  # directory for the archive is an argument of the command (an empty source would stop every Compose command of the
  # stack), on an encrypted volume owned by uid 1000, the image's user node, the only place it can write. No setting of
  # it is required.
  handover:
    image: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-api
    profiles: ["handover"]
    command: ["node", "dist/handover.js"]
    restart: "no"
    network_mode: none
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    tmpfs: ["/tmp"]
    stdin_open: true
    volumes:
      - media-store:/media/store:ro
      - media-quarantine:/media/quarantine:ro

  # The quarantine's mover (3d design, sections 5 and 7.1), under the profile quarantine, started by the operator alone:
  # docker compose -f infra/compose.yml --profile quarantine run --rm -T quarantine < list > receipt, with the list that
  # staff.js quarantine-list printed, and the receipt then recorded by staff.js quarantine-record (the README,
  # Quarantine). The API's image with dist/quarantine.js, which opens no database and no socket: no network at all, no
  # environment, no credential, no capability and a read-only root; the image store and the quarantine read-write, and
  # nothing else. Its two roots are arguments of its entry point, and it refuses to start without both; what follows the
  # service's name on the command line (--lost, --inventory) is appended to them. It is the one service that writes the
  # quarantine; handover reads it, and the api, migrate and worker services never mount it.
  quarantine:
    image: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-api
    profiles: ["quarantine"]
    entrypoint: ["node", "dist/quarantine.js", "/media/store", "/media/quarantine"]
    restart: "no"
    network_mode: none
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    stdin_open: true
    volumes:
      - media-store:/media/store
      - media-quarantine:/media/quarantine

  # The push server (3f design, section 5), under the profile notify, never linked into korbat's programs: ntfy at its
  # pinned release, reading its users, rights and tokens from infra/ntfy/server.yml (git-ignored, made from
  # server.yml.example), mounted read-only, since Compose would blank the $2a$10$ of a password hash in a variable. Only
  # on push, which is internal: it has no route out, so nothing is forwarded upstream. Its cache and auth files are on its
  # volume, at /var/tmp, the one directory of the image its user may write to.
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.28.0@sha256:6ef4b819f722fccdc036af611c4774cfdc2de821ab74fdd48bbf4c9d6f8973da
    profiles: ["notify"]
    command: ["serve", "--config", "/etc/ntfy/server.yml"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true
    user: "1000:1000"
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    logging: *logging
    mem_limit: 128m
    memswap_limit: 128m
    pids_limit: 64
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy-data:/var/tmp
    networks: [push]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1:2586/v1/health"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 4

  # Caddy serves the web app on port 8080, proxying /api, the staff console on port 8090, proxying only /api/staff, and
  # (3f) the phones' push site on port 8091, proxying only the two topics' subscriptions to ntfy. It runs as its own
  # user, sees only the API and ntfy, and is the only thing cloudflared can reach. A client from the push network (ntfy,
  # the watcher) is refused 403 on the app's and the console's sites.
  caddy:
    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true
    tmpfs: ["/tmp"]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    logging: *logging
    mem_limit: 128m
    memswap_limit: 128m
    pids_limit: 64
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: infra/caddy/Dockerfile
      args:
        EXPO_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY: ${WEB_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY:?set WEB_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY in infra/.env}
        KORBAT_ENV: ${KORBAT_ENV:?set KORBAT_ENV to development or production in infra/.env}
        TUNNEL: ${TUNNEL:-off}
        EXPO_PUBLIC_BADGE: ${WEB_BADGE:-off}
        EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL: ${WEB_CONTACT_EMAIL:?set WEB_CONTACT_EMAIL in infra/.env}
        # 3f: the terms' contact point for authorities and korbat's Member State; neither is required (Before going public).
        EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_POINT: ${WEB_CONTACT_POINT:-}
        EXPO_PUBLIC_HOME_STATE: ${WEB_HOME_STATE:-}
    depends_on:
      api: { condition: service_healthy }
    environment:
      # The push network's subnet, which the app's and the console's sites refuse (3f).
      PUSH_SUBNET: ${PUSH_SUBNET:-172.16.91.0/24}
      # The app's site, open (the default) or closed: closed answers 503 to every path while a restore is checked (3f,
      # section 7.17). Caddy reads it when it starts and refuses to start on any other value.
      APP_SITE: ${APP_SITE:-open}
    volumes:
      - caddy-data:/data
      - caddy-config:/config
    networks: [edge, app, push]

  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:2026.9.1@sha256:b269e8abd07a5bf6f3f4be65d5050b2174eca89c56a0241a8ff32a16aec454e4
    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    logging: *logging
    profiles: ["tunnel"]
    command: ["tunnel", "--no-autoupdate", "run"]
    environment:
      TUNNEL_TOKEN: ${TUNNEL_TOKEN}
    networks: [edge]
    depends_on:
      - caddy

# cloudflared reaches only Caddy, Caddy reaches only the API and ntfy, and the API alone reaches the data services, but
# for the watcher's own network to PostgreSQL (3f).
networks:
  edge:
  app:
  data:
  # The watcher and PostgreSQL, nothing else. Not internal: the mail host's port 993 is reached through its gateway.
  watch:
  # ntfy, the watcher and Caddy. Internal: no route out. Its fixed subnet is what the app's and the console's sites refuse.
  push:
    internal: true
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: ${PUSH_SUBNET:-172.16.91.0/24}

volumes:
  # PostgreSQL 18. The earlier pgdata volume (PostgreSQL 16) stays until scripts/pg-major-upgrade.mjs has
  # moved it and you remove it by hand.
  pgdata18:
  valkeydata:
  # Uploads wait here for the worker and are deleted once processed. Nothing in it needs a backup.
  media-uploads:
  # The images korbat serves. Back it up together with the database.
  media-store:
  # 3d: the files of images sealed for good, moved out of the store by the quarantine service, on the host's encrypted
  # disk. It is in no backup, by decision: a restore never brings a destroyed file back. Owned by uid 1000, mode 0700, the
  # path the API's image makes (the README, Quarantine and Backups).

  caddy-config:
```
